en: and, [o muhammad], you are not [engaged] in any matter or recite any of the qur'an and you [people] do not do any deed except that we are witness over you when you are involved in it. and not absent from your lord is any [part] of an atom's weight within the earth or within the heaven or [anything] smaller than that or greater but that it is in a clear register

arNorm: الا ان اوۡلياء الله لا خوۡف عليۡهمۡ ولا همۡ يحۡزنون
en: unquestionably, [for] the allies of allah there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve

arNorm: الذين ءامنوا وكانوا يتقون
en: those who believed and were fearing allah

arNorm: لهم الۡبشۡري في الۡحيوه الدنۡيا وفي الۡاخرهۚ لا تبۡديل لكلمت اللهۚ ذلك هو الۡفوۡز الۡعظيم
en: for them are good tidings in the worldly life and in the hereafter. no change is there in the words of allah. that is what is the great attainment

arNorm: ولا يحۡزنك قوۡلهمۡۘ ان الۡعزه لله جميعاۚ هو السميع الۡعليم
en: and let not their speech grieve you. indeed, honor [due to power] belongs to allah entirely. he is the hearing, the knowing

arNorm: الا ان لله من في السموت ومن في الۡارۡضۗ وما يتبع الذين يدۡعون من دون الله شركاءۚ ان يتبعون الا الظن وانۡ همۡ الا يخۡرصون
en: unquestionably, to allah belongs whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth. and those who invoke other than allah do not [actually] follow [his] "partners." they follow not except assumption, and they are not but falsifying

arNorm: هو الذي جعل لكم اليۡل لتسۡكنوا فيه والنهار مبۡصراۚ ان في ذلك لايت لقوۡم يسۡمعون
en: it is he who made for you the night to rest therein and the day, giving sight. indeed in that are signs for a people who listen

arNorm: قالوا اتخذ الله ولداۗ سبۡحنهۥۖ هو الۡغنيۖ لهۥ ما في السموت وما في الۡارۡضۚ انۡ عندكم من سلۡطنۭ بهذاۚ اتقولون علي الله ما لا تعۡلمون
en: they have said, "allah has taken a son." exalted is he; he is the [one] free of need. to him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. you have no authority for this [claim]. do you say about allah that which you do not know

arNorm: قلۡ ان الذين يفۡترون علي الله الۡكذب لا يفۡلحون
en: say, "indeed, those who invent falsehood about allah will not succeed

arNorm: متع في الدنۡيا ثم اليۡنا مرۡجعهمۡ ثم نذيقهم الۡعذاب الشديد بما كانوا يكۡفرون
en: [for them is brief] enjoyment in this world; then to us is their return; then we will make them taste the severe punishment because they used to disbelieve

arNorm: ۞واتۡل عليۡهمۡ نبا نوح اذۡ قال لقوۡمهۦ يقوۡم ان كان كبر عليۡكم مقامي وتذۡكيري بايت الله فعلي الله توكلۡت فاجۡمعوا امۡركمۡ وشركاءكمۡ ثم لا يكنۡ امۡركمۡ عليۡكمۡ غمه ثم اقۡضوا الي ولا تنظرون
en: and recite to them the news of noah, when he said to his people, "o my people, if my residence and my reminding of the signs of allah has become burdensome upon you - then i have relied upon allah. so resolve upon your plan and [call upon] your associates. then let not your plan be obscure to you. then carry it out upon me and do not give me respite

arNorm: فان توليۡتمۡ فما سالۡتكم منۡ اجۡرۖ انۡ اجۡري الا علي اللهۖ وامرۡت انۡ اكون من الۡمسۡلمين
en: and if you turn away [from my advice] then no payment have i asked of you. my reward is only from allah, and i have been commanded to be of the muslims

arNorm: فكذبوه فنجيۡنه ومن معهۥ في الۡفلۡك وجعلۡنهمۡ خلئف واغۡرقۡنا الذين كذبوا بايتناۖ فانظرۡ كيۡف كان عقبه الۡمنذرين
en: and they denied him, so we saved him and those with him in the ship and made them successors, and we drowned those who denied our signs. then see how was the end of those who were warned

arNorm: ثم بعثۡنا منۢ بعۡدهۦ رسلا الي قوۡمهمۡ فجاءوهم بالۡبينت فما كانوا ليؤۡمنوا بما كذبوا بهۦ من قبۡلۚ كذلك نطۡبع علي قلوب الۡمعۡتدين
en: then we sent after him messengers to their peoples, and they came to them with clear proofs. but they were not to believe in that which they had denied before. thus we seal over the hearts of the transgressors

arNorm: ثم بعثۡنا منۢ بعۡدهم موسي وهرون الي فرۡعوۡن وملايهۦ بايتنا فاسۡتكۡبروا وكانوا قوۡما مجۡرمين
en: then we sent after them moses and aaron to pharaoh and his establishment with our signs, but they behaved arrogantly and were a criminal people

arNorm: فلما جاءهم الۡحق منۡ عندنا قالوا ان هذا لسحۡر مبين
en: so when there came to them the truth from us, they said, "indeed, this is obvious magic

arNorm: قال موسي اتقولون للۡحق لما جاءكمۡۖ اسحۡر هذا ولا يفۡلح السحرون
en: moses said, "do you say [thus] about the truth when it has come to you? is this magic? but magicians will not succeed

arNorm: قالوا اجئۡتنا لتلۡفتنا عما وجدۡنا عليۡه ءاباءنا وتكون لكما الۡكبۡرياء في الۡارۡض وما نحۡن لكما بمؤۡمنين
en: they said, "have you come to us to turn us away from that upon which we found our fathers and so that you two may have grandeur in the land? and we are not believers in you

arNorm: وقال فرۡعوۡن ائۡتوني بكل سحر عليم
en: and pharaoh said, "bring to me every learned magician

arNorm: فلما جاء السحره قال لهم موسي الۡقوا ما انتم ملۡقون
en: so when the magicians came, moses said to them, "throw down whatever you will throw

arNorm: فلما الۡقوۡا قال موسي ما جئۡتم به السحۡرۖ ان الله سيبۡطلهۥ ان الله لا يصۡلح عمل الۡمفۡسدين
en: and when they had thrown, moses said, "what you have brought is [only] magic. indeed, allah will expose its worthlessness. indeed, allah does not amend the work of corrupters

arNorm: ويحق الله الۡحق بكلمتهۦ ولوۡ كره الۡمجۡرمون
en: and allah will establish the truth by his words, even if the criminals dislike it

arNorm: فما ءامن لموسي الا ذريه من قوۡمهۦ علي خوۡف من فرۡعوۡن وملايهمۡ ان يفۡتنهمۡۚ وان فرۡعوۡن لعال في الۡارۡض وانهۥ لمن الۡمسۡرفين
en: but no one believed moses, except [some] youths among his people, for fear of pharaoh and his establishment that they would persecute them. and indeed, pharaoh was haughty within the land, and indeed, he was of the transgressors

arNorm: وقال موسي يقوۡم ان كنتمۡ ءامنتم بالله فعليۡه توكلوا ان كنتم مسۡلمين
en: and moses said, "o my people, if you have believed in allah, then rely upon him, if you should be muslims

arNorm: فقالوا علي الله توكلۡنا ربنا لا تجۡعلۡنا فتۡنه للۡقوۡم الظلمين
en: so they said, "upon allah do we rely. our lord, make us not [objects of] trial for the wrongdoing people

arNorm: ونجنا برحۡمتك من الۡقوۡم الۡكفرين
en: and save us by your mercy from the disbelieving people

arNorm: واوۡحيۡنا الي موسي واخيه ان تبوءا لقوۡمكما بمصۡر بيوتا واجۡعلوا بيوتكمۡ قبۡله واقيموا الصلوهۗ وبشر الۡمؤۡمنين
en: and we inspired to moses and his brother, "settle your people in egypt in houses and make your houses [facing the] qiblah and establish prayer and give good tidings to the believers

arNorm: وقال موسي ربنا انك ءاتيۡت فرۡعوۡن وملاهۥ زينه وامۡولا في الۡحيوه الدنۡيا ربنا ليضلوا عن سبيلكۖ ربنا اطۡمسۡ علي امۡولهمۡ واشۡددۡ علي قلوبهمۡ فلا يؤۡمنوا حتي يروا الۡعذاب الۡاليم
en: and moses said, "our lord, indeed you have given pharaoh and his establishment splendor and wealth in the worldly life, our lord, that they may lead [men] astray from your way. our lord, obliterate their wealth and harden their hearts so that they will not believe until they see the painful punishment

arNorm: قال قدۡ اجيبت دعۡوتكما فاسۡتقيما ولا تتبعان سبيل الذين لا يعۡلمون
en: [allah] said, "your supplication has been answered." so remain on a right course and follow not the way of those who do not know

arNorm: ۞وجوزۡنا ببني اسۡرءيل الۡبحۡر فاتۡبعهمۡ فرۡعوۡن وجنودهۥ بغۡيا وعدۡواۖ حتي اذا ادۡركه الۡغرق قال ءامنت انهۥ لا اله الا الذي ءامنتۡ بهۦ بنوا اسۡرءيل وانا۠ من الۡمسۡلمين
en: and we took the children of israel across the sea, and pharaoh and his soldiers pursued them in tyranny and enmity until, when drowning overtook him, he said, "i believe that there is no deity except that in whom the children of israel believe, and i am of the muslims

arNorm: ءالۡن وقدۡ عصيۡت قبۡل وكنت من الۡمفۡسدين
en: now? and you had disobeyed [him] before and were of the corrupters

arNorm: فالۡيوۡم ننجيك ببدنك لتكون لمنۡ خلۡفك ءايهۚ وان كثيرا من الناس عنۡ ءايتنا لغفلون
en: so today we will save you in body that you may be to those who succeed you a sign. and indeed, many among the people, of our signs, are heedless

arNorm: ولقدۡ بواۡنا بني اسۡرءيل مبوا صدۡق ورزقۡنهم من الطيبت فما اخۡتلفوا حتي جاءهم الۡعلۡمۚ ان ربك يقۡضي بيۡنهمۡ يوۡم الۡقيمه فيما كانوا فيه يخۡتلفون
en: and we had certainty settled the children of israel in an agreeable settlement and provided them with good things. and they did not differ until [after] knowledge had come to them. indeed, your lord will judge between them on the day of resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ

arNorm: فان كنت في شك مما انزلۡنا اليۡك فسۡل الذين يقۡرءون الۡكتب من قبۡلكۚ لقدۡ جاءك الۡحق من ربك فلا تكونن من الۡممۡترين
en: so if you are in doubt, [o muhammad], about that which we have revealed to you, then ask those who have been reading the scripture before you. the truth has certainly come to you from your lord, so never be among the doubters

arNorm: ولا تكونن من الذين كذبوا بايت الله فتكون من الۡخسرين
en: and never be of those who deny the signs of allah and [thus] be among the losers

arNorm: ان الذين حقتۡ عليۡهمۡ كلمت ربك لا يؤۡمنون
en: indeed, those upon whom the word of your lord has come into effect will not believe

arNorm: ولوۡ جاءتۡهمۡ كل ءايه حتي يروا الۡعذاب الۡاليم
en: even if every sign should come to them, until they see the painful punishment

arNorm: فلوۡلا كانتۡ قرۡيه ءامنتۡ فنفعها ايمنها الا قوۡم يونس لما ءامنوا كشفۡنا عنۡهمۡ عذاب الۡخزۡي في الۡحيوه الدنۡيا ومتعۡنهمۡ الي حين
en: then has there not been a [single] city that believed so its faith benefited it except the people of jonah? when they believed, we removed from them the punishment of disgrace in worldly life and gave them enjoyment for a time

arNorm: ولوۡ شاء ربك لامن من في الۡارۡض كلهمۡ جميعاۚ افانت تكۡره الناس حتي يكونوا مؤۡمنين
en: and had your lord willed, those on earth would have believed - all of them entirely. then, [o muhammad], would you compel the people in order that they become believers

arNorm: وما كان لنفۡس ان تؤۡمن الا باذۡن اللهۚ ويجۡعل الرجۡس علي الذين لا يعۡقلون
en: and it is not for a soul to believe except by permission of allah, and he will place defilement upon those who will not use reason

arNorm: قل انظروا ماذا في السموت والۡارۡضۚ وما تغۡني الۡايت والنذر عن قوۡم لا يؤۡمنون
en: say, "observe what is in the heavens and earth." but of no avail will be signs or warners to a people who do not believe

arNorm: فهلۡ ينتظرون الا مثۡل ايام الذين خلوۡا من قبۡلهمۡۚ قلۡ فانتظروا اني معكم من الۡمنتظرين
en: so do they wait except for like [what occurred in] the days of those who passed on before them? say, "then wait; indeed, i am with you among those who wait

arNorm: ثم ننجي رسلنا والذين ءامنواۚ كذلك حقا عليۡنا ننج الۡمؤۡمنين
en: then we will save our messengers and those who have believed. thus, it is an obligation upon us that we save the believers

arNorm: قلۡ يايها الناس ان كنتمۡ في شك من ديني فلا اعۡبد الذين تعۡبدون من دون الله ولكنۡ اعۡبد الله الذي يتوفيكمۡۖ وامرۡت انۡ اكون من الۡمؤۡمنين
en: say, [o muhammad], "o people, if you are in doubt as to my religion - then i do not worship those which you worship besides allah; but i worship allah, who causes your death. and i have been commanded to be of the believers

arNorm: وانۡ اقمۡ وجۡهك للدين حنيفا ولا تكونن من الۡمشۡركين
en: and [commanded], 'direct your face toward the religion, inclining to truth, and never be of those who associate others with allah

arNorm: ولا تدۡع من دون الله ما لا ينفعك ولا يضركۖ فان فعلۡت فانك اذا من الظلمين
en: and do not invoke besides allah that which neither benefits you nor harms you, for if you did, then indeed you would be of the wrongdoers

arNorm: وان يمۡسسۡك الله بضر فلا كاشف لهۥ الا هوۖ وان يردۡك بخيۡر فلا راد لفضۡلهۦۚ يصيب بهۦ من يشاء منۡ عبادهۦۚ وهو الۡغفور الرحيم
en: and if allah should touch you with adversity, there is no remover of it except him; and if he intends for you good, then there is no repeller of his bounty. he causes it to reach whom he wills of his servants. and he is the forgiving, the merciful

arNorm: قلۡ يايها الناس قدۡ جاءكم الۡحق من ربكمۡۖ فمن اهۡتدي فانما يهۡتدي لنفۡسهۦۖ ومن ضل فانما يضل عليۡهاۖ وما انا۠ عليۡكم بوكيل
en: say, "o mankind, the truth has come to you from your lord, so whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] his soul, and whoever goes astray only goes astray [in violation] against it. and i am not over you a manager

arNorm: واتبعۡ ما يوحي اليۡك واصۡبرۡ حتي يحۡكم اللهۚ وهو خيۡر الۡحكمين
en: and follow what is revealed to you, [o muhammad], and be patient until allah will judge. and he is the best of judges

arNorm: الرۚ كتب احۡكمتۡ ءايتهۥ ثم فصلتۡ من لدنۡ حكيم خبير
en: alif, lam, ra. [this is] a book whose verses are perfected and then presented in detail from [one who is] wise and acquainted

arNorm: الا تعۡبدوا الا اللهۚ انني لكم منۡه نذير وبشير
en: [through a messenger, saying], "do not worship except allah. indeed, i am to you from him a warner and a bringer of good tidings

arNorm: وان اسۡتغۡفروا ربكمۡ ثم توبوا اليۡه يمتعۡكم متعا حسنا الي اجل مسمي ويؤۡت كل ذي فضۡل فضۡلهۥۖ وان تولوۡا فاني اخاف عليۡكمۡ عذاب يوۡم كبير
en: and [saying], "seek forgiveness of your lord and repent to him, [and] he will let you enjoy a good provision for a specified term and give every doer of favor his favor. but if you turn away, then indeed, i fear for you the punishment of a great day

arNorm: الي الله مرۡجعكمۡۖ وهو علي كل شيۡء قدير
en: to allah is your return, and he is over all things competent

arNorm: الا انهمۡ يثۡنون صدورهمۡ ليسۡتخۡفوا منۡهۚ الا حين يسۡتغۡشون ثيابهمۡ يعۡلم ما يسرون وما يعۡلنونۚ انهۥ عليمۢ بذات الصدور
en: unquestionably, they the disbelievers turn away their breasts to hide themselves from him. unquestionably, [even] when they cover themselves in their clothing, allah knows what they conceal and what they declare. indeed, he is knowing of that within the breasts

arNorm: ۞وما من دابه في الۡارۡض الا علي الله رزۡقها ويعۡلم مسۡتقرها ومسۡتوۡدعهاۚ كل في كتب مبين
en: and there is no creature on earth but that upon allah is its provision, and he knows its place of dwelling and place of storage. all is in a clear register

arNorm: وهو الذي خلق السموت والۡارۡض في سته ايام وكان عرۡشهۥ علي الۡماء ليبۡلوكمۡ ايكمۡ احۡسن عملاۗ ولئن قلۡت انكم مبۡعوثون منۢ بعۡد الۡموۡت ليقولن الذين كفروا انۡ هذا الا سحۡر مبين
en: and it is he who created the heavens and the earth in six days - and his throne had been upon water - that he might test you as to which of you is best in deed. but if you say, "indeed, you are resurrected after death," those who disbelieve will surely say, "this is not but obvious magic

arNorm: ولئنۡ اخرۡنا عنۡهم الۡعذاب الي امه معۡدوده ليقولن ما يحۡبسهۥۗ الا يوۡم ياۡتيهمۡ ليۡس مصۡروفا عنۡهمۡ وحاق بهم ما كانوا بهۦ يسۡتهۡزءون
en: and if we hold back from them the punishment for a limited time, they will surely say, "what detains it?" unquestionably, on the day it comes to them, it will not be averted from them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule

arNorm: ولئنۡ اذقۡنا الۡانسن منا رحۡمه ثم نزعۡنها منۡه انهۥ ليوس كفور
en: and if we give man a taste of mercy from us and then we withdraw it from him, indeed, he is despairing and ungrateful

arNorm: ولئنۡ اذقۡنه نعۡماء بعۡد ضراء مستۡه ليقولن ذهب السيات عنيۚ انهۥ لفرح فخور
en: but if we give him a taste of favor after hardship has touched him, he will surely say, "bad times have left me." indeed, he is exultant and boastful

arNorm: الا الذين صبروا وعملوا الصلحت اولئك لهم مغۡفره واجۡر كبير
en: except for those who are patient and do righteous deeds; those will have forgiveness and great reward

arNorm: فلعلك تاركۢ بعۡض ما يوحي اليۡك وضائقۢ بهۦ صدۡرك ان يقولوا لوۡلا انزل عليۡه كنز اوۡ جاء معهۥ ملكۚ انما انت نذيرۚ والله علي كل شيۡء وكيل
en: then would you possibly leave [out] some of what is revealed to you, or is your breast constrained by it because they say, "why has there not been sent down to him a treasure or come with him an angel?" but you are only a warner. and allah is disposer of all things

arNorm: امۡ يقولون افۡتريهۖ قلۡ فاۡتوا بعشۡر سور مثۡلهۦ مفۡتريت وادۡعوا من اسۡتطعۡتم من دون الله ان كنتمۡ صدقين
en: or do they say, "he invented it"? say, "then bring ten surahs like it that have been invented and call upon [for assistance] whomever you can besides allah, if you should be truthful

arNorm: فالمۡ يسۡتجيبوا لكمۡ فاعۡلموا انما انزل بعلۡم الله وان لا اله الا هوۖ فهلۡ انتم مسۡلمون
en: and if they do not respond to you - then know that the qur'an was revealed with the knowledge of allah and that there is no deity except him. then, would you [not] be muslims

arNorm: من كان يريد الۡحيوه الدنۡيا وزينتها نوف اليۡهمۡ اعۡملهمۡ فيها وهمۡ فيها لا يبۡخسون
en: whoever desires the life of this world and its adornments - we fully repay them for their deeds therein, and they therein will not be deprived

arNorm: اولئك الذين ليۡس لهمۡ في الۡاخره الا النارۖ وحبط ما صنعوا فيها وبطل ما كانوا يعۡملون
en: those are the ones for whom there is not in the hereafter but the fire. and lost is what they did therein, and worthless is what they used to do

arNorm: افمن كان علي بينه من ربهۦ ويتۡلوه شاهد منۡه ومن قبۡلهۦ كتب موسي اماما ورحۡمهۚ اولئك يؤۡمنون بهۦۚ ومن يكۡفرۡ بهۦ من الۡاحۡزاب فالنار موۡعدهۥۚ فلا تك في مرۡيه منۡهۚ انه الۡحق من ربك ولكن اكۡثر الناس لا يؤۡمنون
en: so is one who [stands] upon a clear evidence from his lord [like the aforementioned]? and a witness from him follows it, and before it was the scripture of moses to lead and as mercy. those [believers in the former revelations] believe in the qur'an. but whoever disbelieves in it from the [various] factions - the fire is his promised destination. so be not in doubt about it. indeed, it is the truth from your lord, but most of the people do not believe

arNorm: ومنۡ اظۡلم ممن افۡتري علي الله كذباۚ اولئك يعۡرضون علي ربهمۡ ويقول الۡاشۡهد هؤلاء الذين كذبوا علي ربهمۡۚ الا لعۡنه الله علي الظلمين
en: and who is more unjust than he who invents a lie about allah? those will be presented before their lord, and the witnesses will say, "these are the ones who lied against their lord." unquestionably, the curse of allah is upon the wrongdoers

arNorm: الذين يصدون عن سبيل الله ويبۡغونها عوجا وهم بالۡاخره همۡ كفرون
en: who averted [people] from the way of allah and sought to make it [seem] deviant while they, concerning the hereafter, were disbelievers

arNorm: اولئك لمۡ يكونوا معۡجزين في الۡارۡض وما كان لهم من دون الله منۡ اوۡلياءۘ يضعف لهم الۡعذابۚ ما كانوا يسۡتطيعون السمۡع وما كانوا يبۡصرون
en: those were not causing failure [to allah] on earth, nor did they have besides allah any protectors. for them the punishment will be multiplied. they were not able to hear, nor did they see

arNorm: اولئك الذين خسروا انفسهمۡ وضل عنۡهم ما كانوا يفۡترون
en: those are the ones who will have lost themselves, and lost from them is what they used to invent

arNorm: لا جرم انهمۡ في الۡاخره هم الۡاخۡسرون
en: assuredly, it is they in the hereafter who will be the greatest losers

arNorm: ان الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت واخۡبتوا الي ربهمۡ اولئك اصۡحب الۡجنهۖ همۡ فيها خلدون
en: indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds and humbled themselves to their lord - those are the companions of paradise; they will abide eternally therein

arNorm: ۞مثل الۡفريقيۡن كالۡاعۡمي والۡاصم والۡبصير والسميعۚ هلۡ يسۡتويان مثلاۚ افلا تذكرون
en: the example of the two parties is like the blind and deaf, and the seeing and hearing. are they equal in comparison? then, will you not remember

arNorm: ولقدۡ ارۡسلۡنا نوحا الي قوۡمهۦ اني لكمۡ نذير مبين
en: and we had certainly sent noah to his people, [saying], "indeed, i am to you a clear warner

arNorm: ان لا تعۡبدوا الا اللهۖ اني اخاف عليۡكمۡ عذاب يوۡم اليم
en: that you not worship except allah. indeed, i fear for you the punishment of a painful day

arNorm: فقال الۡملا الذين كفروا من قوۡمهۦ ما نريك الا بشرا مثۡلنا وما نريك اتبعك الا الذين همۡ اراذلنا بادي الراۡي وما نري لكمۡ عليۡنا من فضۡلۭ بلۡ نظنكمۡ كذبين
en: so the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "we do not see you but as a man like ourselves, and we do not see you followed except by those who are the lowest of us [and] at first suggestion. and we do not see in you over us any merit; rather, we think you are liars

arNorm: قال يقوۡم ارءيۡتمۡ ان كنت علي بينه من ربي وءاتيني رحۡمه منۡ عندهۦ فعميتۡ عليۡكمۡ انلۡزمكموها وانتمۡ لها كرهون
en: he said, "o my people have you considered: if i should be upon clear evidence from my lord while he has given me mercy from himself but it has been made unapparent to you, should we force it upon you while you are averse to it

arNorm: ويقوۡم لا اسۡلكمۡ عليۡه مالاۖ انۡ اجۡري الا علي اللهۚ وما انا۠ بطارد الذين ءامنواۚ انهم ملقوا ربهمۡ ولكني اريكمۡ قوۡما تجۡهلون
en: and o my people, i ask not of you for it any wealth. my reward is not but from allah. and i am not one to drive away those who have believed. indeed, they will meet their lord, but i see that you are a people behaving ignorantly

arNorm: ويقوۡم من ينصرني من الله ان طردتهمۡۚ افلا تذكرون
en: and o my people, who would protect me from allah if i drove them away? then will you not be reminded

arNorm: ولا اقول لكمۡ عندي خزائن الله ولا اعۡلم الۡغيۡب ولا اقول اني ملك ولا اقول للذين تزۡدري اعۡينكمۡ لن يؤۡتيهم الله خيۡراۖ الله اعۡلم بما في انفسهمۡ اني اذا لمن الظلمين
en: and i do not tell you that i have the depositories [containing the provision] of allah or that i know the unseen, nor do i tell you that i am an angel, nor do i say of those upon whom your eyes look down that allah will never grant them any good. allah is most knowing of what is within their souls. indeed, i would then be among the wrongdoers

arNorm: قالوا ينوح قدۡ جدلۡتنا فاكۡثرۡت جدلنا فاۡتنا بما تعدنا ان كنت من الصدقين
en: they said, "o noah, you have disputed us and been frequent in dispute of us. so bring us what you threaten us, if you should be of the truthful

arNorm: قال انما ياۡتيكم به الله ان شاء وما انتم بمعۡجزين
en: he said, "allah will only bring it to you if he wills, and you will not cause [him] failure

arNorm: ولا ينفعكمۡ نصۡحي انۡ اردت انۡ انصح لكمۡ ان كان الله يريد ان يغۡويكمۡۚ هو ربكمۡ واليۡه ترۡجعون
en: and my advice will not benefit you - although i wished to advise you - if allah should intend to put you in error. he is your lord, and to him you will be returned

arNorm: امۡ يقولون افۡتريهۖ قلۡ ان افۡتريۡتهۥ فعلي اجۡرامي وانا۠ بريء مما تجۡرمون
en: or do they say [about prophet muhammad], "he invented it"? say, "if i have invented it, then upon me is [the consequence of] my crime; but i am innocent of what [crimes] you commit

arNorm: واوحي الي نوح انهۥ لن يؤۡمن من قوۡمك الا من قدۡ ءامن فلا تبۡتئسۡ بما كانوا يفۡعلون
en: and it was revealed to noah that, "no one will believe from your people except those who have already believed, so do not be distressed by what they have been doing

arNorm: واصۡنع الۡفلۡك باعۡيننا ووحۡينا ولا تخطبۡني في الذين ظلموا انهم مغۡرقون
en: and construct the ship under our observation and our inspiration and do not address me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are [to be] drowned

arNorm: ويصۡنع الۡفلۡك وكلما مر عليۡه ملا من قوۡمهۦ سخروا منۡهۚ قال ان تسۡخروا منا فانا نسۡخر منكمۡ كما تسۡخرون
en: and he constructed the ship, and whenever an assembly of the eminent of his people passed by him, they ridiculed him. he said, "if you ridicule us, then we will ridicule you just as you ridicule

arNorm: فسوۡف تعۡلمون من ياۡتيه عذاب يخۡزيه ويحل عليۡه عذاب مقيم
en: and you are going to know who will get a punishment that will disgrace him [on earth] and upon whom will descend an enduring punishment [in the hereafter]

arNorm: حتي اذا جاء امۡرنا وفار التنور قلۡنا احۡملۡ فيها من كل زوۡجيۡن اثۡنيۡن واهۡلك الا من سبق عليۡه الۡقوۡل ومنۡ ءامنۚ وما ءامن معهۥ الا قليل
en: [so it was], until when our command came and the oven overflowed, we said, "load upon the ship of each [creature] two mates and your family, except those about whom the word has preceded, and [include] whoever has believed." but none had believed with him, except a few

arNorm: ۞وقال ارۡكبوا فيها بسۡم الله مجۡريها ومرۡسيهاۚ ان ربي لغفور رحيم
en: and [noah] said, "embark therein; in the name of allah is its course and its anchorage. indeed, my lord is forgiving and merciful

arNorm: وهي تجۡري بهمۡ في موۡج كالۡجبال ونادي نوح ابۡنهۥ وكان في معۡزل يبني ارۡكب معنا ولا تكن مع الۡكفرين
en: and it sailed with them through waves like mountains, and noah called to his son who was apart [from them], "o my son, come aboard with us and be not with the disbelievers

arNorm: قال ساوي الي جبل يعۡصمني من الۡماءۚ قال لا عاصم الۡيوۡم منۡ امۡر الله الا من رحمۚ وحال بيۡنهما الۡموۡج فكان من الۡمغۡرقين
en: [but] he said, "i will take refuge on a mountain to protect me from the water." [noah] said, "there is no protector today from the decree of allah, except for whom he gives mercy." and the waves came between them, and he was among the drowned

arNorm: وقيل يارۡض ابۡلعي ماءك ويسماء اقۡلعي وغيض الۡماء وقضي الۡامۡر واسۡتوتۡ علي الۡجوديۖ وقيل بعۡدا للۡقوۡم الظلمين
en: and it was said, "o earth, swallow your water, and o sky, withhold [your rain]." and the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and the ship came to rest on the [mountain of] judiyy. and it was said, "away with the wrongdoing people

arNorm: ونادي نوح ربهۥ فقال رب ان ابۡني منۡ اهۡلي وان وعۡدك الۡحق وانت احۡكم الۡحكمين
en: and noah called to his lord and said, "my lord, indeed my son is of my family; and indeed, your promise is true; and you are the most just of judges

arNorm: قال ينوح انهۥ ليۡس منۡ اهۡلكۖ انهۥ عمل غيۡر صلحۖ فلا تسۡلۡن ما ليۡس لك بهۦ علۡمۖ اني اعظك ان تكون من الۡجهلين
en: he said, "o noah, indeed he is not of your family; indeed, he is [one whose] work was other than righteous, so ask me not for that about which you have no knowledge. indeed, i advise you, lest you be among the ignorant

arNorm: قال رب اني اعوذ بك انۡ اسۡلك ما ليۡس لي بهۦ علۡمۖ والا تغۡفرۡ لي وترۡحمۡني اكن من الۡخسرين
en: [noah] said, "my lord, i seek refuge in you from asking that of which i have no knowledge. and unless you forgive me and have mercy upon me, i will be among the losers

arNorm: قيل ينوح اهۡبطۡ بسلم منا وبركت عليۡك وعلي امم ممن معكۚ وامم سنمتعهمۡ ثم يمسهم منا عذاب اليم
en: it was said, "o noah, disembark in security from us and blessings upon you and upon nations [descending] from those with you. but other nations [of them] we will grant enjoyment; then there will touch them from us a painful punishment

arNorm: تلۡك منۡ انۢباء الۡغيۡب نوحيها اليۡكۖ ما كنت تعۡلمها انت ولا قوۡمك من قبۡل هذاۖ فاصۡبرۡۖ ان الۡعقبه للۡمتقين
en: that is from the news of the unseen which we reveal to you, [o muhammad]. you knew it not, neither you nor your people, before this. so be patient; indeed, the [best] outcome is for the righteous

arNorm: والي عاد اخاهمۡ هوداۚ قال يقوۡم اعۡبدوا الله ما لكم منۡ اله غيۡرهۥۖ انۡ انتمۡ الا مفۡترون
en: and to 'aad [we sent] their brother hud. he said, "o my people, worship allah; you have no deity other than him. you are not but inventors [of falsehood]

arNorm: يقوۡم لا اسۡلكمۡ عليۡه اجۡراۖ انۡ اجۡري الا علي الذي فطرنيۚ افلا تعۡقلون
en: o my people, i do not ask you for it any reward. my reward is only from the one who created me. then will you not reason

arNorm: ويقوۡم اسۡتغۡفروا ربكمۡ ثم توبوا اليۡه يرۡسل السماء عليۡكم مدۡرارا ويزدۡكمۡ قوه الي قوتكمۡ ولا تتولوۡا مجۡرمين
en: and o my people, ask forgiveness of your lord and then repent to him. he will send [rain from] the sky upon you in showers and increase you in strength [added] to your strength. and do not turn away, [being] criminals

arNorm: قالوا يهود ما جئۡتنا ببينه وما نحۡن بتاركي ءالهتنا عن قوۡلك وما نحۡن لك بمؤۡمنين
en: they said, "o hud, you have not brought us clear evidence, and we are not ones to leave our gods on your say-so. nor are we believers in you

arNorm: ان نقول الا اعۡتريك بعۡض ءالهتنا بسوءۗ قال اني اشۡهد الله واشۡهدوا اني بريء مما تشۡركون
en: we only say that some of our gods have possessed you with evil." he said, "indeed, i call allah to witness, and witness [yourselves] that i am free from whatever you associate with allah

arNorm: من دونهۦۖ فكيدوني جميعا ثم لا تنظرون
en: other than him. so plot against me all together; then do not give me respite

arNorm: اني توكلۡت علي الله ربي وربكمۚ ما من دابه الا هو ءاخذۢ بناصيتهاۚ ان ربي علي صرط مسۡتقيم
en: indeed, i have relied upon allah, my lord and your lord. there is no creature but that he holds its forelock. indeed, my lord is on a path [that is] straight

arNorm: فان تولوۡا فقدۡ ابۡلغۡتكم ما ارۡسلۡت بهۦ اليۡكمۡۚ ويسۡتخۡلف ربي قوۡما غيۡركمۡ ولا تضرونهۥ شيۡاۚ ان ربي علي كل شيۡء حفيظ
en: but if they turn away, [say], "i have already conveyed that with which i was sent to you. my lord will give succession to a people other than you, and you will not harm him at all. indeed my lord is, over all things, guardian

arNorm: ولما جاء امۡرنا نجيۡنا هودا والذين ءامنوا معهۥ برحۡمه منا ونجيۡنهم منۡ عذاب غليظ
en: and when our command came, we saved hud and those who believed with him, by mercy from us; and we saved them from a harsh punishment

arNorm: وتلۡك عادۖ جحدوا بايت ربهمۡ وعصوۡا رسلهۥ واتبعوا امۡر كل جبار عنيد
en: and that was 'aad, who rejected the signs of their lord and disobeyed his messengers and followed the order of every obstinate tyrant

arNorm: واتۡبعوا في هذه الدنۡيا لعۡنه ويوۡم الۡقيمهۗ الا ان عادا كفروا ربهمۡۗ الا بعۡدا لعاد قوۡم هود
en: and they were [therefore] followed in this world with a curse and [as well] on the day of resurrection. unquestionably, 'aad denied their lord; then away with 'aad, the people of hud

arNorm: ۞والي ثمود اخاهمۡ صلحاۚ قال يقوۡم اعۡبدوا الله ما لكم منۡ اله غيۡرهۥۖ هو انشاكم من الۡارۡض واسۡتعۡمركمۡ فيها فاسۡتغۡفروه ثم توبوا اليۡهۚ ان ربي قريب مجيب
en: and to thamud [we sent] their brother salih. he said, "o my people, worship allah; you have no deity other than him. he has produced you from the earth and settled you in it, so ask forgiveness of him and then repent to him. indeed, my lord is near and responsive

arNorm: قالوا يصلح قدۡ كنت فينا مرۡجوا قبۡل هذاۖ اتنۡهينا ان نعۡبد ما يعۡبد ءاباؤنا واننا لفي شك مما تدۡعونا اليۡه مريب
en: they said, "o salih, you were among us a man of promise before this. do you forbid us to worship what our fathers worshipped? and indeed we are, about that to which you invite us, in disquieting doubt

arNorm: قال يقوۡم ارءيۡتمۡ ان كنت علي بينه من ربي وءاتيني منۡه رحۡمه فمن ينصرني من الله انۡ عصيۡتهۥۖ فما تزيدونني غيۡر تخۡسير
en: he said, "o my people, have you considered: if i should be upon clear evidence from my lord and he has given me mercy from himself, who would protect me from allah if i disobeyed him? so you would not increase me except in loss

arNorm: ويقوۡم هذهۦ ناقه الله لكمۡ ءايهۖ فذروها تاۡكلۡ في ارۡض اللهۖ ولا تمسوها بسوء فياۡخذكمۡ عذاب قريب
en: and o my people, this is the she-camel of allah - [she is] to you a sign. so let her feed upon allah 's earth and do not touch her with harm, or you will be taken by an impending punishment

arNorm: فعقروها فقال تمتعوا في داركمۡ ثلثه ايامۖ ذلك وعۡد غيۡر مكۡذوب
en: but they hamstrung her, so he said, "enjoy yourselves in your homes for three days. that is a promise not to be denied

arNorm: فلما جاء امۡرنا نجيۡنا صلحا والذين ءامنوا معهۥ برحۡمه منا ومنۡ خزۡي يوۡمئذۚ ان ربك هو الۡقوي الۡعزيز
en: so when our command came, we saved salih and those who believed with him, by mercy from us, and [saved them] from the disgrace of that day. indeed, it is your lord who is the powerful, the exalted in might

arNorm: واخذ الذين ظلموا الصيۡحه فاصۡبحوا في ديرهمۡ جثمين
en: and the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone

arNorm: كان لمۡ يغۡنوۡا فيهاۗ الا ان ثمودا كفروا ربهمۡۗ الا بعۡدا لثمود
en: as if they had never prospered therein. unquestionably, thamud denied their lord; then, away with thamud

arNorm: ولقدۡ جاءتۡ رسلنا ابۡرهيم بالۡبشۡري قالوا سلماۖ قال سلمۖ فما لبث ان جاء بعجۡل حنيذ
en: and certainly did our messengers come to abraham with good tidings; they said, "peace." he said, "peace," and did not delay in bringing [them] a roasted calf

arNorm: فلما رءا ايۡديهمۡ لا تصل اليۡه نكرهمۡ واوۡجس منۡهمۡ خيفهۚ قالوا لا تخفۡ انا ارۡسلۡنا الي قوۡم لوط
en: but when he saw their hands not reaching for it, he distrusted them and felt from them apprehension. they said, "fear not. we have been sent to the people of lot

arNorm: وامۡراتهۥ قائمه فضحكتۡ فبشرۡنها باسۡحق ومن وراء اسۡحق يعۡقوب
en: and his wife was standing, and she smiled. then we gave her good tidings of isaac and after isaac, jacob

arNorm: قالتۡ يويۡلتي ءالد وانا۠ عجوز وهذا بعۡلي شيۡخاۖ ان هذا لشيۡء عجيب
en: she said, "woe to me! shall i give birth while i am an old woman and this, my husband, is an old man? indeed, this is an amazing thing

arNorm: قالوا اتعۡجبين منۡ امۡر اللهۖ رحۡمت الله وبركتهۥ عليۡكمۡ اهۡل الۡبيۡتۚ انهۥ حميد مجيد
en: they said, "are you amazed at the decree of allah? may the mercy of allah and his blessings be upon you, people of the house. indeed, he is praiseworthy and honorable

arNorm: فلما ذهب عنۡ ابۡرهيم الروۡع وجاءتۡه الۡبشۡري يجدلنا في قوۡم لوط
en: and when the fright had left abraham and the good tidings had reached him, he began to argue with us concerning the people of lot

arNorm: ان ابۡرهيم لحليم اوه منيب
en: indeed, abraham was forbearing, grieving and [frequently] returning [to allah]

arNorm: يابۡرهيم اعۡرضۡ عنۡ هذاۖ انهۥ قدۡ جاء امۡر ربكۖ وانهمۡ ءاتيهمۡ عذاب غيۡر مرۡدود
en: [the angels said], "o abraham, give up this [plea]. indeed, the command of your lord has come, and indeed, there will reach them a punishment that cannot be repelled

arNorm: ولما جاءتۡ رسلنا لوطا سيء بهمۡ وضاق بهمۡ ذرۡعا وقال هذا يوۡم عصيب
en: and when our messengers, [the angels], came to lot, he was anguished for them and felt for them great discomfort and said, "this is a trying day

arNorm: وجاءهۥ قوۡمهۥ يهۡرعون اليۡه ومن قبۡل كانوا يعۡملون السياتۚ قال يقوۡم هؤلاء بناتي هن اطۡهر لكمۡۖ فاتقوا الله ولا تخۡزون في ضيۡفيۖ اليۡس منكمۡ رجل رشيد
en: and his people came hastening to him, and before [this] they had been doing evil deeds. he said, "o my people, these are my daughters; they are purer for you. so fear allah and do not disgrace me concerning my guests. is there not among you a man of reason

arNorm: قالوا لقدۡ علمۡت ما لنا في بناتك منۡ حق وانك لتعۡلم ما نريد
en: they said, "you have already known that we have not concerning your daughters any claim, and indeed, you know what we want

arNorm: قال لوۡ ان لي بكمۡ قوه اوۡ ءاوي الي ركۡن شديد
en: he said, "if only i had against you some power or could take refuge in a strong support

arNorm: قالوا يلوط انا رسل ربك لن يصلوا اليۡكۖ فاسۡر باهۡلك بقطۡع من اليۡل ولا يلۡتفتۡ منكمۡ احد الا امۡراتكۖ انهۥ مصيبها ما اصابهمۡۚ ان موۡعدهم الصبۡحۚ اليۡس الصبۡح بقريب
en: the angels said, "o lot, indeed we are messengers of your lord; [therefore], they will never reach you. so set out with your family during a portion of the night and let not any among you look back - except your wife; indeed, she will be struck by that which strikes them. indeed, their appointment is [for] the morning. is not the morning near

arNorm: فلما جاء امۡرنا جعلۡنا عليها سافلها وامۡطرۡنا عليۡها حجاره من سجيل منضود
en: so when our command came, we made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of layered hard clay, [which were]

arNorm: مسومه عند ربكۖ وما هي من الظلمين ببعيد
en: marked from your lord. and allah 's punishment is not from the wrongdoers [very] far

arNorm: ۞والي مدۡين اخاهمۡ شعيۡباۚ قال يقوۡم اعۡبدوا الله ما لكم منۡ اله غيۡرهۥۖ ولا تنقصوا الۡمكۡيال والۡميزانۖ اني اريكم بخيۡر واني اخاف عليۡكمۡ عذاب يوۡم محيط
en: and to madyan [we sent] their brother shu'ayb. he said, "o my people, worship allah; you have no deity other than him. and do not decrease from the measure and the scale. indeed, i see you in prosperity, but indeed, i fear for you the punishment of an all-encompassing day

arNorm: ويقوۡم اوۡفوا الۡمكۡيال والۡميزان بالۡقسۡطۖ ولا تبۡخسوا الناس اشۡياءهمۡ ولا تعۡثوۡا في الۡارۡض مفۡسدين
en: and o my people, give full measure and weight in justice and do not deprive the people of their due and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption

arNorm: بقيت الله خيۡر لكمۡ ان كنتم مؤۡمنينۚ وما انا۠ عليۡكم بحفيظ
en: what remains [lawful] from allah is best for you, if you would be believers. but i am not a guardian over you

arNorm: قالوا يشعيۡب اصلوتك تاۡمرك ان نتۡرك ما يعۡبد ءاباؤنا اوۡ ان نفۡعل في امۡولنا ما نشؤاۖ انك لانت الۡحليم الرشيد
en: they said, "o shu'ayb, does your prayer command you that we should leave what our fathers worship or not do with our wealth what we please? indeed, you are the forbearing, the discerning

arNorm: قال يقوۡم ارءيۡتمۡ ان كنت علي بينه من ربي ورزقني منۡه رزۡقا حسناۚ وما اريد انۡ اخالفكمۡ الي ما انۡهيكمۡ عنۡهۚ انۡ اريد الا الۡاصۡلح ما اسۡتطعۡتۚ وما توۡفيقي الا باللهۚ عليۡه توكلۡت واليۡه انيب
en: he said, "o my people, have you considered: if i am upon clear evidence from my lord and he has provided me with a good provision from him...? and i do not intend to differ from you in that which i have forbidden you; i only intend reform as much as i am able. and my success is not but through allah. upon him i have relied, and to him i return

arNorm: ويقوۡم لا يجۡرمنكمۡ شقاقي ان يصيبكم مثۡل ما اصاب قوۡم نوح اوۡ قوۡم هود اوۡ قوۡم صلحۚ وما قوۡم لوط منكم ببعيد
en: and o my people, let not [your] dissension from me cause you to be struck by that similar to what struck the people of noah or the people of hud or the people of salih. and the people of lot are not from you far away

arNorm: واسۡتغۡفروا ربكمۡ ثم توبوا اليۡهۚ ان ربي رحيم ودود
en: and ask forgiveness of your lord and then repent to him. indeed, my lord is merciful and affectionate

arNorm: قالوا يشعيۡب ما نفۡقه كثيرا مما تقول وانا لنريك فينا ضعيفاۖ ولوۡلا رهۡطك لرجمۡنكۖ وما انت عليۡنا بعزيز
en: they said, "o shu'ayb, we do not understand much of what you say, and indeed, we consider you among us as weak. and if not for your family, we would have stoned you [to death]; and you are not to us one respected

arNorm: قال يقوۡم ارهۡطي اعز عليۡكم من الله واتخذۡتموه وراءكمۡ ظهۡرياۖ ان ربي بما تعۡملون محيط
en: he said, "o my people, is my family more respected for power by you than allah? but you put him behind your backs [in neglect]. indeed, my lord is encompassing of what you do

arNorm: ويقوۡم اعۡملوا علي مكانتكمۡ اني عملۖ سوۡف تعۡلمون من ياۡتيه عذاب يخۡزيه ومنۡ هو كذبۖ وارۡتقبوا اني معكمۡ رقيب
en: and o my people, work according to your position; indeed, i am working. you are going to know to whom will come a punishment that will disgrace him and who is a liar. so watch; indeed, i am with you a watcher, [awaiting the outcome]

arNorm: ولما جاء امۡرنا نجيۡنا شعيۡبا والذين ءامنوا معهۥ برحۡمه منا واخذت الذين ظلموا الصيۡحه فاصۡبحوا في ديرهمۡ جثمين
en: and when our command came, we saved shu'ayb and those who believed with him, by mercy from us. and the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone

arNorm: كان لمۡ يغۡنوۡا فيهاۗ الا بعۡدا لمدۡين كما بعدتۡ ثمود
en: as if they had never prospered therein. then, away with madyan as thamud was taken away

arNorm: ولقدۡ ارۡسلۡنا موسي بايتنا وسلۡطن مبين
en: and we did certainly send moses with our signs and a clear authority

arNorm: الي فرۡعوۡن وملايهۦ فاتبعوا امۡر فرۡعوۡنۖ وما امۡر فرۡعوۡن برشيد
en: to pharaoh and his establishment, but they followed the command of pharaoh, and the command of pharaoh was not [at all] discerning

arNorm: يقۡدم قوۡمهۥ يوۡم الۡقيمه فاوۡردهم النارۖ وبئۡس الۡورۡد الۡموۡرود
en: he will precede his people on the day of resurrection and lead them into the fire; and wretched is the place to which they are led

arNorm: واتۡبعوا في هذهۦ لعۡنه ويوۡم الۡقيمهۚ بئۡس الرفۡد الۡمرۡفود
en: and they were followed in this [world] with a curse and on the day of resurrection. and wretched is the gift which is given

arNorm: ذلك منۡ انۢباء الۡقري نقصهۥ عليۡكۖ منۡها قائم وحصيد
en: that is from the news of the cities, which we relate to you; of them, some are [still] standing and some are [as] a harvest [mowed down]

arNorm: وما ظلمۡنهمۡ ولكن ظلموا انفسهمۡۖ فما اغۡنتۡ عنۡهمۡ ءالهتهم التي يدۡعون من دون الله من شيۡء لما جاء امۡر ربكۖ وما زادوهمۡ غيۡر تتۡبيب
en: and we did not wrong them, but they wronged themselves. and they were not availed at all by their gods which they invoked other than allah when there came the command of your lord. and they did not increase them in other than ruin

arNorm: وكذلك اخۡذ ربك اذا اخذ الۡقري وهي ظلمهۚ ان اخۡذهۥ اليم شديد
en: and thus is the seizure of your lord when he seizes the cities while they are committing wrong. indeed, his seizure is painful and severe

arNorm: ان في ذلك لايه لمنۡ خاف عذاب الۡاخرهۚ ذلك يوۡم مجۡموع له الناس وذلك يوۡم مشۡهود
en: indeed in that is a sign for those who fear the punishment of the hereafter. that is a day for which the people will be collected, and that is a day [which will be] witnessed

arNorm: وما نؤخرهۥ الا لاجل معۡدود
en: and we do not delay it except for a limited term

arNorm: يوۡم ياۡت لا تكلم نفۡس الا باذۡنهۦۚ فمنۡهمۡ شقي وسعيد
en: the day it comes no soul will speak except by his permission. and among them will be the wretched and the prosperous

arNorm: فاما الذين شقوا ففي النار لهمۡ فيها زفير وشهيق
en: as for those who were [destined to be] wretched, they will be in the fire. for them therein is [violent] exhaling and inhaling

arNorm: خلدين فيها ما دامت السموت والۡارۡض الا ما شاء ربكۚ ان ربك فعال لما يريد
en: [they will be] abiding therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your lord should will. indeed, your lord is an effecter of what he intends

arNorm: ۞واما الذين سعدوا ففي الۡجنه خلدين فيها ما دامت السموت والۡارۡض الا ما شاء ربكۖ عطاء غيۡر مجۡذوذ
en: and as for those who were [destined to be] prosperous, they will be in paradise, abiding therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your lord should will - a bestowal uninterrupted

arNorm: فلا تك في مرۡيه مما يعۡبد هؤلاءۚ ما يعۡبدون الا كما يعۡبد ءاباؤهم من قبۡلۚ وانا لموفوهمۡ نصيبهمۡ غيۡر منقوص
en: so do not be in doubt, [o muhammad], as to what these [polytheists] are worshipping. they worship not except as their fathers worshipped before. and indeed, we will give them their share undiminished

arNorm: ولقدۡ ءاتيۡنا موسي الۡكتب فاخۡتلف فيهۚ ولوۡلا كلمه سبقتۡ من ربك لقضي بيۡنهمۡۚ وانهمۡ لفي شك منۡه مريب
en: and we had certainly given moses the scripture, but it came under disagreement. and if not for a word that preceded from your lord, it would have been judged between them. and indeed they are, concerning the qur'an, in disquieting doubt

arNorm: وان كلا لما ليوفينهمۡ ربك اعۡملهمۡۚ انهۥ بما يعۡملون خبير
en: and indeed, each [of the believers and disbelievers] - your lord will fully compensate them for their deeds. indeed, he is acquainted with what they do

arNorm: فاسۡتقمۡ كما امرۡت ومن تاب معك ولا تطۡغوۡاۚ انهۥ بما تعۡملون بصير
en: so remain on a right course as you have been commanded, [you] and those who have turned back with you [to allah], and do not transgress. indeed, he is seeing of what you do

arNorm: ولا ترۡكنوا الي الذين ظلموا فتمسكم النار وما لكم من دون الله منۡ اوۡلياء ثم لا تنصرون
en: and do not incline toward those who do wrong, lest you be touched by the fire, and you would not have other than allah any protectors; then you would not be helped

arNorm: واقم الصلوه طرفي النهار وزلفا من اليۡلۚ ان الۡحسنت يذۡهبۡن السياتۚ ذلك ذكۡري للذكرين
en: and establish prayer at the two ends of the day and at the approach of the night. indeed, good deeds do away with misdeeds. that is a reminder for those who remember

arNorm: واصۡبرۡ فان الله لا يضيع اجۡر الۡمحۡسنين
en: and be patient, for indeed, allah does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good

arNorm: فلوۡلا كان من الۡقرون من قبۡلكمۡ اولوا بقيه ينۡهوۡن عن الۡفساد في الۡارۡض الا قليلا ممنۡ انجيۡنا منۡهمۡۗ واتبع الذين ظلموا ما اتۡرفوا فيه وكانوا مجۡرمين
en: so why were there not among the generations before you those of enduring discrimination forbidding corruption on earth - except a few of those we saved from among them? but those who wronged pursued what luxury they were given therein, and they were criminals

arNorm: وما كان ربك ليهۡلك الۡقري بظلۡم واهۡلها مصۡلحون
en: and your lord would not have destroyed the cities unjustly while their people were reformers

arNorm: ولوۡ شاء ربك لجعل الناس امه وحدهۖ ولا يزالون مخۡتلفين
en: and if your lord had willed, he could have made mankind one community; but they will not cease to differ

arNorm: الا من رحم ربكۚ ولذلك خلقهمۡۗ وتمتۡ كلمه ربك لامۡلان جهنم من الۡجنه والناس اجۡمعين
en: except whom your lord has given mercy, and for that he created them. but the word of your lord is to be fulfilled that, "i will surely fill hell with jinn and men all together

arNorm: وكلا نقص عليۡك منۡ انۢباء الرسل ما نثبت بهۦ فؤادكۚ وجاءك في هذه الۡحق وموۡعظه وذكۡري للۡمؤۡمنين
en: and each [story] we relate to you from the news of the messengers is that by which we make firm your heart. and there has come to you, in this, the truth and an instruction and a reminder for the believers

arNorm: وقل للذين لا يؤۡمنون اعۡملوا علي مكانتكمۡ انا عملون
en: and say to those who do not believe, "work according to your position; indeed, we are working

arNorm: وانتظروا انا منتظرون
en: and wait, indeed, we are waiting

arNorm: ولله غيۡب السموت والۡارۡض واليۡه يرۡجع الۡامۡر كلهۥ فاعۡبدۡه وتوكلۡ عليۡهۚ وما ربك بغفل عما تعۡملون
en: and to allah belong the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth and to him will be returned the matter, all of it, so worship him and rely upon him. and your lord is not unaware of that which you do

arNorm: الرۚ تلۡك ءايت الۡكتب الۡمبين
en: alif, lam, ra. these are the verses of the clear book

arNorm: انا انزلۡنه قرۡءنا عربيا لعلكمۡ تعۡقلون
en: indeed, we have sent it down as an arabic qur'an that you might understand

arNorm: نحۡن نقص عليۡك احۡسن الۡقصص بما اوۡحيۡنا اليۡك هذا الۡقرۡءان وان كنت من قبۡلهۦ لمن الۡغفلين
en: we relate to you, [o muhammad], the best of stories in what we have revealed to you of this qur'an although you were, before it, among the unaware

arNorm: اذۡ قال يوسف لابيه يابت اني رايۡت احد عشر كوۡكبا والشمۡس والۡقمر رايۡتهمۡ لي سجدين
en: [of these stories mention] when joseph said to his father, "o my father, indeed i have seen [in a dream] eleven stars and the sun and the moon; i saw them prostrating to me

arNorm: قال يبني لا تقۡصصۡ رءۡياك علي اخۡوتك فيكيدوا لك كيۡداۖ ان الشيۡطن للۡانسن عدو مبين
en: he said, "o my son, do not relate your vision to your brothers or they will contrive against you a plan. indeed satan, to man, is a manifest enemy

arNorm: وكذلك يجۡتبيك ربك ويعلمك من تاۡويل الۡاحاديث ويتم نعۡمتهۥ عليۡك وعلي ءال يعۡقوب كما اتمها علي ابويۡك من قبۡل ابۡرهيم واسۡحقۚ ان ربك عليم حكيم
en: and thus will your lord choose you and teach you the interpretation of narratives and complete his favor upon you and upon the family of jacob, as he completed it upon your fathers before, abraham and isaac. indeed, your lord is knowing and wise

arNorm: ۞لقدۡ كان في يوسف واخۡوتهۦ ءايت للسائلين
en: certainly were there in joseph and his brothers signs for those who ask

arNorm: اذۡ قالوا ليوسف واخوه احب الي ابينا منا ونحۡن عصۡبه ان ابانا لفي ضلل مبين
en: when they said, "joseph and his brother are more beloved to our father than we, while we are a clan. indeed, our father is in clear error

arNorm: اقۡتلوا يوسف او اطۡرحوه ارۡضا يخۡل لكمۡ وجۡه ابيكمۡ وتكونوا منۢ بعۡدهۦ قوۡما صلحين
en: kill joseph or cast him out to [another] land; the countenance of your father will [then] be only for you, and you will be after that a righteous people

arNorm: قال قائل منۡهمۡ لا تقۡتلوا يوسف والۡقوه في غيبت الۡجب يلۡتقطۡه بعۡض السياره ان كنتمۡ فعلين
en: said a speaker among them, "do not kill joseph but throw him into the bottom of the well; some travelers will pick him up - if you would do [something]

arNorm: قالوا يابانا ما لك لا تاۡم۬نا علي يوسف وانا لهۥ لنصحون
en: they said, "o our father, why do you not entrust us with joseph while indeed, we are to him sincere counselors

arNorm: ارۡسلۡه معنا غدا يرۡتعۡ ويلۡعبۡ وانا لهۥ لحفظون
en: send him with us tomorrow that he may eat well and play. and indeed, we will be his guardians

arNorm: قال اني ليحۡزنني ان تذۡهبوا بهۦ واخاف ان ياۡكله الذئۡب وانتمۡ عنۡه غفلون
en: [jacob] said, "indeed, it saddens me that you should take him, and i fear that a wolf would eat him while you are of him unaware

arNorm: قالوا لئنۡ اكله الذئۡب ونحۡن عصۡبه انا اذا لخسرون
en: they said, "if a wolf should eat him while we are a [strong] clan, indeed, we would then be losers

arNorm: فلما ذهبوا بهۦ واجۡمعوا ان يجۡعلوه في غيبت الۡجبۚ واوۡحيۡنا اليۡه لتنبئنهم بامۡرهمۡ هذا وهمۡ لا يشۡعرون
en: so when they took him [out] and agreed to put him into the bottom of the well... but we inspired to him, "you will surely inform them [someday] about this affair of theirs while they do not perceive [your identity]

arNorm: وجاءو اباهمۡ عشاء يبۡكون
en: and they came to their father at night, weeping

arNorm: قالوا يابانا انا ذهبۡنا نسۡتبق وتركۡنا يوسف عند متعنا فاكله الذئۡبۖ وما انت بمؤۡمن لنا ولوۡ كنا صدقين
en: they said, "o our father, indeed we went racing each other and left joseph with our possessions, and a wolf ate him. but you would not believe us, even if we were truthful

arNorm: وجاءو علي قميصهۦ بدم كذبۚ قال بلۡ سولتۡ لكمۡ انفسكمۡ امۡراۖ فصبۡر جميلۖ والله الۡمسۡتعان علي ما تصفون
en: and they brought upon his shirt false blood. [jacob] said, "rather, your souls have enticed you to something, so patience is most fitting. and allah is the one sought for help against that which you describe

arNorm: وجاءتۡ سياره فارۡسلوا واردهمۡ فادۡلي دلۡوهۥۖ قال يبشۡري هذا غلمۚ واسروه بضعهۚ والله عليمۢ بما يعۡملون
en: and there came a company of travelers; then they sent their water drawer, and he let down his bucket. he said, "good news! here is a boy." and they concealed him, [taking him] as merchandise; and allah was knowing of what they did

arNorm: وشروۡه بثمنۭ بخۡس درهم معۡدوده وكانوا فيه من الزهدين
en: and they sold him for a reduced price - a few dirhams - and they were, concerning him, of those content with little

arNorm: وقال الذي اشۡتريه من مصۡر لامۡراتهۦ اكۡرمي مثۡويه عسي ان ينفعنا اوۡ نتخذهۥ ولداۚ وكذلك مكنا ليوسف في الۡارۡض ولنعلمهۥ من تاۡويل الۡاحاديثۚ والله غالب علي امۡرهۦ ولكن اكۡثر الناس لا يعۡلمون
en: and the one from egypt who bought him said to his wife, "make his residence comfortable. perhaps he will benefit us, or we will adopt him as a son." and thus, we established joseph in the land that we might teach him the interpretation of events. and allah is predominant over his affair, but most of the people do not know

arNorm: ولما بلغ اشدهۥ ءاتيۡنه حكۡما وعلۡماۚ وكذلك نجۡزي الۡمحۡسنين
en: and when joseph reached maturity, we gave him judgment and knowledge. and thus we reward the doers of good

arNorm: ورودتۡه التي هو في بيۡتها عن نفۡسهۦ وغلقت الۡابۡوب وقالتۡ هيۡت لكۚ قال معاذ اللهۖ انهۥ ربي احۡسن مثۡوايۖ انهۥ لا يفۡلح الظلمون
en: and she, in whose house he was, sought to seduce him. she closed the doors and said, "come, you." he said, "[i seek] the refuge of allah. indeed, he is my master, who has made good my residence. indeed, wrongdoers will not succeed

arNorm: ولقدۡ همتۡ بهۦۖ وهم بها لوۡلا ان رءا برۡهن ربهۦۚ كذلك لنصۡرف عنۡه السوء والۡفحۡشاءۚ انهۥ منۡ عبادنا الۡمخۡلصين
en: and she certainly determined [to seduce] him, and he would have inclined to her had he not seen the proof of his lord. and thus [it was] that we should avert from him evil and immorality. indeed, he was of our chosen servants

arNorm: واسۡتبقا الۡباب وقدتۡ قميصهۥ من دبر والۡفيا سيدها لدا الۡبابۚ قالتۡ ما جزاء منۡ اراد باهۡلك سوءا الا ان يسۡجن اوۡ عذاب اليم
en: and they both raced to the door, and she tore his shirt from the back, and they found her husband at the door. she said, "what is the recompense of one who intended evil for your wife but that he be imprisoned or a painful punishment

arNorm: قال هي رودتۡني عن نفۡسيۚ وشهد شاهد منۡ اهۡلها ان كان قميصهۥ قد من قبل فصدقتۡ وهو من الۡكذبين
en: [joseph] said, "it was she who sought to seduce me." and a witness from her family testified. "if his shirt is torn from the front, then she has told the truth, and he is of the liars

arNorm: وان كان قميصهۥ قد من دبر فكذبتۡ وهو من الصدقين
en: but if his shirt is torn from the back, then she has lied, and he is of the truthful

arNorm: فلما رءا قميصهۥ قد من دبر قال انهۥ من كيۡدكنۖ ان كيۡدكن عظيم
en: so when her husband saw his shirt torn from the back, he said, "indeed, it is of the women's plan. indeed, your plan is great

arNorm: يوسف اعۡرضۡ عنۡ هذاۚ واسۡتغۡفري لذنۢبكۖ انك كنت من الۡخاطين
en: joseph, ignore this. and, [my wife], ask forgiveness for your sin. indeed, you were of the sinful

arNorm: ۞وقال نسۡوه في الۡمدينه امۡرات الۡعزيز ترود فتيها عن نفۡسهۦۖ قدۡ شغفها حباۖ انا لنريها في ضلل مبين
en: and women in the city said, "the wife of al-'azeez is seeking to seduce her slave boy; he has impassioned her with love. indeed, we see her [to be] in clear error

arNorm: فلما سمعتۡ بمكۡرهن ارۡسلتۡ اليۡهن واعۡتدتۡ لهن متكا وءاتتۡ كل وحده منۡهن سكينا وقالت اخۡرجۡ عليۡهنۖ فلما رايۡنهۥ اكۡبرۡنهۥ وقطعۡن ايۡديهن وقلۡن حش لله ما هذا بشرا انۡ هذا الا ملك كريم
en: so when she heard of their scheming, she sent for them and prepared for them a banquet and gave each one of them a knife and said [to joseph], "come out before them." and when they saw him, they greatly admired him and cut their hands and said, "perfect is allah! this is not a man; this is none but a noble angel

arNorm: قالتۡ فذلكن الذي لمۡتنني فيهۖ ولقدۡ رودتهۥ عن نفۡسهۦ فاسۡتعۡصمۖ ولئن لمۡ يفۡعلۡ ما ءامرهۥ ليسۡجنن وليكونا من الصغرين
en: she said, "that is the one about whom you blamed me. and i certainly sought to seduce him, but he firmly refused; and if he will not do what i order him, he will surely be imprisoned and will be of those debased

arNorm: قال رب السجۡن احب الي مما يدۡعونني اليۡهۖ والا تصۡرفۡ عني كيۡدهن اصۡب اليۡهن واكن من الۡجهلين
en: he said, "my lord, prison is more to my liking than that to which they invite me. and if you do not avert from me their plan, i might incline toward them and [thus] be of the ignorant

arNorm: فاسۡتجاب لهۥ ربهۥ فصرف عنۡه كيۡدهنۚ انهۥ هو السميع الۡعليم
en: so his lord responded to him and averted from him their plan. indeed, he is the hearing, the knowing

arNorm: ثم بدا لهم منۢ بعۡد ما راوا الۡايت ليسۡجننهۥ حتي حين
en: then it appeared to them after they had seen the signs that al-'azeez should surely imprison him for a time

arNorm: ودخل معه السجۡن فتيانۖ قال احدهما اني اريني اعۡصر خمۡراۖ وقال الۡاخر اني اريني احۡمل فوۡق راۡسي خبۡزا تاۡكل الطيۡر منۡهۖ نبئۡنا بتاۡويلهۦۖ انا نريك من الۡمحۡسنين
en: and there entered the prison with him two young men. one of them said, "indeed, i have seen myself [in a dream] pressing wine." the other said, "indeed, i have seen myself carrying upon my head [some] bread, from which the birds were eating. inform us of its interpretation; indeed, we see you to be of those who do good

arNorm: قال لا ياۡتيكما طعام ترۡزقانهۦ الا نباۡتكما بتاۡويلهۦ قبۡل ان ياۡتيكماۚ ذلكما مما علمني ربيۚ اني تركۡت مله قوۡم لا يؤۡمنون بالله وهم بالۡاخره همۡ كفرون
en: he said, "you will not receive food that is provided to you except that i will inform you of its interpretation before it comes to you. that is from what my lord has taught me. indeed, i have left the religion of a people who do not believe in allah, and they, in the hereafter, are disbelievers

arNorm: واتبعۡت مله ءاباءي ابۡرهيم واسۡحق ويعۡقوبۚ ما كان لنا ان نشۡرك بالله من شيۡءۚ ذلك من فضۡل الله عليۡنا وعلي الناس ولكن اكۡثر الناس لا يشۡكرون
en: and i have followed the religion of my fathers, abraham, isaac and jacob. and it was not for us to associate anything with allah. that is from the favor of allah upon us and upon the people, but most of the people are not grateful

arNorm: يصحبي السجۡن ءارۡباب متفرقون خيۡر ام الله الۡوحد الۡقهار
en: o [my] two companions of prison, are separate lords better or allah, the one, the prevailing

arNorm: ما تعۡبدون من دونهۦ الا اسۡماء سميۡتموها انتمۡ وءاباؤكم ما انزل الله بها من سلۡطنۚ ان الۡحكۡم الا لله امر الا تعۡبدوا الا اياهۚ ذلك الدين الۡقيم ولكن اكۡثر الناس لا يعۡلمون
en: you worship not besides him except [mere] names you have named them, you and your fathers, for which allah has sent down no authority. legislation is not but for allah. he has commanded that you worship not except him. that is the correct religion, but most of the people do not know

arNorm: يصحبي السجۡن اما احدكما فيسۡقي ربهۥ خمۡراۖ واما الۡاخر فيصۡلب فتاۡكل الطيۡر من راۡسهۦۚ قضي الۡامۡر الذي فيه تسۡتفۡتيان
en: o two companions of prison, as for one of you, he will give drink to his master of wine; but as for the other, he will be crucified, and the birds will eat from his head. the matter has been decreed about which you both inquire

arNorm: وقال للذي ظن انهۥ ناج منۡهما اذۡكرۡني عند ربك فانسيه الشيۡطن ذكۡر ربهۦ فلبث في السجۡن بضۡع سنين
en: and he said to the one whom he knew would go free, "mention me before your master." but satan made him forget the mention [to] his master, and joseph remained in prison several years

arNorm: وقال الۡملك اني اري سبۡع بقرت سمان ياۡكلهن سبۡع عجاف وسبۡع سنۢبلت خضۡر واخر يابستۖ يايها الۡملا افۡتوني في رءۡيي ان كنتمۡ للرءۡيا تعۡبرون
en: and [subsequently] the king said, "indeed, i have seen [in a dream] seven fat cows being eaten by seven [that were] lean, and seven green spikes [of grain] and others [that were] dry. o eminent ones, explain to me my vision, if you should interpret visions

arNorm: قالوا اضۡغث احۡلمۖ وما نحۡن بتاۡويل الۡاحۡلم بعلمين
en: they said, "[it is but] a mixture of false dreams, and we are not learned in the interpretation of dreams

arNorm: وقال الذي نجا منۡهما وادكر بعۡد امه انا۠ انبئكم بتاۡويلهۦ فارۡسلون
en: but the one who was freed and remembered after a time said, "i will inform you of its interpretation, so send me forth

arNorm: يوسف ايها الصديق افۡتنا في سبۡع بقرت سمان ياۡكلهن سبۡع عجاف وسبۡع سنۢبلت خضۡر واخر يابست لعلي ارۡجع الي الناس لعلهمۡ يعۡلمون
en: [he said], "joseph, o man of truth, explain to us about seven fat cows eaten by seven [that were] lean, and seven green spikes [of grain] and others [that were] dry - that i may return to the people; perhaps they will know [about you]

arNorm: قال تزۡرعون سبۡع سنين دابا فما حصدتمۡ فذروه في سنۢبلهۦ الا قليلا مما تاۡكلون
en: [joseph] said, "you will plant for seven years consecutively; and what you harvest leave in its spikes, except a little from which you will eat

arNorm: ثم ياۡتي منۢ بعۡد ذلك سبۡع شداد ياۡكلۡن ما قدمۡتمۡ لهن الا قليلا مما تحۡصنون
en: then will come after that seven difficult [years] which will consume what you saved for them, except a little from which you will store

arNorm: ثم ياۡتي منۢ بعۡد ذلك عام فيه يغاث الناس وفيه يعۡصرون
en: then will come after that a year in which the people will be given rain and in which they will press [olives and grapes]

arNorm: وقال الۡملك ائۡتوني بهۦۖ فلما جاءه الرسول قال ارۡجعۡ الي ربك فسۡلۡه ما بال النسۡوه التي قطعۡن ايۡديهنۚ ان ربي بكيۡدهن عليم
en: and the king said, "bring him to me." but when the messenger came to him, [joseph] said, "return to your master and ask him what is the case of the women who cut their hands. indeed, my lord is knowing of their plan

arNorm: قال ما خطۡبكن اذۡ رودتن يوسف عن نفۡسهۦۚ قلۡن حش لله ما علمۡنا عليۡه من سوءۚ قالت امۡرات الۡعزيز الۡن حصۡحص الۡحق انا۠ رودتهۥ عن نفۡسهۦ وانهۥ لمن الصدقين
en: said [the king to the women], "what was your condition when you sought to seduce joseph?" they said, "perfect is allah! we know about him no evil." the wife of al-'azeez said, "now the truth has become evident. it was i who sought to seduce him, and indeed, he is of the truthful

arNorm: ذلك ليعۡلم اني لمۡ اخنۡه بالۡغيۡب وان الله لا يهۡدي كيۡد الۡخائنين
en: that is so al-'azeez will know that i did not betray him in [his] absence and that allah does not guide the plan of betrayers

arNorm: ۞وما ابرئ نفۡسيۚ ان النفۡس لامارهۢ بالسوء الا ما رحم ربيۚ ان ربي غفور رحيم
en: and i do not acquit myself. indeed, the soul is a persistent enjoiner of evil, except those upon which my lord has mercy. indeed, my lord is forgiving and merciful

arNorm: وقال الۡملك ائۡتوني بهۦ اسۡتخۡلصۡه لنفۡسيۖ فلما كلمهۥ قال انك الۡيوۡم لديۡنا مكين امين
en: and the king said, "bring him to me; i will appoint him exclusively for myself." and when he spoke to him, he said, "indeed, you are today established [in position] and trusted

arNorm: قال اجۡعلۡني علي خزائن الۡارۡضۖ اني حفيظ عليم
en: [joseph] said, "appoint me over the storehouses of the land. indeed, i will be a knowing guardian

arNorm: وكذلك مكنا ليوسف في الۡارۡض يتبوا منۡها حيۡث يشاءۚ نصيب برحۡمتنا من نشاءۖ ولا نضيع اجۡر الۡمحۡسنين
en: and thus we established joseph in the land to settle therein wherever he willed. we touch with our mercy whom we will, and we do not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good

arNorm: ولاجۡر الۡاخره خيۡر للذين ءامنوا وكانوا يتقون
en: and the reward of the hereafter is better for those who believed and were fearing allah

arNorm: وجاء اخۡوه يوسف فدخلوا عليۡه فعرفهمۡ وهمۡ لهۥ منكرون
en: and the brothers of joseph came [seeking food], and they entered upon him; and he recognized them, but he was to them unknown

arNorm: ولما جهزهم بجهازهمۡ قال ائۡتوني باخ لكم منۡ ابيكمۡۚ الا تروۡن اني اوفي الۡكيۡل وانا۠ خيۡر الۡمنزلين
en: and when he had furnished them with their supplies, he said, "bring me a brother of yours from your father. do not you see that i give full measure and that i am the best of accommodators

arNorm: فان لمۡ تاۡتوني بهۦ فلا كيۡل لكمۡ عندي ولا تقۡربون
en: but if you do not bring him to me, no measure will there be [hereafter] for you from me, nor will you approach me

arNorm: قالوا سنرود عنۡه اباه وانا لفعلون
en: they said, "we will attempt to dissuade his father from [keeping] him, and indeed, we will do [it]

arNorm: وقال لفتۡينه اجۡعلوا بضعتهمۡ في رحالهمۡ لعلهمۡ يعۡرفونها اذا انقلبوا الي اهۡلهمۡ لعلهمۡ يرۡجعون
en: and [joseph] said to his servants, "put their merchandise into their saddlebags so they might recognize it when they have gone back to their people that perhaps they will [again] return

arNorm: فلما رجعوا الي ابيهمۡ قالوا يابانا منع منا الۡكيۡل فارۡسلۡ معنا اخانا نكۡتلۡ وانا لهۥ لحفظون
en: so when they returned to their father, they said, "o our father, [further] measure has been denied to us, so send with us our brother [that] we will be given measure. and indeed, we will be his guardians

arNorm: قال هلۡ ءامنكمۡ عليۡه الا كما امنتكمۡ علي اخيه من قبۡل فالله خيۡر حفظاۖ وهو ارۡحم الرحمين
en: he said, "should i entrust you with him except [under coercion] as i entrusted you with his brother before? but allah is the best guardian, and he is the most merciful of the merciful

arNorm: ولما فتحوا متعهمۡ وجدوا بضعتهمۡ ردتۡ اليۡهمۡۖ قالوا يابانا ما نبۡغيۖ هذهۦ بضعتنا ردتۡ اليۡناۖ ونمير اهۡلنا ونحۡفظ اخانا ونزۡداد كيۡل بعيرۖ ذلك كيۡل يسير
en: and when they opened their baggage, they found their merchandise returned to them. they said, "o our father, what [more] could we desire? this is our merchandise returned to us. and we will obtain supplies for our family and protect our brother and obtain an increase of a camel's load; that is an easy measurement

arNorm: قال لنۡ ارۡسلهۥ معكمۡ حتي تؤۡتون موۡثقا من الله لتاۡتنني بهۦ الا ان يحاط بكمۡۖ فلما ءاتوۡه موۡثقهمۡ قال الله علي ما نقول وكيل
en: [jacob] said, "never will i send him with you until you give me a promise by allah that you will bring him [back] to me, unless you should be surrounded by enemies." and when they had given their promise, he said, "allah, over what we say, is witness

arNorm: وقال يبني لا تدۡخلوا منۢ باب وحد وادۡخلوا منۡ ابۡوب متفرقهۖ وما اغۡني عنكم من الله من شيۡءۖ ان الۡحكۡم الا للهۖ عليۡه توكلۡتۖ وعليۡه فلۡيتوكل الۡمتوكلون
en: and he said, "o my sons, do not enter from one gate but enter from different gates; and i cannot avail you against [the decree of] allah at all. the decision is only for allah; upon him i have relied, and upon him let those who would rely [indeed] rely

arNorm: ولما دخلوا منۡ حيۡث امرهمۡ ابوهم ما كان يغۡني عنۡهم من الله من شيۡء الا حاجه في نفۡس يعۡقوب قضيهاۚ وانهۥ لذو علۡم لما علمۡنه ولكن اكۡثر الناس لا يعۡلمون
en: and when they entered from where their father had ordered them, it did not avail them against allah at all except [it was] a need within the soul of jacob, which he satisfied. and indeed, he was a possessor of knowledge because of what we had taught him, but most of the people do not know

arNorm: ولما دخلوا علي يوسف ءاوي اليۡه اخاهۖ قال اني انا۠ اخوك فلا تبۡتئسۡ بما كانوا يعۡملون
en: and when they entered upon joseph, he took his brother to himself; he said, "indeed, i am your brother, so do not despair over what they used to do [to me]

arNorm: فلما جهزهم بجهازهمۡ جعل السقايه في رحۡل اخيه ثم اذن مؤذن ايتها الۡعير انكمۡ لسرقون
en: so when he had furnished them with their supplies, he put the [gold measuring] bowl into the bag of his brother. then an announcer called out, "o caravan, indeed you are thieves

arNorm: قالوا واقۡبلوا عليۡهم ماذا تفۡقدون
en: they said while approaching them, "what is it you are missing

arNorm: قالوا نفۡقد صواع الۡملك ولمن جاء بهۦ حمۡل بعير وانا۠ بهۦ زعيم
en: they said, "we are missing the measure of the king. and for he who produces it is [the reward of] a camel's load, and i am responsible for it

arNorm: قالوا تالله لقدۡ علمۡتم ما جئۡنا لنفۡسد في الۡارۡض وما كنا سرقين
en: they said, "by allah, you have certainly known that we did not come to cause corruption in the land, and we have not been thieves

arNorm: قالوا فما جزؤهۥ ان كنتمۡ كذبين
en: the accusers said, "then what would be its recompense if you should be liars

arNorm: قالوا جزؤهۥ من وجد في رحۡلهۦ فهو جزؤهۥۚ كذلك نجۡزي الظلمين
en: [the brothers] said, "its recompense is that he in whose bag it is found - he [himself] will be its recompense. thus do we recompense the wrongdoers

arNorm: فبدا باوۡعيتهمۡ قبۡل وعاء اخيه ثم اسۡتخۡرجها من وعاء اخيهۚ كذلك كدۡنا ليوسفۖ ما كان لياۡخذ اخاه في دين الۡملك الا ان يشاء اللهۚ نرۡفع درجت من نشاءۗ وفوۡق كل ذي علۡم عليم
en: so he began [the search] with their bags before the bag of his brother; then he extracted it from the bag of his brother. thus did we plan for joseph. he could not have taken his brother within the religion of the king except that allah willed. we raise in degrees whom we will, but over every possessor of knowledge is one [more] knowing

arNorm: ۞قالوا ان يسۡرقۡ فقدۡ سرق اخ لهۥ من قبۡلۚ فاسرها يوسف في نفۡسهۦ ولمۡ يبۡدها لهمۡۚ قال انتمۡ شر مكاناۖ والله اعۡلم بما تصفون
en: they said, "if he steals - a brother of his has stolen before." but joseph kept it within himself and did not reveal it to them. he said, "you are worse in position, and allah is most knowing of what you describe

arNorm: قالوا يايها الۡعزيز ان لهۥ ابا شيۡخا كبيرا فخذۡ احدنا مكانهۥۖ انا نريك من الۡمحۡسنين
en: they said, "o 'azeez, indeed he has a father [who is] an old man, so take one of us in place of him. indeed, we see you as a doer of good

arNorm: قال معاذ الله ان ناۡخذ الا من وجدۡنا متعنا عندهۥ انا اذا لظلمون
en: he said, "[i seek] the refuge of allah [to prevent] that we take except him with whom we found our possession. indeed, we would then be unjust

arNorm: فلما اسۡتيۡسوا منۡه خلصوا نجياۖ قال كبيرهمۡ المۡ تعۡلموا ان اباكمۡ قدۡ اخذ عليۡكم موۡثقا من الله ومن قبۡل ما فرطتمۡ في يوسفۖ فلنۡ ابۡرح الۡارۡض حتي ياۡذن لي ابي اوۡ يحۡكم الله ليۖ وهو خيۡر الۡحكمين
en: so when they had despaired of him, they secluded themselves in private consultation. the eldest of them said, "do you not know that your father has taken upon you an oath by allah and [that] before you failed in [your duty to] joseph? so i will never leave [this] land until my father permits me or allah decides for me, and he is the best of judges

arNorm: ارۡجعوا الي ابيكمۡ فقولوا يابانا ان ابۡنك سرق وما شهدۡنا الا بما علمۡنا وما كنا للۡغيۡب حفظين
en: return to your father and say, "o our father, indeed your son has stolen, and we did not testify except to what we knew. and we were not witnesses of the unseen

arNorm: وسۡل الۡقرۡيه التي كنا فيها والۡعير التي اقۡبلۡنا فيهاۖ وانا لصدقون
en: and ask the city in which we were and the caravan in which we came - and indeed, we are truthful

arNorm: قال بلۡ سولتۡ لكمۡ انفسكمۡ امۡراۖ فصبۡر جميلۖ عسي الله ان ياۡتيني بهمۡ جميعاۚ انهۥ هو الۡعليم الۡحكيم
en: [jacob] said, "rather, your souls have enticed you to something, so patience is most fitting. perhaps allah will bring them to me all together. indeed it is he who is the knowing, the wise

arNorm: وتولي عنۡهمۡ وقال ياسفي علي يوسف وابۡيضتۡ عيۡناه من الۡحزۡن فهو كظيم
en: and he turned away from them and said, "oh, my sorrow over joseph," and his eyes became white from grief, for he was [of that] a suppressor

arNorm: قالوا تالله تفۡتؤا تذۡكر يوسف حتي تكون حرضا اوۡ تكون من الۡهلكين
en: they said, "by allah, you will not cease remembering joseph until you become fatally ill or become of those who perish

arNorm: قال انما اشۡكوا بثي وحزۡني الي الله واعۡلم من الله ما لا تعۡلمون
en: he said, "i only complain of my suffering and my grief to allah, and i know from allah that which you do not know

arNorm: يبني اذۡهبوا فتحسسوا من يوسف واخيه ولا تايۡسوا من روۡح اللهۖ انهۥ لا يايۡس من روۡح الله الا الۡقوۡم الۡكفرون
en: o my sons, go and find out about joseph and his brother and despair not of relief from allah. indeed, no one despairs of relief from allah except the disbelieving people

arNorm: فلما دخلوا عليۡه قالوا يايها الۡعزيز مسنا واهۡلنا الضر وجئۡنا ببضعه مزۡجيه فاوۡف لنا الۡكيۡل وتصدقۡ عليۡناۖ ان الله يجۡزي الۡمتصدقين
en: so when they entered upon joseph, they said, "o 'azeez, adversity has touched us and our family, and we have come with goods poor in quality, but give us full measure and be charitable to us. indeed, allah rewards the charitable

arNorm: قال هلۡ علمۡتم ما فعلۡتم بيوسف واخيه اذۡ انتمۡ جهلون
en: he said, "do you know what you did with joseph and his brother when you were ignorant

arNorm: قالوا اءنك لانت يوسفۖ قال انا۠ يوسف وهذا اخيۖ قدۡ من الله عليۡناۖ انهۥ من يتق ويصۡبرۡ فان الله لا يضيع اجۡر الۡمحۡسنين
en: they said, "are you indeed joseph?" he said "i am joseph, and this is my brother. allah has certainly favored us. indeed, he who fears allah and is patient, then indeed, allah does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good

arNorm: قالوا تالله لقدۡ ءاثرك الله عليۡنا وان كنا لخطين
en: they said, "by allah, certainly has allah preferred you over us, and indeed, we have been sinners

arNorm: قال لا تثۡريب عليۡكم الۡيوۡمۖ يغۡفر الله لكمۡۖ وهو ارۡحم الرحمين
en: he said, "no blame will there be upon you today. allah will forgive you; and he is the most merciful of the merciful

arNorm: اذۡهبوا بقميصي هذا فالۡقوه علي وجۡه ابي ياۡت بصيرا واۡتوني باهۡلكمۡ اجۡمعين
en: take this, my shirt, and cast it over the face of my father; he will become seeing. and bring me your family, all together

arNorm: ولما فصلت الۡعير قال ابوهمۡ اني لاجد ريح يوسفۖ لوۡلا ان تفندون
en: and when the caravan departed [from egypt], their father said, "indeed, i find the smell of joseph [and would say that he was alive] if you did not think me weakened in mind

arNorm: قالوا تالله انك لفي ضللك الۡقديم
en: they said, "by allah, indeed you are in your [same] old error

arNorm: فلما ان جاء الۡبشير الۡقيه علي وجۡههۦ فارۡتد بصيراۖ قال المۡ اقل لكمۡ اني اعۡلم من الله ما لا تعۡلمون
en: and when the bearer of good tidings arrived, he cast it over his face, and he returned [once again] seeing. he said, "did i not tell you that i know from allah that which you do not know

arNorm: قالوا يابانا اسۡتغۡفرۡ لنا ذنوبنا انا كنا خطين
en: they said, "o our father, ask for us forgiveness of our sins; indeed, we have been sinners

arNorm: قال سوۡف اسۡتغۡفر لكمۡ ربيۖ انهۥ هو الۡغفور الرحيم
en: he said, "i will ask forgiveness for you from my lord. indeed, it is he who is the forgiving, the merciful

arNorm: فلما دخلوا علي يوسف ءاوي اليۡه ابويۡه وقال ادۡخلوا مصۡر ان شاء الله ءامنين
en: and when they entered upon joseph, he took his parents to himself and said, "enter egypt, allah willing, safe [and secure]

arNorm: ورفع ابويۡه علي الۡعرۡش وخروا لهۥ سجداۖ وقال يابت هذا تاۡويل رءۡيي من قبۡل قدۡ جعلها ربي حقاۖ وقدۡ احۡسن بي اذۡ اخۡرجني من السجۡن وجاء بكم من الۡبدۡو منۢ بعۡد ان نزغ الشيۡطن بيۡني وبيۡن اخۡوتيۚ ان ربي لطيف لما يشاءۚ انهۥ هو الۡعليم الۡحكيم
en: and he raised his parents upon the throne, and they bowed to him in prostration. and he said, "o my father, this is the explanation of my vision of before. my lord has made it reality. and he was certainly good to me when he took me out of prison and brought you [here] from bedouin life after satan had induced [estrangement] between me and my brothers. indeed, my lord is subtle in what he wills. indeed, it is he who is the knowing, the wise

arNorm: ۞رب قدۡ ءاتيۡتني من الۡملۡك وعلمۡتني من تاۡويل الۡاحاديثۚ فاطر السموت والۡارۡض انت وليۦ في الدنۡيا والۡاخرهۖ توفني مسۡلما والۡحقۡني بالصلحين
en: my lord, you have given me [something] of sovereignty and taught me of the interpretation of dreams. creator of the heavens and earth, you are my protector in this world and in the hereafter. cause me to die a muslim and join me with the righteous

arNorm: ذلك منۡ انۢباء الۡغيۡب نوحيه اليۡكۖ وما كنت لديۡهمۡ اذۡ اجۡمعوا امۡرهمۡ وهمۡ يمۡكرون
en: that is from the news of the unseen which we reveal, [o muhammad], to you. and you were not with them when they put together their plan while they conspired

arNorm: وما اكۡثر الناس ولوۡ حرصۡت بمؤۡمنين
en: and most of the people, although you strive [for it], are not believers

arNorm: وما تسۡلهمۡ عليۡه منۡ اجۡرۚ انۡ هو الا ذكۡر للۡعلمين
en: and you do not ask of them for it any payment. it is not except a reminder to the worlds

arNorm: وكاين منۡ ءايه في السموت والۡارۡض يمرون عليۡها وهمۡ عنۡها معۡرضون
en: and how many a sign within the heavens and earth do they pass over while they, therefrom, are turning away

arNorm: وما يؤۡمن اكۡثرهم بالله الا وهم مشۡركون
en: and most of them believe not in allah except while they associate others with him

arNorm: افامنوا ان تاۡتيهمۡ غشيه منۡ عذاب الله اوۡ تاۡتيهم الساعه بغۡته وهمۡ لا يشۡعرون
en: then do they feel secure that there will not come to them an overwhelming [aspect] of the punishment of allah or that the hour will not come upon them suddenly while they do not perceive

arNorm: قلۡ هذهۦ سبيلي ادۡعوا الي اللهۚ علي بصيره انا۠ ومن اتبعنيۖ وسبۡحن الله وما انا۠ من الۡمشۡركين
en: say, "this is my way; i invite to allah with insight, i and those who follow me. and exalted is allah; and i am not of those who associate others with him

arNorm: وما ارۡسلۡنا من قبۡلك الا رجالا نوحي اليۡهم منۡ اهۡل الۡقريۗ افلمۡ يسيروا في الۡارۡض فينظروا كيۡف كان عقبه الذين من قبۡلهمۡۗ ولدار الۡاخره خيۡر للذين اتقوۡاۚ افلا تعۡقلون
en: and we sent not before you [as messengers] except men to whom we revealed from among the people of cities. so have they not traveled through the earth and observed how was the end of those before them? and the home of the hereafter is best for those who fear allah; then will you not reason

arNorm: حتي اذا اسۡتيۡس الرسل وظنوا انهمۡ قدۡ كذبوا جاءهمۡ نصۡرنا فنجي من نشاءۖ ولا يرد باۡسنا عن الۡقوۡم الۡمجۡرمين
en: [they continued] until, when the messengers despaired and were certain that they had been denied, there came to them our victory, and whoever we willed was saved. and our punishment cannot be repelled from the people who are criminals

arNorm: لقدۡ كان في قصصهمۡ عبۡره لاولي الۡالۡببۗ ما كان حديثا يفۡتري ولكن تصۡديق الذي بيۡن يديۡه وتفۡصيل كل شيۡء وهدي ورحۡمه لقوۡم يؤۡمنون
en: there was certainly in their stories a lesson for those of understanding. never was the qur'an a narration invented, but a confirmation of what was before it and a detailed explanation of all things and guidance and mercy for a people who believe

arNorm: المرۚ تلۡك ءايت الۡكتبۗ والذي انزل اليۡك من ربك الۡحق ولكن اكۡثر الناس لا يؤۡمنون
en: alif, lam, meem, ra. these are the verses of the book; and what has been revealed to you from your lord is the truth, but most of the people do not believe

arNorm: الله الذي رفع السموت بغيۡر عمد تروۡنهاۖ ثم اسۡتوي علي الۡعرۡشۖ وسخر الشمۡس والۡقمرۖ كل يجۡري لاجل مسميۚ يدبر الۡامۡر يفصل الۡايت لعلكم بلقاء ربكمۡ توقنون
en: it is allah who erected the heavens without pillars that you [can] see; then he established himself above the throne and made subject the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. he arranges [each] matter; he details the signs that you may, of the meeting with your lord, be certain

arNorm: وهو الذي مد الۡارۡض وجعل فيها روسي وانۡهراۖ ومن كل الثمرت جعل فيها زوۡجيۡن اثۡنيۡنۖ يغۡشي اليۡل النهارۚ ان في ذلك لايت لقوۡم يتفكرون
en: and it is he who spread the earth and placed therein firmly set mountains and rivers; and from all of the fruits he made therein two mates; he causes the night to cover the day. indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought

arNorm: وفي الۡارۡض قطع متجورت وجنت منۡ اعۡنب وزرۡع ونخيل صنۡوان وغيۡر صنۡوان يسۡقي بماء وحد ونفضل بعۡضها علي بعۡض في الۡاكلۚ ان في ذلك لايت لقوۡم يعۡقلون
en: and within the land are neighboring plots and gardens of grapevines and crops and palm trees, [growing] several from a root or otherwise, watered with one water; but we make some of them exceed others in [quality of] fruit. indeed in that are signs for a people who reason

arNorm: ۞وان تعۡجبۡ فعجب قوۡلهمۡ اءذا كنا تربا اءنا لفي خلۡق جديدۗ اولئك الذين كفروا بربهمۡۖ واولئك الۡاغۡلل في اعۡناقهمۡۖ واولئك اصۡحب النارۖ همۡ فيها خلدون
en: and if you are astonished, [o muhammad] - then astonishing is their saying, "when we are dust, will we indeed be [brought] into a new creation?" those are the ones who have disbelieved in their lord, and those will have shackles upon their necks, and those are the companions of the fire; they will abide therein eternally

arNorm: ويسۡتعۡجلونك بالسيئه قبۡل الۡحسنه وقدۡ خلتۡ من قبۡلهم الۡمثلتۗ وان ربك لذو مغۡفره للناس علي ظلۡمهمۡۖ وان ربك لشديد الۡعقاب
en: they impatiently urge you to bring about evil before good, while there has already occurred before them similar punishments [to what they demand]. and indeed, your lord is full of forgiveness for the people despite their wrongdoing, and indeed, your lord is severe in penalty

arNorm: ويقول الذين كفروا لوۡلا انزل عليۡه ءايه من ربهۦۗ انما انت منذرۖ ولكل قوۡم هاد
en: and those who disbelieved say, "why has a sign not been sent down to him from his lord?" you are only a warner, and for every people is a guide

arNorm: الله يعۡلم ما تحۡمل كل انثي وما تغيض الۡارۡحام وما تزۡدادۚ وكل شيۡء عندهۥ بمقۡدار
en: allah knows what every female carries and what the wombs lose [prematurely] or exceed. and everything with him is by due measure

arNorm: علم الۡغيۡب والشهده الۡكبير الۡمتعال
en: [he is] knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the grand, the exalted

arNorm: سواء منكم منۡ اسر الۡقوۡل ومن جهر بهۦ ومنۡ هو مسۡتخۡفۭ باليۡل وساربۢ بالنهار
en: it is the same [to him] concerning you whether one conceals [his] speech or one publicizes it and whether one is hidden by night or conspicuous [among others] by day

arNorm: لهۥ معقبت منۢ بيۡن يديۡه ومنۡ خلۡفهۦ يحۡفظونهۥ منۡ امۡر اللهۗ ان الله لا يغير ما بقوۡم حتي يغيروا ما بانفسهمۡۗ واذا اراد الله بقوۡم سوءا فلا مرد لهۥۚ وما لهم من دونهۦ من وال
en: for each one are successive [angels] before and behind him who protect him by the decree of allah. indeed, allah will not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves. and when allah intends for a people ill, there is no repelling it. and there is not for them besides him any patron

arNorm: هو الذي يريكم الۡبرۡق خوۡفا وطمعا وينشئ السحاب الثقال
en: it is he who shows you lightening, [causing] fear and aspiration, and generates the heavy clouds

arNorm: ويسبح الرعۡد بحمۡدهۦ والۡملئكه منۡ خيفتهۦ ويرۡسل الصوعق فيصيب بها من يشاء وهمۡ يجدلون في الله وهو شديد الۡمحال
