en: [moses] said, "then go. and indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'no contact.' and indeed, you have an appointment [in the hereafter] you will not fail to keep. and look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. we will surely burn it and blow it into the sea with a blast

arNorm: انما الهكم الله الذي لا اله الا هوۚ وسع كل شيۡء علۡما
en: your god is only allah, except for whom there is no deity. he has encompassed all things in knowledge

arNorm: كذلك نقص عليۡك منۡ انۢباء ما قدۡ سبقۚ وقدۡ ءاتيۡنك من لدنا ذكۡرا
en: thus, [o muhammad], we relate to you from the news of what has preceded. and we have certainly given you from us the qur'an

arNorm: منۡ اعۡرض عنۡه فانهۥ يحۡمل يوۡم الۡقيمه وزۡرا
en: whoever turns away from it - then indeed, he will bear on the day of resurrection a burden

arNorm: خلدين فيهۖ وساء لهمۡ يوۡم الۡقيمه حمۡلا
en: [abiding] eternally therein, and evil it is for them on the day of resurrection as a load

arNorm: يوۡم ينفخ في الصورۚ ونحۡشر الۡمجۡرمين يوۡمئذ زرۡقا
en: the day the horn will be blown. and we will gather the criminals, that day, blue-eyed

arNorm: يتخفتون بيۡنهمۡ ان لبثۡتمۡ الا عشۡرا
en: they will murmur among themselves, "you remained not but ten [days in the world]

arNorm: نحۡن اعۡلم بما يقولون اذۡ يقول امۡثلهمۡ طريقه ان لبثۡتمۡ الا يوۡما
en: we are most knowing of what they say when the best of them in manner will say, "you remained not but one day

arNorm: ويسۡلونك عن الۡجبال فقلۡ ينسفها ربي نسۡفا
en: and they ask you about the mountains, so say, "my lord will blow them away with a blast

arNorm: فيذرها قاعا صفۡصفا
en: and he will leave the earth a level plain

arNorm: لا تري فيها عوجا ولا امۡتا
en: you will not see therein a depression or an elevation

arNorm: يوۡمئذ يتبعون الداعي لا عوج لهۥۖ وخشعت الۡاصۡوات للرحۡمن فلا تسۡمع الا همۡسا
en: that day, everyone will follow [the call of] the caller [with] no deviation therefrom, and [all] voices will be stilled before the most merciful, so you will not hear except a whisper [of footsteps]

arNorm: يوۡمئذ لا تنفع الشفعه الا منۡ اذن له الرحۡمن ورضي لهۥ قوۡلا
en: that day, no intercession will benefit except [that of] one to whom the most merciful has given permission and has accepted his word

arNorm: يعۡلم ما بيۡن ايۡديهمۡ وما خلۡفهمۡ ولا يحيطون بهۦ علۡما
en: allah knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, but they do not encompass it in knowledge

arNorm: ۞وعنت الۡوجوه للۡحي الۡقيومۖ وقدۡ خاب منۡ حمل ظلۡما
en: and [all] faces will be humbled before the ever-living, the sustainer of existence. and he will have failed who carries injustice

arNorm: ومن يعۡملۡ من الصلحت وهو مؤۡمن فلا يخاف ظلۡما ولا هضۡما
en: but he who does of righteous deeds while he is a believer - he will neither fear injustice nor deprivation

arNorm: وكذلك انزلۡنه قرۡءانا عربيا وصرفۡنا فيه من الۡوعيد لعلهمۡ يتقون اوۡ يحۡدث لهمۡ ذكۡرا
en: and thus we have sent it down as an arabic qur'an and have diversified therein the warnings that perhaps they will avoid [sin] or it would cause them remembrance

arNorm: فتعلي الله الۡملك الۡحقۗ ولا تعۡجلۡ بالۡقرۡءان من قبۡل ان يقۡضي اليۡك وحۡيهۥۖ وقل رب زدۡني علۡما
en: so high [above all] is allah, the sovereign, the truth. and, [o muhammad], do not hasten with [recitation of] the qur'an before its revelation is completed to you, and say, "my lord, increase me in knowledge

arNorm: ولقدۡ عهدۡنا الي ءادم من قبۡل فنسي ولمۡ نجدۡ لهۥ عزۡما
en: and we had already taken a promise from adam before, but he forgot; and we found not in him determination

arNorm: واذۡ قلۡنا للۡملئكه اسۡجدوا لادم فسجدوا الا ابۡليس ابي
en: and [mention] when we said to the angels, "prostrate to adam," and they prostrated, except iblees; he refused

arNorm: فقلۡنا يادم ان هذا عدو لك ولزوۡجك فلا يخۡرجنكما من الۡجنه فتشۡقي
en: so we said, "o adam, indeed this is an enemy to you and to your wife. then let him not remove you from paradise so you would suffer

arNorm: ان لك الا تجوع فيها ولا تعۡري
en: indeed, it is [promised] for you not to be hungry therein or be unclothed

arNorm: وانك لا تظۡمؤا فيها ولا تضۡحي
en: and indeed, you will not be thirsty therein or be hot from the sun

arNorm: فوسۡوس اليۡه الشيۡطن قال يادم هلۡ ادلك علي شجره الۡخلۡد وملۡك لا يبۡلي
en: then satan whispered to him; he said, "o adam, shall i direct you to the tree of eternity and possession that will not deteriorate

arNorm: فاكلا منۡها فبدتۡ لهما سوۡءتهما وطفقا يخۡصفان عليۡهما من ورق الۡجنهۚ وعصي ءادم ربهۥ فغوي
en: and adam and his wife ate of it, and their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten over themselves from the leaves of paradise. and adam disobeyed his lord and erred

arNorm: ثم اجۡتبه ربهۥ فتاب عليۡه وهدي
en: then his lord chose him and turned to him in forgiveness and guided [him]

arNorm: قال اهۡبطا منۡها جميعۢاۖ بعۡضكمۡ لبعۡض عدوۖ فاما ياۡتينكم مني هدي فمن اتبع هداي فلا يضل ولا يشۡقي
en: [allah] said, "descend from paradise - all, [your descendants] being enemies to one another. and if there should come to you guidance from me - then whoever follows my guidance will neither go astray [in the world] nor suffer [in the hereafter]

arNorm: ومنۡ اعۡرض عن ذكۡري فان لهۥ معيشه ضنكا ونحۡشرهۥ يوۡم الۡقيمه اعۡمي
en: and whoever turns away from my remembrance - indeed, he will have a depressed life, and we will gather him on the day of resurrection blind

arNorm: قال رب لم حشرۡتني اعۡمي وقدۡ كنت بصيرا
en: he will say, "my lord, why have you raised me blind while i was [once] seeing

arNorm: قال كذلك اتتۡك ءايتنا فنسيتهاۖ وكذلك الۡيوۡم تنسي
en: [allah] will say, "thus did our signs come to you, and you forgot them; and thus will you this day be forgotten

arNorm: وكذلك نجۡزي منۡ اسۡرف ولمۡ يؤۡمنۢ بايت ربهۦۚ ولعذاب الۡاخره اشد وابۡقي
en: and thus do we recompense he who transgressed and did not believe in the signs of his lord. and the punishment of the hereafter is more severe and more enduring

arNorm: افلمۡ يهۡد لهمۡ كمۡ اهۡلكۡنا قبۡلهم من الۡقرون يمۡشون في مسكنهمۡۚ ان في ذلك لايت لاولي النهي
en: then, has it not become clear to them how many generations we destroyed before them as they walk among their dwellings? indeed in that are signs for those of intelligence

arNorm: ولوۡلا كلمه سبقتۡ من ربك لكان لزاما واجل مسمي
en: and if not for a word that preceded from your lord, punishment would have been an obligation [due immediately], and [if not for] a specified term [decreed]

arNorm: فاصۡبرۡ علي ما يقولون وسبحۡ بحمۡد ربك قبۡل طلوع الشمۡس وقبۡل غروبهاۖ ومنۡ ءاناي اليۡل فسبحۡ واطۡراف النهار لعلك ترۡضي
en: so be patient over what they say and exalt [allah] with praise of your lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting; and during periods of the night [exalt him] and at the ends of the day, that you may be satisfied

arNorm: ولا تمدن عيۡنيۡك الي ما متعۡنا بهۦ ازۡوجا منۡهمۡ زهۡره الۡحيوه الدنۡيا لنفۡتنهمۡ فيهۚ ورزۡق ربك خيۡر وابۡقي
en: and do not extend your eyes toward that by which we have given enjoyment to [some] categories of them, [its being but] the splendor of worldly life by which we test them. and the provision of your lord is better and more enduring

arNorm: واۡمرۡ اهۡلك بالصلوه واصۡطبرۡ عليۡهاۖ لا نسۡلك رزۡقاۖ نحۡن نرۡزقكۗ والۡعقبه للتقۡوي
en: and enjoin prayer upon your family [and people] and be steadfast therein. we ask you not for provision; we provide for you, and the [best] outcome is for [those of] righteousness

arNorm: وقالوا لوۡلا ياۡتينا بايه من ربهۦۚ اولمۡ تاۡتهم بينه ما في الصحف الۡاولي
en: and they say, "why does he not bring us a sign from his lord?" has there not come to them evidence of what was in the former scriptures

arNorm: ولوۡ انا اهۡلكۡنهم بعذاب من قبۡلهۦ لقالوا ربنا لوۡلا ارۡسلۡت اليۡنا رسولا فنتبع ءايتك من قبۡل ان نذل ونخۡزي
en: and if we had destroyed them with a punishment before him, they would have said, "our lord, why did you not send to us a messenger so we could have followed your verses before we were humiliated and disgraced

arNorm: قلۡ كل متربص فتربصواۖ فستعۡلمون منۡ اصۡحب الصرط السوي ومن اهۡتدي
en: say, "each [of us] is waiting; so wait. for you will know who are the companions of the sound path and who is guided

arNorm: اقۡترب للناس حسابهمۡ وهمۡ في غفۡله معۡرضون
en: [the time of] their account has approached for the people, while they are in heedlessness turning away

arNorm: ما ياۡتيهم من ذكۡر من ربهم محۡدث الا اسۡتمعوه وهمۡ يلۡعبون
en: no mention comes to them anew from their lord except that they listen to it while they are at play

arNorm: لاهيه قلوبهمۡۗ واسروا النجۡوي الذين ظلموا هلۡ هذا الا بشر مثۡلكمۡۖ افتاۡتون السحۡر وانتمۡ تبۡصرون
en: with their hearts distracted. and those who do wrong conceal their private conversation, [saying], "is this [prophet] except a human being like you? so would you approach magic while you are aware [of it]

arNorm: قال ربي يعۡلم الۡقوۡل في السماء والۡارۡضۖ وهو السميع الۡعليم
en: the prophet said, "my lord knows whatever is said throughout the heaven and earth, and he is the hearing, the knowing

arNorm: بلۡ قالوا اضۡغث احۡلمۭ بل افۡتريه بلۡ هو شاعر فلۡياۡتنا بايه كما ارۡسل الۡاولون
en: but they say, "[the revelation is but] a mixture of false dreams; rather, he has invented it; rather, he is a poet. so let him bring us a sign just as the previous [messengers] were sent [with miracles]

arNorm: ما ءامنتۡ قبۡلهم من قرۡيه اهۡلكۡنهاۖ افهمۡ يؤۡمنون
en: not a [single] city which we destroyed believed before them, so will they believe

arNorm: وما ارۡسلۡنا قبۡلك الا رجالا نوحي اليۡهمۡۖ فسۡلوا اهۡل الذكۡر ان كنتمۡ لا تعۡلمون
en: and we sent not before you, [o muhammad], except men to whom we revealed [the message], so ask the people of the message if you do not know

arNorm: وما جعلۡنهمۡ جسدا لا ياۡكلون الطعام وما كانوا خلدين
en: and we did not make the prophets forms not eating food, nor were they immortal [on earth]

arNorm: ثم صدقۡنهم الۡوعۡد فانجيۡنهمۡ ومن نشاء واهۡلكۡنا الۡمسۡرفين
en: then we fulfilled for them the promise, and we saved them and whom we willed and destroyed the transgressors

arNorm: لقدۡ انزلۡنا اليۡكمۡ كتبا فيه ذكۡركمۡۚ افلا تعۡقلون
en: we have certainly sent down to you a book in which is your mention. then will you not reason

arNorm: وكمۡ قصمۡنا من قرۡيه كانتۡ ظالمه وانشاۡنا بعۡدها قوۡما ءاخرين
en: and how many a city which was unjust have we shattered and produced after it another people

arNorm: فلما احسوا باۡسنا اذا هم منۡها يرۡكضون
en: and when its inhabitants perceived our punishment, at once they fled from it

arNorm: لا ترۡكضوا وارۡجعوا الي ما اتۡرفۡتمۡ فيه ومسكنكمۡ لعلكمۡ تسۡلون
en: [some angels said], "do not flee but return to where you were given luxury and to your homes - perhaps you will be questioned

arNorm: قالوا يويۡلنا انا كنا ظلمين
en: they said, "o woe to us! indeed, we were wrongdoers

arNorm: فما زالت تلۡك دعۡويهمۡ حتي جعلۡنهمۡ حصيدا خمدين
en: and that declaration of theirs did not cease until we made them [as] a harvest [mowed down], extinguished [like a fire]

arNorm: وما خلقۡنا السماء والۡارۡض وما بيۡنهما لعبين
en: and we did not create the heaven and earth and that between them in play

arNorm: لوۡ اردۡنا ان نتخذ لهۡوا لاتخذۡنه من لدنا ان كنا فعلين
en: had we intended to take a diversion, we could have taken it from [what is] with us - if [indeed] we were to do so

arNorm: بلۡ نقۡذف بالۡحق علي الۡبطل فيدۡمغهۥ فاذا هو زاهقۚ ولكم الۡويۡل مما تصفون
en: rather, we dash the truth upon falsehood, and it destroys it, and thereupon it departs. and for you is destruction from that which you describe

arNorm: ولهۥ من في السموت والۡارۡضۚ ومنۡ عندهۥ لا يسۡتكۡبرون عنۡ عبادتهۦ ولا يسۡتحۡسرون
en: to him belongs whoever is in the heavens and the earth. and those near him are not prevented by arrogance from his worship, nor do they tire

arNorm: يسبحون اليۡل والنهار لا يفۡترون
en: they exalt [him] night and day [and] do not slacken

arNorm: ام اتخذوا ءالهه من الۡارۡض همۡ ينشرون
en: or have men taken for themselves gods from the earth who resurrect [the dead]

arNorm: لوۡ كان فيهما ءالهه الا الله لفسدتاۚ فسبۡحن الله رب الۡعرۡش عما يصفون
en: had there been within the heavens and earth gods besides allah, they both would have been ruined. so exalted is allah, lord of the throne, above what they describe

arNorm: لا يسۡل عما يفۡعل وهمۡ يسۡلون
en: he is not questioned about what he does, but they will be questioned

arNorm: ام اتخذوا من دونهۦ ءالههۖ قلۡ هاتوا برۡهنكمۡۖ هذا ذكۡر من معي وذكۡر من قبۡليۚ بلۡ اكۡثرهمۡ لا يعۡلمون الۡحقۖ فهم معۡرضون
en: or have they taken gods besides him? say, [o muhammad], "produce your proof. this [qur'an] is the message for those with me and the message of those before me." but most of them do not know the truth, so they are turning away

arNorm: وما ارۡسلۡنا من قبۡلك من رسول الا نوحي اليۡه انهۥ لا اله الا انا۠ فاعۡبدون
en: and we sent not before you any messenger except that we revealed to him that, "there is no deity except me, so worship me

arNorm: وقالوا اتخذ الرحۡمن ولداۗ سبۡحنهۥۚ بلۡ عباد مكۡرمون
en: and they say, "the most merciful has taken a son." exalted is he! rather, they are [but] honored servants

arNorm: لا يسۡبقونهۥ بالۡقوۡل وهم بامۡرهۦ يعۡملون
en: they cannot precede him in word, and they act by his command

arNorm: يعۡلم ما بيۡن ايۡديهمۡ وما خلۡفهمۡ ولا يشۡفعون الا لمن ارۡتضي وهم منۡ خشۡيتهۦ مشۡفقون
en: he knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they cannot intercede except on behalf of one whom he approves. and they, from fear of him, are apprehensive

arNorm: ۞ومن يقلۡ منۡهمۡ اني اله من دونهۦ فذلك نجۡزيه جهنمۚ كذلك نجۡزي الظلمين
en: and whoever of them should say, "indeed, i am a god besides him"- that one we would recompense with hell. thus do we recompense the wrongdoers

arNorm: اولمۡ ير الذين كفروا ان السموت والۡارۡض كانتا رتۡقا ففتقۡنهماۖ وجعلۡنا من الۡماء كل شيۡء حيۚ افلا يؤۡمنون
en: have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and we separated them and made from water every living thing? then will they not believe

arNorm: وجعلۡنا في الۡارۡض روسي ان تميد بهمۡ وجعلۡنا فيها فجاجا سبلا لعلهمۡ يهۡتدون
en: and we placed within the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with them, and we made therein [mountain] passes [as] roads that they might be guided

arNorm: وجعلۡنا السماء سقۡفا محۡفوظاۖ وهمۡ عنۡ ءايتها معۡرضون
en: and we made the sky a protected ceiling, but they, from its signs, are turning away

arNorm: وهو الذي خلق اليۡل والنهار والشمۡس والۡقمرۖ كل في فلك يسۡبحون
en: and it is he who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; all [heavenly bodies] in an orbit are swimming

arNorm: وما جعلۡنا لبشر من قبۡلك الۡخلۡدۖ افاين مت فهم الۡخلدون
en: and we did not grant to any man before you eternity [on earth]; so if you die - would they be eternal

arNorm: كل نفۡس ذائقه الۡموۡتۗ ونبۡلوكم بالشر والۡخيۡر فتۡنهۖ واليۡنا ترۡجعون
en: every soul will taste death. and we test you with evil and with good as trial; and to us you will be returned

arNorm: واذا رءاك الذين كفروا ان يتخذونك الا هزوا اهذا الذي يذۡكر ءالهتكمۡ وهم بذكۡر الرحۡمن همۡ كفرون
en: and when those who disbelieve see you, [o muhammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "is this the one who insults your gods?" and they are, at the mention of the most merciful, disbelievers

arNorm: خلق الۡانسن منۡ عجلۚ ساوريكمۡ ءايتي فلا تسۡتعۡجلون
en: man was created of haste. i will show you my signs, so do not impatiently urge me

arNorm: ويقولون متي هذا الۡوعۡد ان كنتمۡ صدقين
en: and they say, "when is this promise, if you should be truthful

arNorm: لوۡ يعۡلم الذين كفروا حين لا يكفون عن وجوههم النار ولا عن ظهورهمۡ ولا همۡ ينصرون
en: if those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not avert the fire from their faces or from their backs and they will not be aided

arNorm: بلۡ تاۡتيهم بغۡته فتبۡهتهمۡ فلا يسۡتطيعون ردها ولا همۡ ينظرون
en: rather, it will come to them unexpectedly and bewilder them, and they will not be able to repel it, nor will they be reprieved

arNorm: ولقد اسۡتهۡزئ برسل من قبۡلك فحاق بالذين سخروا منۡهم ما كانوا بهۦ يسۡتهۡزءون
en: and already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by what they used to ridicule

arNorm: قلۡ من يكۡلؤكم باليۡل والنهار من الرحۡمنۚ بلۡ همۡ عن ذكۡر ربهم معۡرضون
en: say, "who can protect you at night or by day from the most merciful?" but they are, from the remembrance of their lord, turning away

arNorm: امۡ لهمۡ ءالهه تمۡنعهم من دونناۚ لا يسۡتطيعون نصۡر انفسهمۡ ولا هم منا يصۡحبون
en: or do they have gods to defend them other than us? they are unable [even] to help themselves, nor can they be protected from us

arNorm: بلۡ متعۡنا هؤلاء وءاباءهمۡ حتي طال عليۡهم الۡعمرۗ افلا يروۡن انا ناۡتي الۡارۡض ننقصها منۡ اطۡرافهاۚ افهم الۡغلبون
en: but, [on the contrary], we have provided good things for these [disbelievers] and their fathers until life was prolonged for them. then do they not see that we set upon the land, reducing it from its borders? so it is they who will overcome

arNorm: قلۡ انما انذركم بالۡوحۡيۚ ولا يسۡمع الصم الدعاء اذا ما ينذرون
en: say, "i only warn you by revelation." but the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned

arNorm: ولئن مستۡهمۡ نفۡحه منۡ عذاب ربك ليقولن يويۡلنا انا كنا ظلمين
en: and if [as much as] a whiff of the punishment of your lord should touch them, they would surely say, "o woe to us! indeed, we have been wrongdoers

arNorm: ونضع الۡموزين الۡقسۡط ليوۡم الۡقيمه فلا تظۡلم نفۡس شيۡاۖ وان كان مثۡقال حبه منۡ خرۡدل اتيۡنا بهاۗ وكفي بنا حسبين
en: and we place the scales of justice for the day of resurrection, so no soul will be treated unjustly at all. and if there is [even] the weight of a mustard seed, we will bring it forth. and sufficient are we as accountant

arNorm: ولقدۡ ءاتيۡنا موسي وهرون الۡفرۡقان وضياء وذكۡرا للۡمتقين
en: and we had already given moses and aaron the criterion and a light and a reminder for the righteous

arNorm: الذين يخۡشوۡن ربهم بالۡغيۡب وهم من الساعه مشۡفقون
en: who fear their lord unseen, while they are of the hour apprehensive

arNorm: وهذا ذكۡر مبارك انزلۡنهۚ افانتمۡ لهۥ منكرون
en: and this [qur'an] is a blessed message which we have sent down. then are you with it unacquainted

arNorm: ۞ولقدۡ ءاتيۡنا ابۡرهيم رشۡدهۥ من قبۡل وكنا بهۦ علمين
en: and we had certainly given abraham his sound judgement before, and we were of him well-knowing

arNorm: اذۡ قال لابيه وقوۡمهۦ ما هذه التماثيل التي انتمۡ لها عكفون
en: when he said to his father and his people, "what are these statues to which you are devoted

arNorm: قالوا وجدۡنا ءاباءنا لها عبدين
en: they said, "we found our fathers worshippers of them

arNorm: قال لقدۡ كنتمۡ انتمۡ وءاباؤكمۡ في ضلل مبين
en: he said, "you were certainly, you and your fathers, in manifest error

arNorm: قالوا اجئۡتنا بالۡحق امۡ انت من اللعبين
en: they said, "have you come to us with truth, or are you of those who jest

arNorm: قال بل ربكمۡ رب السموت والۡارۡض الذي فطرهن وانا۠ علي ذلكم من الشهدين
en: he said, "[no], rather, your lord is the lord of the heavens and the earth who created them, and i, to that, am of those who testify

arNorm: وتالله لاكيدن اصۡنمكم بعۡد ان تولوا مدۡبرين
en: and [i swear] by allah, i will surely plan against your idols after you have turned and gone away

arNorm: فجعلهمۡ جذذا الا كبيرا لهمۡ لعلهمۡ اليۡه يرۡجعون
en: so he made them into fragments, except a large one among them, that they might return to it [and question]

arNorm: قالوا من فعل هذا بالهتنا انهۥ لمن الظلمين
en: they said, "who has done this to our gods? indeed, he is of the wrongdoers

arNorm: قالوا سمعۡنا فتي يذۡكرهمۡ يقال لهۥ ابۡرهيم
en: they said, "we heard a young man mention them who is called abraham

arNorm: قالوا فاۡتوا بهۦ علي اعۡين الناس لعلهمۡ يشۡهدون
en: they said, "then bring him before the eyes of the people that they may testify

arNorm: قالوا ءانت فعلۡت هذا بالهتنا يابۡرهيم
en: they said, "have you done this to our gods, o abraham

arNorm: قال بلۡ فعلهۥ كبيرهمۡ هذا فسۡلوهمۡ ان كانوا ينطقون
en: he said, "rather, this - the largest of them - did it, so ask them, if they should [be able to] speak

arNorm: فرجعوا الي انفسهمۡ فقالوا انكمۡ انتم الظلمون
en: so they returned to [blaming] themselves and said [to each other], "indeed, you are the wrongdoers

arNorm: ثم نكسوا علي رءوسهمۡ لقدۡ علمۡت ما هؤلاء ينطقون
en: then they reversed themselves, [saying], "you have already known that these do not speak

arNorm: قال افتعۡبدون من دون الله ما لا ينفعكمۡ شيۡا ولا يضركمۡ
en: he said, "then do you worship instead of allah that which does not benefit you at all or harm you

arNorm: اف لكمۡ ولما تعۡبدون من دون اللهۚ افلا تعۡقلون
en: uff to you and to what you worship instead of allah. then will you not use reason

arNorm: قالوا حرقوه وانصروا ءالهتكمۡ ان كنتمۡ فعلين
en: they said, "burn him and support your gods - if you are to act

arNorm: قلۡنا ينار كوني برۡدا وسلما علي ابۡرهيم
en: allah said, "o fire, be coolness and safety upon abraham

arNorm: وارادوا بهۦ كيۡدا فجعلۡنهم الۡاخۡسرين
en: and they intended for him harm, but we made them the greatest losers

arNorm: ونجيۡنه ولوطا الي الۡارۡض التي بركۡنا فيها للۡعلمين
en: and we delivered him and lot to the land which we had blessed for the worlds

arNorm: ووهبۡنا لهۥ اسۡحق ويعۡقوب نافلهۖ وكلا جعلۡنا صلحين
en: and we gave him isaac and jacob in addition, and all [of them] we made righteous

arNorm: وجعلۡنهمۡ ائمه يهۡدون بامۡرنا واوۡحيۡنا اليۡهمۡ فعۡل الۡخيۡرت واقام الصلوه وايتاء الزكوهۖ وكانوا لنا عبدين
en: and we made them leaders guiding by our command. and we inspired to them the doing of good deeds, establishment of prayer, and giving of zakah; and they were worshippers of us

arNorm: ولوطا ءاتيۡنه حكۡما وعلۡما ونجيۡنه من الۡقرۡيه التي كانت تعۡمل الۡخبئثۚ انهمۡ كانوا قوۡم سوۡء فسقين
en: and to lot we gave judgement and knowledge, and we saved him from the city that was committing wicked deeds. indeed, they were a people of evil, defiantly disobedient

arNorm: وادۡخلۡنه في رحۡمتناۖ انهۥ من الصلحين
en: and we admitted him into our mercy. indeed, he was of the righteous

arNorm: ونوحا اذۡ نادي من قبۡل فاسۡتجبۡنا لهۥ فنجيۡنه واهۡلهۥ من الۡكرۡب الۡعظيم
en: and [mention] noah, when he called [to allah] before [that time], so we responded to him and saved him and his family from the great flood

arNorm: ونصرۡنه من الۡقوۡم الذين كذبوا بايتناۚ انهمۡ كانوا قوۡم سوۡء فاغۡرقۡنهمۡ اجۡمعين
en: and we saved him from the people who denied our signs. indeed, they were a people of evil, so we drowned them, all together

arNorm: وداوۥد وسليۡمن اذۡ يحۡكمان في الۡحرۡث اذۡ نفشتۡ فيه غنم الۡقوۡم وكنا لحكۡمهمۡ شهدين
en: and [mention] david and solomon, when they judged concerning the field - when the sheep of a people overran it [at night], and we were witness to their judgement

arNorm: ففهمۡنها سليۡمنۚ وكلا ءاتيۡنا حكۡما وعلۡماۚ وسخرۡنا مع داوۥد الۡجبال يسبحۡن والطيۡرۚ وكنا فعلين
en: and we gave understanding of the case to solomon, and to each [of them] we gave judgement and knowledge. and we subjected the mountains to exalt [us], along with david and [also] the birds. and we were doing [that]

arNorm: وعلمۡنه صنۡعه لبوس لكمۡ لتحۡصنكم منۢ باۡسكمۡۖ فهلۡ انتمۡ شكرون
en: and we taught him the fashioning of coats of armor to protect you from your [enemy in] battle. so will you then be grateful

arNorm: ولسليۡمن الريح عاصفه تجۡري بامۡرهۦ الي الۡارۡض التي بركۡنا فيهاۚ وكنا بكل شيۡء علمين
en: and to solomon [we subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which we had blessed. and we are ever, of all things, knowing

arNorm: ومن الشيطين من يغوصون لهۥ ويعۡملون عملا دون ذلكۖ وكنا لهمۡ حفظين
en: and of the devils were those who dived for him and did work other than that. and we were of them a guardian

arNorm: ۞وايوب اذۡ نادي ربهۥ اني مسني الضر وانت ارۡحم الرحمين
en: and [mention] job, when he called to his lord, "indeed, adversity has touched me, and you are the most merciful of the merciful

arNorm: فاسۡتجبۡنا لهۥ فكشفۡنا ما بهۦ من ضرۖ وءاتيۡنه اهۡلهۥ ومثۡلهم معهمۡ رحۡمه منۡ عندنا وذكۡري للۡعبدين
en: so we responded to him and removed what afflicted him of adversity. and we gave him [back] his family and the like thereof with them as mercy from us and a reminder for the worshippers [of allah]

arNorm: واسۡمعيل وادۡريس وذا الۡكفۡلۖ كل من الصبرين
en: and [mention] ishmael and idrees and dhul-kifl; all were of the patient

arNorm: وادۡخلۡنهمۡ في رحۡمتناۖ انهم من الصلحين
en: and we admitted them into our mercy. indeed, they were of the righteous

arNorm: وذا النون اذ ذهب مغضبا فظن ان لن نقۡدر عليۡه فنادي في الظلمت ان لا اله الا انت سبۡحنك اني كنت من الظلمين
en: and [mention] the man of the fish, when he went off in anger and thought that we would not decree [anything] upon him. and he called out within the darknesses, "there is no deity except you; exalted are you. indeed, i have been of the wrongdoers

arNorm: فاسۡتجبۡنا لهۥ ونجيۡنه من الۡغمۚ وكذلك نۨجي الۡمؤۡمنين
en: so we responded to him and saved him from the distress. and thus do we save the believers

arNorm: وزكريا اذۡ نادي ربهۥ رب لا تذرۡني فرۡدا وانت خيۡر الۡورثين
en: and [mention] zechariah, when he called to his lord, "my lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while you are the best of inheritors

arNorm: فاسۡتجبۡنا لهۥ ووهبۡنا لهۥ يحۡيي واصۡلحۡنا لهۥ زوۡجهۥۚ انهمۡ كانوا يسرعون في الۡخيۡرت ويدۡعوننا رغبا ورهباۖ وكانوا لنا خشعين
en: so we responded to him, and we gave to him john, and amended for him his wife. indeed, they used to hasten to good deeds and supplicate us in hope and fear, and they were to us humbly submissive

arNorm: والتي احۡصنتۡ فرۡجها فنفخۡنا فيها من روحنا وجعلۡنها وابۡنها ءايه للۡعلمين
en: and [mention] the one who guarded her chastity, so we blew into her [garment] through our angel [gabriel], and we made her and her son a sign for the worlds

arNorm: ان هذهۦ امتكمۡ امه وحده وانا۠ ربكمۡ فاعۡبدون
en: indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and i am your lord, so worship me

arNorm: وتقطعوا امۡرهم بيۡنهمۡۖ كل اليۡنا رجعون
en: and [yet] they divided their affair among themselves, [but] all to us will return

arNorm: فمن يعۡملۡ من الصلحت وهو مؤۡمن فلا كفۡران لسعۡيهۦ وانا لهۥ كتبون
en: so whoever does righteous deeds while he is a believer - no denial will there be for his effort, and indeed we, of it, are recorders

arNorm: وحرم علي قرۡيه اهۡلكۡنها انهمۡ لا يرۡجعون
en: and there is prohibition upon [the people of] a city which we have destroyed that they will [ever] return

arNorm: حتي اذا فتحتۡ ياۡجوج وماۡجوج وهم من كل حدب ينسلون
en: until when [the dam of] gog and magog has been opened and they, from every elevation, descend

arNorm: واقۡترب الۡوعۡد الۡحق فاذا هي شخصه ابۡصر الذين كفروا يويۡلنا قدۡ كنا في غفۡله منۡ هذا بلۡ كنا ظلمين
en: and [when] the true promise has approached; then suddenly the eyes of those who disbelieved will be staring [in horror, while they say], "o woe to us; we had been unmindful of this; rather, we were wrongdoers

arNorm: انكمۡ وما تعۡبدون من دون الله حصب جهنم انتمۡ لها وردون
en: indeed, you [disbelievers] and what you worship other than allah are the firewood of hell. you will be coming to [enter] it

arNorm: لوۡ كان هؤلاء ءالهه ما وردوهاۖ وكل فيها خلدون
en: had these [false deities] been [actual] gods, they would not have come to it, but all are eternal therein

arNorm: لهمۡ فيها زفير وهمۡ فيها لا يسۡمعون
en: for them therein is heavy sighing, and they therein will not hear

arNorm: ان الذين سبقتۡ لهم منا الۡحسۡني اولئك عنۡها مبۡعدون
en: indeed, those for whom the best [reward] has preceded from us - they are from it far removed

arNorm: لا يسۡمعون حسيسهاۖ وهمۡ في ما اشۡتهتۡ انفسهمۡ خلدون
en: they will not hear its sound, while they are, in that which their souls desire, abiding eternally

arNorm: لا يحۡزنهم الۡفزع الۡاكۡبر وتتلقيهم الۡملئكه هذا يوۡمكم الذي كنتمۡ توعدون
en: they will not be grieved by the greatest terror, and the angels will meet them, [saying], "this is your day which you have been promised

arNorm: يوۡم نطۡوي السماء كطي السجل للۡكتبۚ كما بداۡنا اول خلۡق نعيدهۥۚ وعۡدا عليۡناۚ انا كنا فعلين
en: the day when we will fold the heaven like the folding of a [written] sheet for the records. as we began the first creation, we will repeat it. [that is] a promise binding upon us. indeed, we will do it

arNorm: ولقدۡ كتبۡنا في الزبور منۢ بعۡد الذكۡر ان الۡارۡض يرثها عبادي الصلحون
en: and we have already written in the book [of psalms] after the [previous] mention that the land [of paradise] is inherited by my righteous servants

arNorm: ان في هذا لبلغا لقوۡم عبدين
en: indeed, in this [qur'an] is notification for a worshipping people

arNorm: وما ارۡسلۡنك الا رحۡمه للۡعلمين
en: and we have not sent you, [o muhammad], except as a mercy to the worlds

arNorm: قلۡ انما يوحي الي انما الهكمۡ اله وحدۖ فهلۡ انتم مسۡلمون
en: say, "it is only revealed to me that your god is but one god; so will you be muslims [in submission to him]

arNorm: فان تولوۡا فقلۡ ءاذنتكمۡ علي سواءۖ وانۡ ادۡري اقريب ام بعيد ما توعدون
en: but if they turn away, then say, "i have announced to [all of] you equally. and i know not whether near or far is that which you are promised

arNorm: انهۥ يعۡلم الۡجهۡر من الۡقوۡل ويعۡلم ما تكۡتمون
en: indeed, he knows what is declared of speech, and he knows what you conceal

arNorm: وانۡ ادۡري لعلهۥ فتۡنه لكمۡ ومتع الي حين
en: and i know not; perhaps it is a trial for you and enjoyment for a time

arNorm: قل رب احۡكم بالۡحقۗ وربنا الرحۡمن الۡمسۡتعان علي ما تصفون
en: [the prophet] has said, "my lord, judge [between us] in truth. and our lord is the most merciful, the one whose help is sought against that which you describe

arNorm: يايها الناس اتقوا ربكمۡۚ ان زلۡزله الساعه شيۡء عظيم
en: o mankind, fear your lord. indeed, the convulsion of the [final] hour is a terrible thing

arNorm: يوۡم تروۡنها تذۡهل كل مرۡضعه عما ارۡضعتۡ وتضع كل ذات حمۡل حمۡلها وتري الناس سكري وما هم بسكري ولكن عذاب الله شديد
en: on the day you see it every nursing mother will be distracted from that [child] she was nursing, and every pregnant woman will abort her pregnancy, and you will see the people [appearing] intoxicated while they are not intoxicated; but the punishment of allah is severe

arNorm: ومن الناس من يجدل في الله بغيۡر علۡم ويتبع كل شيۡطن مريد
en: and of the people is he who disputes about allah without knowledge and follows every rebellious devil

arNorm: كتب عليۡه انهۥ من تولاه فانهۥ يضلهۥ ويهۡديه الي عذاب السعير
en: it has been decreed for every devil that whoever turns to him - he will misguide him and will lead him to the punishment of the blaze

arNorm: يايها الناس ان كنتمۡ في ريۡب من الۡبعۡث فانا خلقۡنكم من تراب ثم من نطۡفه ثم منۡ علقه ثم من مضۡغه مخلقه وغيۡر مخلقه لنبين لكمۡۚ ونقر في الۡارۡحام ما نشاء الي اجل مسمي ثم نخۡرجكمۡ طفۡلا ثم لتبۡلغوا اشدكمۡۖ ومنكم من يتوفي ومنكم من يرد الي ارۡذل الۡعمر لكيۡلا يعۡلم منۢ بعۡد علۡم شيۡاۚ وتري الۡارۡض هامده فاذا انزلۡنا عليۡها الۡماء اهۡتزتۡ وربتۡ وانۢبتتۡ من كل زوۡجۭ بهيج
en: o people, if you should be in doubt about the resurrection, then [consider that] indeed, we created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot, and then from a lump of flesh, formed and unformed - that we may show you. and we settle in the wombs whom we will for a specified term, then we bring you out as a child, and then [we develop you] that you may reach your [time of] maturity. and among you is he who is taken in [early] death, and among you is he who is returned to the most decrepit [old] age so that he knows, after [once having] knowledge, nothing. and you see the earth barren, but when we send down upon it rain, it quivers and swells and grows [something] of every beautiful kind

arNorm: ذلك بان الله هو الۡحق وانهۥ يحۡي الۡموۡتي وانهۥ علي كل شيۡء قدير
en: that is because allah is the truth and because he gives life to the dead and because he is over all things competent

arNorm: وان الساعه ءاتيه لا ريۡب فيها وان الله يبۡعث من في الۡقبور
en: and [that they may know] that the hour is coming - no doubt about it - and that allah will resurrect those in the graves

arNorm: ومن الناس من يجدل في الله بغيۡر علۡم ولا هدي ولا كتب منير
en: and of the people is he who disputes about allah without knowledge or guidance or an enlightening book [from him]

arNorm: ثاني عطۡفهۦ ليضل عن سبيل اللهۖ لهۥ في الدنۡيا خزۡيۖ ونذيقهۥ يوۡم الۡقيمه عذاب الۡحريق
en: twisting his neck [in arrogance] to mislead [people] from the way of allah. for him in the world is disgrace, and we will make him taste on the day of resurrection the punishment of the burning fire [while it is said]

arNorm: ذلك بما قدمتۡ يداك وان الله ليۡس بظلم للۡعبيد
en: that is for what your hands have put forth and because allah is not ever unjust to [his] servants

arNorm: ومن الناس من يعۡبد الله علي حرۡفۖ فانۡ اصابهۥ خيۡر اطۡمان بهۦۖ وانۡ اصابتۡه فتۡنه انقلب علي وجۡههۦ خسر الدنۡيا والۡاخرهۚ ذلك هو الۡخسۡران الۡمبين
en: and of the people is he who worships allah on an edge. if he is touched by good, he is reassured by it; but if he is struck by trial, he turns on his face [to the other direction]. he has lost [this] world and the hereafter. that is what is the manifest loss

arNorm: يدۡعوا من دون الله ما لا يضرهۥ وما لا ينفعهۥۚ ذلك هو الضلل الۡبعيد
en: he invokes instead of allah that which neither harms him nor benefits him. that is what is the extreme error

arNorm: يدۡعوا لمن ضرهۥ اقۡرب من نفۡعهۦۚ لبئۡس الۡموۡلي ولبئۡس الۡعشير
en: he invokes one whose harm is closer than his benefit - how wretched the protector and how wretched the associate

arNorm: ان الله يدۡخل الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت جنت تجۡري من تحۡتها الۡانۡهرۚ ان الله يفۡعل ما يريد
en: indeed, allah will admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow. indeed, allah does what he intends

arNorm: من كان يظن ان لن ينصره الله في الدنۡيا والۡاخره فلۡيمۡددۡ بسبب الي السماء ثم لۡيقۡطعۡ فلۡينظرۡ هلۡ يذۡهبن كيۡدهۥ ما يغيظ
en: whoever should think that allah will not support [prophet muhammad] in this world and the hereafter - let him extend a rope to the ceiling, then cut off [his breath], and let him see: will his effort remove that which enrages [him]

arNorm: وكذلك انزلۡنه ءايتۭ بينت وان الله يهۡدي من يريد
en: and thus have we sent the qur'an down as verses of clear evidence and because allah guides whom he intends

arNorm: ان الذين ءامنوا والذين هادوا والصبين والنصري والۡمجوس والذين اشۡركوا ان الله يفۡصل بيۡنهمۡ يوۡم الۡقيمهۚ ان الله علي كل شيۡء شهيد
en: indeed, those who have believed and those who were jews and the sabeans and the christians and the magians and those who associated with allah - allah will judge between them on the day of resurrection. indeed allah is, over all things, witness

arNorm: المۡ تر ان الله يسۡجدۤ لهۥۤ من في السموت ومن في الۡارۡض والشمۡس والۡقمر والنجوم والۡجبال والشجر والدواب وكثير من الناسۖ وكثير حق عليۡه الۡعذابۗ ومن يهن الله فما لهۥ من مكۡرمۚ ان الله يفۡعل ما يشاء۩
en: do you not see that to allah prostrates whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth and the sun, the moon, the stars, the mountains, the trees, the moving creatures and many of the people? but upon many the punishment has been justified. and he whom allah humiliates - for him there is no bestower of honor. indeed, allah does what he wills

arNorm: ۞هذان خصۡمان اخۡتصموا في ربهمۡۖ فالذين كفروا قطعتۡ لهمۡ ثياب من نار يصب من فوۡق رءوسهم الۡحميم
en: these are two adversaries who have disputed over their lord. but those who disbelieved will have cut out for them garments of fire. poured upon their heads will be scalding water

arNorm: يصۡهر بهۦ ما في بطونهمۡ والۡجلود
en: by which is melted that within their bellies and [their] skins

arNorm: ولهم مقمع منۡ حديد
en: and for [striking] them are maces of iron

arNorm: كلما ارادوا ان يخۡرجوا منۡها منۡ غم اعيدوا فيها وذوقوا عذاب الۡحريق
en: every time they want to get out of hellfire from anguish, they will be returned to it, and [it will be said], "taste the punishment of the burning fire

arNorm: ان الله يدۡخل الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت جنت تجۡري من تحۡتها الۡانۡهر يحلوۡن فيها منۡ اساور من ذهب ولؤۡلؤاۖ ولباسهمۡ فيها حرير
en: indeed, allah will admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow. they will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and pearl, and their garments therein will be silk

arNorm: وهدوا الي الطيب من الۡقوۡل وهدوا الي صرط الۡحميد
en: and they had been guided [in worldly life] to good speech, and they were guided to the path of the praiseworthy

arNorm: ان الذين كفروا ويصدون عن سبيل الله والۡمسۡجد الۡحرام الذي جعلۡنه للناس سواء الۡعكف فيه والۡبادۚ ومن يردۡ فيه بالۡحادۭ بظلۡم نذقۡه منۡ عذاب اليم
en: indeed, those who have disbelieved and avert [people] from the way of allah and [from] al-masjid al-haram, which we made for the people - equal are the resident therein and one from outside; and [also] whoever intends [a deed] therein of deviation [in religion] or wrongdoing - we will make him taste of a painful punishment

arNorm: واذۡ بواۡنا لابۡرهيم مكان الۡبيۡت ان لا تشۡركۡ بي شيۡا وطهرۡ بيۡتي للطائفين والۡقائمين والركع السجود
en: and [mention, o muhammad], when we designated for abraham the site of the house, [saying], "do not associate anything with me and purify my house for those who perform tawaf and those who stand [in prayer] and those who bow and prostrate

arNorm: واذن في الناس بالۡحج ياۡتوك رجالا وعلي كل ضامر ياۡتين من كل فج عميق
en: and proclaim to the people the hajj [pilgrimage]; they will come to you on foot and on every lean camel; they will come from every distant pass

arNorm: ليشۡهدوا منفع لهمۡ ويذۡكروا اسۡم الله في ايام معۡلومت علي ما رزقهم منۢ بهيمه الۡانۡعمۖ فكلوا منۡها واطۡعموا الۡبائس الۡفقير
en: that they may witness benefits for themselves and mention the name of allah on known days over what he has provided for them of [sacrificial] animals. so eat of them and feed the miserable and poor

arNorm: ثم لۡيقۡضوا تفثهمۡ ولۡيوفوا نذورهمۡ ولۡيطوفوا بالۡبيۡت الۡعتيق
en: then let them end their untidiness and fulfill their vows and perform tawaf around the ancient house

arNorm: ذلكۖ ومن يعظمۡ حرمت الله فهو خيۡر لهۥ عند ربهۦۗ واحلتۡ لكم الۡانۡعم الا ما يتۡلي عليۡكمۡۖ فاجۡتنبوا الرجۡس من الۡاوۡثن واجۡتنبوا قوۡل الزور
en: that [has been commanded], and whoever honors the sacred ordinances of allah - it is best for him in the sight of his lord. and permitted to you are the grazing livestock, except what is recited to you. so avoid the uncleanliness of idols and avoid false statement

arNorm: حنفاء لله غيۡر مشۡركين بهۦۚ ومن يشۡركۡ بالله فكانما خر من السماء فتخۡطفه الطيۡر اوۡ تهۡوي به الريح في مكان سحيق
en: inclining [only] to allah, not associating [anything] with him. and he who associates with allah - it is as though he had fallen from the sky and was snatched by the birds or the wind carried him down into a remote place

arNorm: ذلكۖ ومن يعظمۡ شعئر الله فانها من تقۡوي الۡقلوب
en: that [is so]. and whoever honors the symbols of allah - indeed, it is from the piety of hearts

arNorm: لكمۡ فيها منفع الي اجل مسمي ثم محلها الي الۡبيۡت الۡعتيق
en: for you the animals marked for sacrifice are benefits for a specified term; then their place of sacrifice is at the ancient house

arNorm: ولكل امه جعلۡنا منسكا ليذۡكروا اسۡم الله علي ما رزقهم منۢ بهيمه الۡانۡعمۗ فالهكمۡ اله وحد فلهۥ اسۡلمواۗ وبشر الۡمخۡبتين
en: and for all religion we have appointed a rite [of sacrifice] that they may mention the name of allah over what he has provided for them of [sacrificial] animals. for your god is one god, so to him submit. and, [o muhammad], give good tidings to the humble [before their lord]

arNorm: الذين اذا ذكر الله وجلتۡ قلوبهمۡ والصبرين علي ما اصابهمۡ والۡمقيمي الصلوه ومما رزقۡنهمۡ ينفقون
en: who, when allah is mentioned, their hearts are fearful, and [to] the patient over what has afflicted them, and the establishers of prayer and those who spend from what we have provided them

arNorm: والۡبدۡن جعلۡنها لكم من شعئر الله لكمۡ فيها خيۡرۖ فاذۡكروا اسۡم الله عليۡها صوافۖ فاذا وجبتۡ جنوبها فكلوا منۡها واطۡعموا الۡقانع والۡمعۡترۚ كذلك سخرۡنها لكمۡ لعلكمۡ تشۡكرون
en: and the camels and cattle we have appointed for you as among the symbols of allah; for you therein is good. so mention the name of allah upon them when lined up [for sacrifice]; and when they are [lifeless] on their sides, then eat from them and feed the needy and the beggar. thus have we subjected them to you that you may be grateful

arNorm: لن ينال الله لحومها ولا دماؤها ولكن يناله التقۡوي منكمۡۚ كذلك سخرها لكمۡ لتكبروا الله علي ما هديكمۡۗ وبشر الۡمحۡسنين
en: their meat will not reach allah, nor will their blood, but what reaches him is piety from you. thus have we subjected them to you that you may glorify allah for that [to] which he has guided you; and give good tidings to the doers of good

arNorm: ۞ان الله يدفع عن الذين ءامنواۗ ان الله لا يحب كل خوان كفور
en: indeed, allah defends those who have believed. indeed, allah does not like everyone treacherous and ungrateful

arNorm: اذن للذين يقتلون بانهمۡ ظلمواۚ وان الله علي نصۡرهمۡ لقدير
en: permission [to fight] has been given to those who are being fought, because they were wronged. and indeed, allah is competent to give them victory

arNorm: الذين اخۡرجوا من ديرهم بغيۡر حق الا ان يقولوا ربنا اللهۗ ولوۡلا دفۡع الله الناس بعۡضهم ببعۡض لهدمتۡ صومع وبيع وصلوت ومسجد يذۡكر فيها اسۡم الله كثيراۗ ولينصرن الله من ينصرهۥۚ ان الله لقوي عزيز
en: [they are] those who have been evicted from their homes without right - only because they say, "our lord is allah." and were it not that allah checks the people, some by means of others, there would have been demolished monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques in which the name of allah is much mentioned. and allah will surely support those who support him. indeed, allah is powerful and exalted in might

arNorm: الذين ان مكنهمۡ في الۡارۡض اقاموا الصلوه وءاتوا الزكوه وامروا بالۡمعۡروف ونهوۡا عن الۡمنكرۗ ولله عقبه الۡامور
en: [and they are] those who, if we give them authority in the land, establish prayer and give zakah and enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong. and to allah belongs the outcome of [all] matters

arNorm: وان يكذبوك فقدۡ كذبتۡ قبۡلهمۡ قوۡم نوح وعاد وثمود
en: and if they deny you, [o muhammad] - so, before them, did the people of noah and 'aad and thamud deny [their prophets]

arNorm: وقوۡم ابۡرهيم وقوۡم لوط
en: and the people of abraham and the people of lot

arNorm: واصۡحب مدۡينۖ وكذب موسيۖ فامۡليۡت للۡكفرين ثم اخذۡتهمۡۖ فكيۡف كان نكير
en: and the inhabitants of madyan. and moses was denied, so i prolonged enjoyment for the disbelievers; then i seized them, and how [terrible] was my reproach

arNorm: فكاين من قرۡيه اهۡلكۡنها وهي ظالمه فهي خاويه علي عروشها وبئۡر معطله وقصۡر مشيد
en: and how many a city did we destroy while it was committing wrong - so it is [now] fallen into ruin - and [how many] an abandoned well and [how many] a lofty palace

arNorm: افلمۡ يسيروا في الۡارۡض فتكون لهمۡ قلوب يعۡقلون بها اوۡ ءاذان يسۡمعون بهاۖ فانها لا تعۡمي الۡابۡصر ولكن تعۡمي الۡقلوب التي في الصدور
en: so have they not traveled through the earth and have hearts by which to reason and ears by which to hear? for indeed, it is not eyes that are blinded, but blinded are the hearts which are within the breasts

arNorm: ويسۡتعۡجلونك بالۡعذاب ولن يخۡلف الله وعۡدهۥۚ وان يوۡما عند ربك كالۡف سنه مما تعدون
en: and they urge you to hasten the punishment. but allah will never fail in his promise. and indeed, a day with your lord is like a thousand years of those which you count

arNorm: وكاين من قرۡيه امۡليۡت لها وهي ظالمه ثم اخذۡتها والي الۡمصير
en: and for how many a city did i prolong enjoyment while it was committing wrong. then i seized it, and to me is the [final] destination

arNorm: قلۡ يايها الناس انما انا۠ لكمۡ نذير مبين
en: say, "o people, i am only to you a clear warner

arNorm: فالذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت لهم مغۡفره ورزۡق كريم
en: and those who have believed and done righteous deeds - for them is forgiveness and noble provision

arNorm: والذين سعوۡا في ءايتنا معجزين اولئك اصۡحب الۡجحيم
en: but the ones who strove against our verses, [seeking] to cause failure - those are the companions of hellfire

arNorm: وما ارۡسلۡنا من قبۡلك من رسول ولا نبي الا اذا تمني الۡقي الشيۡطن في امۡنيتهۦ فينسخ الله ما يلۡقي الشيۡطن ثم يحۡكم الله ءايتهۦۗ والله عليم حكيم
en: and we did not send before you any messenger or prophet except that when he spoke [or recited], satan threw into it [some misunderstanding]. but allah abolishes that which satan throws in; then allah makes precise his verses. and allah is knowing and wise

arNorm: ليجۡعل ما يلۡقي الشيۡطن فتۡنه للذين في قلوبهم مرض والۡقاسيه قلوبهمۡۗ وان الظلمين لفي شقاقۭ بعيد
en: [that is] so he may make what satan throws in a trial for those within whose hearts is disease and those hard of heart. and indeed, the wrongdoers are in extreme dissension

arNorm: وليعۡلم الذين اوتوا الۡعلۡم انه الۡحق من ربك فيؤۡمنوا بهۦ فتخۡبت لهۥ قلوبهمۡۗ وان الله لهاد الذين ءامنوا الي صرط مسۡتقيم
en: and so those who were given knowledge may know that it is the truth from your lord and [therefore] believe in it, and their hearts humbly submit to it. and indeed is allah the guide of those who have believed to a straight path

arNorm: ولا يزال الذين كفروا في مرۡيه منۡه حتي تاۡتيهم الساعه بغۡته اوۡ ياۡتيهمۡ عذاب يوۡم عقيم
en: but those who disbelieve will not cease to be in doubt of it until the hour comes upon them unexpectedly or there comes to them the punishment of a barren day

arNorm: الۡملۡك يوۡمئذ لله يحۡكم بيۡنهمۡۚ فالذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت في جنت النعيم
en: [all] sovereignty that day is for allah; he will judge between them. so they who believed and did righteous deeds will be in the gardens of pleasure

arNorm: والذين كفروا وكذبوا بايتنا فاولئك لهمۡ عذاب مهين
en: and they who disbelieved and denied our signs - for those there will be a humiliating punishment

arNorm: والذين هاجروا في سبيل الله ثم قتلوا اوۡ ماتوا ليرۡزقنهم الله رزۡقا حسناۚ وان الله لهو خيۡر الرزقين
en: and those who emigrated for the cause of allah and then were killed or died - allah will surely provide for them a good provision. and indeed, it is allah who is the best of providers

arNorm: ليدۡخلنهم مدۡخلا يرۡضوۡنهۥۚ وان الله لعليم حليم
en: he will surely cause them to enter an entrance with which they will be pleased, and indeed, allah is knowing and forbearing

arNorm: ۞ذلكۖ ومنۡ عاقب بمثۡل ما عوقب بهۦ ثم بغي عليۡه لينصرنه اللهۚ ان الله لعفو غفور
en: that [is so]. and whoever responds [to injustice] with the equivalent of that with which he was harmed and then is tyrannized - allah will surely aid him. indeed, allah is pardoning and forgiving

arNorm: ذلك بان الله يولج اليۡل في النهار ويولج النهار في اليۡل وان الله سميعۢ بصير
en: that is because allah causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and because allah is hearing and seeing

arNorm: ذلك بان الله هو الۡحق وان ما يدۡعون من دونهۦ هو الۡبطل وان الله هو الۡعلي الۡكبير
en: that is because allah is the truth, and that which they call upon other than him is falsehood, and because allah is the most high, the grand

arNorm: المۡ تر ان الله انزل من السماء ماء فتصۡبح الۡارۡض مخۡضرهۚ ان الله لطيف خبير
en: do you not see that allah has sent down rain from the sky and the earth becomes green? indeed, allah is subtle and acquainted

arNorm: لهۥ ما في السموت وما في الۡارۡضۚ وان الله لهو الۡغني الۡحميد
en: to him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth. and indeed, allah is the free of need, the praiseworthy

arNorm: المۡ تر ان الله سخر لكم ما في الۡارۡض والۡفلۡك تجۡري في الۡبحۡر بامۡرهۦ ويمۡسك السماء ان تقع علي الۡارۡض الا باذۡنهۦۚ ان الله بالناس لرءوف رحيم
en: do you not see that allah has subjected to you whatever is on the earth and the ships which run through the sea by his command? and he restrains the sky from falling upon the earth, unless by his permission. indeed allah, to the people, is kind and merciful

arNorm: وهو الذي احۡياكمۡ ثم يميتكمۡ ثم يحۡييكمۡۗ ان الۡانسن لكفور
en: and he is the one who gave you life; then he causes you to die and then will [again] give you life. indeed, mankind is ungrateful

arNorm: لكل امه جعلۡنا منسكا همۡ ناسكوهۖ فلا ينزعنك في الۡامۡرۚ وادۡع الي ربكۖ انك لعلي هدي مسۡتقيم
en: for every religion we have appointed rites which they perform. so, [o muhammad], let the disbelievers not contend with you over the matter but invite them to your lord. indeed, you are upon straight guidance

arNorm: وان جدلوك فقل الله اعۡلم بما تعۡملون
en: and if they dispute with you, then say, "allah is most knowing of what you do

arNorm: الله يحۡكم بيۡنكمۡ يوۡم الۡقيمه فيما كنتمۡ فيه تخۡتلفون
en: allah will judge between you on the day of resurrection concerning that over which you used to differ

arNorm: المۡ تعۡلمۡ ان الله يعۡلم ما في السماء والۡارۡضۚ ان ذلك في كتبۚ ان ذلك علي الله يسير
en: do you not know that allah knows what is in the heaven and earth? indeed, that is in a record. indeed that, for allah, is easy

arNorm: ويعۡبدون من دون الله ما لمۡ ينزلۡ بهۦ سلۡطنا وما ليۡس لهم بهۦ علۡمۗ وما للظلمين من نصير
en: and they worship besides allah that for which he has not sent down authority and that of which they have no knowledge. and there will not be for the wrongdoers any helper

arNorm: واذا تتۡلي عليۡهمۡ ءايتنا بينت تعۡرف في وجوه الذين كفروا الۡمنكرۖ يكادون يسۡطون بالذين يتۡلون عليۡهمۡ ءايتناۗ قلۡ افانبئكم بشر من ذلكمۚ النار وعدها الله الذين كفرواۖ وبئۡس الۡمصير
en: and when our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, you recognize in the faces of those who disbelieve disapproval. they are almost on the verge of assaulting those who recite to them our verses. say, "then shall i inform you of [what is] worse than that? [it is] the fire which allah has promised those who disbelieve, and wretched is the destination

arNorm: يايها الناس ضرب مثل فاسۡتمعوا لهۥۚ ان الذين تدۡعون من دون الله لن يخۡلقوا ذبابا ولو اجۡتمعوا لهۥۖ وان يسۡلبۡهم الذباب شيۡا لا يسۡتنقذوه منۡهۚ ضعف الطالب والۡمطۡلوب
en: o people, an example is presented, so listen to it. indeed, those you invoke besides allah will never create [as much as] a fly, even if they gathered together for that purpose. and if the fly should steal away from them a [tiny] thing, they could not recover it from him. weak are the pursuer and pursued

arNorm: ما قدروا الله حق قدۡرهۦۚ ان الله لقوي عزيز
en: they have not appraised allah with true appraisal. indeed, allah is powerful and exalted in might

arNorm: الله يصۡطفي من الۡملئكه رسلا ومن الناسۚ ان الله سميعۢ بصير
en: allah chooses from the angels messengers and from the people. indeed, allah is hearing and seeing

arNorm: يعۡلم ما بيۡن ايۡديهمۡ وما خلۡفهمۡۚ والي الله ترۡجع الۡامور
en: he knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them. and to allah will be returned [all] matters

arNorm: يايها الذين ءامنوا ارۡكعوا واسۡجدواۤ واعۡبدوا ربكمۡ وافۡعلوا الۡخيۡر لعلكمۡ تفۡلحون۩
en: o you who have believed, bow and prostrate and worship your lord and do good - that you may succeed

arNorm: وجهدوا في الله حق جهادهۦۚ هو اجۡتبيكمۡ وما جعل عليۡكمۡ في الدين منۡ حرجۚ مله ابيكمۡ ابۡرهيمۚ هو سميكم الۡمسۡلمين من قبۡل وفي هذا ليكون الرسول شهيدا عليۡكمۡ وتكونوا شهداء علي الناسۚ فاقيموا الصلوه وءاتوا الزكوه واعۡتصموا بالله هو موۡليكمۡۖ فنعۡم الۡموۡلي ونعۡم النصير
en: and strive for allah with the striving due to him. he has chosen you and has not placed upon you in the religion any difficulty. [it is] the religion of your father, abraham. allah named you "muslims" before [in former scriptures] and in this [revelation] that the messenger may be a witness over you and you may be witnesses over the people. so establish prayer and give zakah and hold fast to allah. he is your protector; and excellent is the protector, and excellent is the helper

arNorm: قدۡ افۡلح الۡمؤۡمنون
en: certainly will the believers have succeeded

arNorm: الذين همۡ في صلاتهمۡ خشعون
en: they who are during their prayer humbly submissive

arNorm: والذين همۡ عن اللغۡو معۡرضون
en: and they who turn away from ill speech

arNorm: والذين همۡ للزكوه فعلون
en: and they who are observant of zakah

arNorm: والذين همۡ لفروجهمۡ حفظون
en: and they who guard their private parts

arNorm: الا علي ازۡوجهمۡ اوۡ ما ملكتۡ ايۡمنهمۡ فانهمۡ غيۡر ملومين
en: except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they will not be blamed

arNorm: فمن ابۡتغي وراء ذلك فاولئك هم الۡعادون
en: but whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors

arNorm: والذين همۡ لامنتهمۡ وعهۡدهمۡ رعون
en: and they who are to their trusts and their promises attentive

arNorm: والذين همۡ علي صلوتهمۡ يحافظون
en: and they who carefully maintain their prayers

arNorm: اولئك هم الۡورثون
en: those are the inheritors

arNorm: الذين يرثون الۡفرۡدوۡس همۡ فيها خلدون
en: who will inherit al-firdaus. they will abide therein eternally

arNorm: ولقدۡ خلقۡنا الۡانسن من سلله من طين
en: and certainly did we create man from an extract of clay

arNorm: ثم جعلۡنه نطۡفه في قرار مكين
en: then we placed him as a sperm-drop in a firm lodging

arNorm: ثم خلقۡنا النطۡفه علقه فخلقۡنا الۡعلقه مضۡغه فخلقۡنا الۡمضۡغه عظما فكسوۡنا الۡعظم لحۡما ثم انشاۡنه خلۡقا ءاخرۚ فتبارك الله احۡسن الۡخلقين
en: then we made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and we made the clot into a lump [of flesh], and we made [from] the lump, bones, and we covered the bones with flesh; then we developed him into another creation. so blessed is allah, the best of creators

arNorm: ثم انكم بعۡد ذلك لميتون
en: then indeed, after that you are to die

arNorm: ثم انكمۡ يوۡم الۡقيمه تبۡعثون
en: then indeed you, on the day of resurrection, will be resurrected

arNorm: ولقدۡ خلقۡنا فوۡقكمۡ سبۡع طرائق وما كنا عن الۡخلۡق غفلين
en: and we have created above you seven layered heavens, and never have we been of [our] creation unaware

arNorm: وانزلۡنا من السماء ماءۢ بقدر فاسۡكنه في الۡارۡضۖ وانا علي ذهابۭ بهۦ لقدرون
en: and we have sent down rain from the sky in a measured amount and settled it in the earth. and indeed, we are able to take it away

arNorm: فانشاۡنا لكم بهۦ جنت من نخيل واعۡنب لكمۡ فيها فوكه كثيره ومنۡها تاۡكلون
en: and we brought forth for you thereby gardens of palm trees and grapevines in which for you are abundant fruits and from which you eat

arNorm: وشجره تخۡرج من طور سيۡناء تنۢبت بالدهۡن وصبۡغ للۡاكلين
en: and [we brought forth] a tree issuing from mount sinai which produces oil and food for those who eat

arNorm: وان لكمۡ في الۡانۡعم لعبۡرهۖ نسۡقيكم مما في بطونها ولكمۡ فيها منفع كثيره ومنۡها تاۡكلون
en: and indeed, for you in livestock is a lesson. we give you drink from that which is in their bellies, and for you in them are numerous benefits, and from them you eat

arNorm: وعليۡها وعلي الۡفلۡك تحۡملون
en: and upon them and on ships you are carried

arNorm: ولقدۡ ارۡسلۡنا نوحا الي قوۡمهۦ فقال يقوۡم اعۡبدوا الله ما لكم منۡ اله غيۡرهۥۚ افلا تتقون
en: and we had certainly sent noah to his people, and he said, "o my people, worship allah; you have no deity other than him; then will you not fear him

arNorm: فقال الۡملؤا الذين كفروا من قوۡمهۦ ما هذا الا بشر مثۡلكمۡ يريد ان يتفضل عليۡكمۡ ولوۡ شاء الله لانزل ملئكه ما سمعۡنا بهذا في ءابائنا الۡاولين
en: but the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "this is not but a man like yourselves who wishes to take precedence over you; and if allah had willed [to send a messenger], he would have sent down angels. we have not heard of this among our forefathers

arNorm: انۡ هو الا رجلۢ بهۦ جنه فتربصوا بهۦ حتي حين
en: he is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time

arNorm: قال رب انصرۡني بما كذبون
en: [noah] said, "my lord, support me because they have denied me

arNorm: فاوۡحيۡنا اليۡه ان اصۡنع الۡفلۡك باعۡيننا ووحۡينا فاذا جاء امۡرنا وفار التنور فاسۡلكۡ فيها من كل زوۡجيۡن اثۡنيۡن واهۡلك الا من سبق عليۡه الۡقوۡل منۡهمۡۖ ولا تخطبۡني في الذين ظلموا انهم مغۡرقون
en: so we inspired to him, "construct the ship under our observation, and our inspiration, and when our command comes and the oven overflows, put into the ship from each [creature] two mates and your family, except those for whom the decree [of destruction] has proceeded. and do not address me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are to be drowned

arNorm: فاذا اسۡتويۡت انت ومن معك علي الۡفلۡك فقل الۡحمۡد لله الذي نجينا من الۡقوۡم الظلمين
en: and when you have boarded the ship, you and those with you, then say, 'praise to allah who has saved us from the wrongdoing people

arNorm: وقل رب انزلۡني منزلا مباركا وانت خيۡر الۡمنزلين
en: and say, 'my lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and you are the best to accommodate [us]

arNorm: ان في ذلك لايت وان كنا لمبۡتلين
en: indeed in that are signs, and indeed, we are ever testing [our servants]

arNorm: ثم انشاۡنا منۢ بعۡدهمۡ قرۡنا ءاخرين
en: then we produced after them a generation of others

arNorm: فارۡسلۡنا فيهمۡ رسولا منۡهمۡ ان اعۡبدوا الله ما لكم منۡ اله غيۡرهۥۚ افلا تتقون
en: and we sent among them a messenger from themselves, [saying], "worship allah; you have no deity other than him; then will you not fear him

arNorm: وقال الۡملا من قوۡمه الذين كفروا وكذبوا بلقاء الۡاخره واتۡرفۡنهمۡ في الۡحيوه الدنۡيا ما هذا الا بشر مثۡلكمۡ ياۡكل مما تاۡكلون منۡه ويشۡرب مما تشۡربون
en: and the eminent among his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the hereafter while we had given them luxury in the worldly life said, "this is not but a man like yourselves. he eats of that from which you eat and drinks of what you drink

arNorm: ولئنۡ اطعۡتم بشرا مثۡلكمۡ انكمۡ اذا لخسرون
en: and if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers

arNorm: ايعدكمۡ انكمۡ اذا متمۡ وكنتمۡ ترابا وعظما انكم مخۡرجون
en: does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones that you will be brought forth [once more]

arNorm: ۞هيۡهات هيۡهات لما توعدون
en: how far, how far, is that which you are promised

arNorm: انۡ هي الا حياتنا الدنۡيا نموت ونحۡيا وما نحۡن بمبۡعوثين
en: life is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected

arNorm: انۡ هو الا رجل افۡتري علي الله كذبا وما نحۡن لهۥ بمؤۡمنين
en: he is not but a man who has invented a lie about allah, and we will not believe him

arNorm: قال رب انصرۡني بما كذبون
en: he said, "my lord, support me because they have denied me

arNorm: قال عما قليل ليصۡبحن ندمين
en: [allah] said, "after a little, they will surely become regretful

arNorm: فاخذتۡهم الصيۡحه بالۡحق فجعلۡنهمۡ غثاءۚ فبعۡدا للۡقوۡم الظلمين
en: so the shriek seized them in truth, and we made them as [plant] stubble. then away with the wrongdoing people

arNorm: ثم انشاۡنا منۢ بعۡدهمۡ قرونا ءاخرين
en: then we produced after them other generations

arNorm: ما تسۡبق منۡ امه اجلها وما يسۡتۡخرون
en: no nation will precede its time [of termination], nor will they remain [thereafter]

arNorm: ثم ارۡسلۡنا رسلنا تتۡراۖ كل ما جاء امه رسولها كذبوهۖ فاتۡبعۡنا بعۡضهم بعۡضا وجعلۡنهمۡ احاديثۚ فبعۡدا لقوۡم لا يؤۡمنون
en: then we sent our messengers in succession. every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so we made them follow one another [to destruction], and we made them narrations. so away with a people who do not believe

arNorm: ثم ارۡسلۡنا موسي واخاه هرون بايتنا وسلۡطن مبين
en: then we sent moses and his brother aaron with our signs and a clear authority

arNorm: الي فرۡعوۡن وملايهۦ فاسۡتكۡبروا وكانوا قوۡما عالين
en: to pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people

arNorm: فقالوا انؤۡمن لبشريۡن مثۡلنا وقوۡمهما لنا عبدون
en: they said, "should we believe two men like ourselves while their people are for us in servitude

arNorm: فكذبوهما فكانوا من الۡمهۡلكين
en: so they denied them and were of those destroyed

arNorm: ولقدۡ ءاتيۡنا موسي الۡكتب لعلهمۡ يهۡتدون
en: and we certainly gave moses the scripture that perhaps they would be guided

arNorm: وجعلۡنا ابۡن مرۡيم وامهۥ ءايه وءاويۡنهما الي ربۡوه ذات قرار ومعين
en: and we made the son of mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water

arNorm: يايها الرسل كلوا من الطيبت واعۡملوا صلحاۖ اني بما تعۡملون عليم
en: [allah said], "o messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. indeed, i, of what you do, am knowing

arNorm: وان هذهۦ امتكمۡ امه وحده وانا۠ ربكمۡ فاتقون
en: and indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and i am your lord, so fear me

arNorm: فتقطعوا امۡرهم بيۡنهمۡ زبراۖ كل حزۡبۭ بما لديۡهمۡ فرحون
en: but the people divided their religion among them into sects - each faction, in what it has, rejoicing

arNorm: فذرۡهمۡ في غمۡرتهمۡ حتي حين
en: so leave them in their confusion for a time

arNorm: ايحۡسبون انما نمدهم بهۦ من مال وبنين
en: do they think that what we extend to them of wealth and children

arNorm: نسارع لهمۡ في الۡخيۡرتۚ بل لا يشۡعرون
en: is [because] we hasten for them good things? rather, they do not perceive

arNorm: ان الذين هم منۡ خشۡيه ربهم مشۡفقون
en: indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their lord

arNorm: والذين هم بايت ربهمۡ يؤۡمنون
en: and they who believe in the signs of their lord

arNorm: والذين هم بربهمۡ لا يشۡركون
en: and they who do not associate anything with their lord

arNorm: والذين يؤۡتون ما ءاتوا وقلوبهمۡ وجله انهمۡ الي ربهمۡ رجعون
en: and they who give what they give while their hearts are fearful because they will be returning to their lord

arNorm: اولئك يسرعون في الۡخيۡرت وهمۡ لها سبقون
en: it is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip [others] therein

arNorm: ولا نكلف نفۡسا الا وسۡعهاۚ ولديۡنا كتب ينطق بالۡحق وهمۡ لا يظۡلمون
en: and we charge no soul except [with that within] its capacity, and with us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged

arNorm: بلۡ قلوبهمۡ في غمۡره منۡ هذا ولهمۡ اعۡمل من دون ذلك همۡ لها عملون
en: but their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have [evil] deeds besides disbelief which they are doing

arNorm: حتي اذا اخذۡنا متۡرفيهم بالۡعذاب اذا همۡ يجۡرون
en: until when we seize their affluent ones with punishment, at once they are crying [to allah] for help

arNorm: لا تجۡروا الۡيوۡمۖ انكم منا لا تنصرون
en: do not cry out today. indeed, by us you will not be helped

arNorm: قدۡ كانتۡ ءايتي تتۡلي عليۡكمۡ فكنتمۡ علي اعۡقبكمۡ تنكصون
en: my verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels

arNorm: مسۡتكۡبرين بهۦ سمرا تهۡجرون
en: in arrogance regarding it, conversing by night, speaking evil

arNorm: افلمۡ يدبروا الۡقوۡل امۡ جاءهم ما لمۡ ياۡت ءاباءهم الۡاولين
en: then have they not reflected over the qur'an, or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers

arNorm: امۡ لمۡ يعۡرفوا رسولهمۡ فهمۡ لهۥ منكرون
en: or did they not know their messenger, so they are toward him disacknowledging

arNorm: امۡ يقولون بهۦ جنهۢۚ بلۡ جاءهم بالۡحق واكۡثرهمۡ للۡحق كرهون
en: or do they say, "in him is madness?" rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse

arNorm: ولو اتبع الۡحق اهۡواءهمۡ لفسدت السموت والۡارۡض ومن فيهنۚ بلۡ اتيۡنهم بذكۡرهمۡ فهمۡ عن ذكۡرهم معۡرضون
en: but if the truth had followed their inclinations, the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been ruined. rather, we have brought them their message, but they, from their message, are turning away

arNorm: امۡ تسۡلهمۡ خرۡجا فخراج ربك خيۡرۖ وهو خيۡر الرزقين
en: or do you, [o muhammad], ask them for payment? but the reward of your lord is best, and he is the best of providers

arNorm: وانك لتدۡعوهمۡ الي صرط مسۡتقيم
en: and indeed, you invite them to a straight path

arNorm: وان الذين لا يؤۡمنون بالۡاخره عن الصرط لنكبون
en: but indeed, those who do not believe in the hereafter are deviating from the path

arNorm: ۞ولوۡ رحمۡنهمۡ وكشفۡنا ما بهم من ضر للجوا في طغۡينهمۡ يعۡمهون
en: and even if we gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly

arNorm: ولقدۡ اخذۡنهم بالۡعذاب فما اسۡتكانوا لربهمۡ وما يتضرعون
en: and we had gripped them with suffering [as a warning], but they did not yield to their lord, nor did they humbly supplicate, [and will continue thus]

arNorm: حتي اذا فتحۡنا عليۡهم بابا ذا عذاب شديد اذا همۡ فيه مبۡلسون
en: until when we have opened before them a door of severe punishment, immediately they will be therein in despair

arNorm: وهو الذي انشا لكم السمۡع والۡابۡصر والۡافۡدهۚ قليلا ما تشۡكرون
en: and it is he who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful

arNorm: وهو الذي ذراكمۡ في الۡارۡض واليۡه تحۡشرون
en: and it is he who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to him you will be gathered

arNorm: وهو الذي يحۡيۦ ويميت وله اخۡتلف اليۡل والنهارۚ افلا تعۡقلون
en: and it is he who gives life and causes death, and his is the alternation of the night and the day. then will you not reason

arNorm: بلۡ قالوا مثۡل ما قال الۡاولون
en: rather, they say like what the former peoples said

arNorm: قالوا اءذا متۡنا وكنا ترابا وعظما اءنا لمبۡعوثون
en: they said, "when we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected

arNorm: لقدۡ وعدۡنا نحۡن وءاباؤنا هذا من قبۡل انۡ هذا الا اسطير الۡاولين
en: we have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples

arNorm: قل لمن الۡارۡض ومن فيها ان كنتمۡ تعۡلمون
en: say, [o muhammad], "to whom belongs the earth and whoever is in it, if you should know

arNorm: سيقولون للهۚ قلۡ افلا تذكرون
en: they will say, "to allah." say, "then will you not remember

arNorm: قلۡ من رب السموت السبۡع ورب الۡعرۡش الۡعظيم
en: say, "who is lord of the seven heavens and lord of the great throne

arNorm: سيقولون للهۚ قلۡ افلا تتقون
en: they will say, "[they belong] to allah." say, "then will you not fear him

arNorm: قلۡ منۢ بيدهۦ ملكوت كل شيۡء وهو يجير ولا يجار عليۡه ان كنتمۡ تعۡلمون
en: say, "in whose hand is the realm of all things - and he protects while none can protect against him - if you should know

arNorm: سيقولون للهۚ قلۡ فاني تسۡحرون
en: they will say, "[all belongs] to allah." say, "then how are you deluded

arNorm: بلۡ اتيۡنهم بالۡحق وانهمۡ لكذبون
en: rather, we have brought them the truth, and indeed they are liars

arNorm: ما اتخذ الله من ولد وما كان معهۥ منۡ الهۚ اذا لذهب كل الهۭ بما خلق ولعلا بعۡضهمۡ علي بعۡضۚ سبۡحن الله عما يصفون
en: allah has not taken any son, nor has there ever been with him any deity. [if there had been], then each deity would have taken what it created, and some of them would have sought to overcome others. exalted is allah above what they describe [concerning him]

arNorm: علم الۡغيۡب والشهده فتعلي عما يشۡركون
en: [he is] knower of the unseen and the witnessed, so high is he above what they associate [with him]

arNorm: قل رب اما تريني ما يوعدون
en: say, [o muhammad], "my lord, if you should show me that which they are promised

arNorm: رب فلا تجۡعلۡني في الۡقوۡم الظلمين
en: my lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people

arNorm: وانا علي ان نريك ما نعدهمۡ لقدرون
en: and indeed, we are able to show you what we have promised them

arNorm: ادۡفعۡ بالتي هي احۡسن السيئهۚ نحۡن اعۡلم بما يصفون
en: repel, by [means of] what is best, [their] evil. we are most knowing of what they describe

arNorm: وقل رب اعوذ بك منۡ همزت الشيطين
en: and say, "my lord, i seek refuge in you from the incitements of the devils

arNorm: واعوذ بك رب ان يحۡضرون
en: and i seek refuge in you, my lord, lest they be present with me

arNorm: حتي اذا جاء احدهم الۡموۡت قال رب ارۡجعون
en: [for such is the state of the disbelievers], until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "my lord, send me back

arNorm: لعلي اعۡمل صلحا فيما تركۡتۚ كلاۚ انها كلمه هو قائلهاۖ ومن ورائهم برۡزخ الي يوۡم يبۡعثون
en: that i might do righteousness in that which i left behind." no! it is only a word he is saying; and behind them is a barrier until the day they are resurrected

arNorm: فاذا نفخ في الصور فلا انساب بيۡنهمۡ يوۡمئذ ولا يتساءلون
en: so when the horn is blown, no relationship will there be among them that day, nor will they ask about one another

arNorm: فمن ثقلتۡ موزينهۥ فاولئك هم الۡمفۡلحون
en: and those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] - it is they who are the successful

arNorm: ومنۡ خفتۡ موزينهۥ فاولئك الذين خسروا انفسهمۡ في جهنم خلدون
en: but those whose scales are light - those are the ones who have lost their souls, [being] in hell, abiding eternally

arNorm: تلۡفح وجوههم النار وهمۡ فيها كلحون
en: the fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles

arNorm: المۡ تكنۡ ءايتي تتۡلي عليۡكمۡ فكنتم بها تكذبون
en: [it will be said]. "were not my verses recited to you and you used to deny them

arNorm: قالوا ربنا غلبتۡ عليۡنا شقۡوتنا وكنا قوۡما ضالين
en: they will say, "our lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray

arNorm: ربنا اخۡرجۡنا منۡها فانۡ عدۡنا فانا ظلمون
en: our lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return [to evil], we would indeed be wrongdoers

arNorm: قال اخۡسوا فيها ولا تكلمون
en: he will say, "remain despised therein and do not speak to me

arNorm: انهۥ كان فريق منۡ عبادي يقولون ربنا ءامنا فاغۡفرۡ لنا وارۡحمۡنا وانت خيۡر الرحمين
en: indeed, there was a party of my servants who said, 'our lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and you are the best of the merciful

arNorm: فاتخذۡتموهمۡ سخۡريا حتي انسوۡكمۡ ذكۡري وكنتم منۡهمۡ تضۡحكون
en: but you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget my remembrance, and you used to laugh at them

arNorm: اني جزيۡتهم الۡيوۡم بما صبروا انهمۡ هم الۡفائزون
en: indeed, i have rewarded them this day for their patient endurance - that they are the attainers [of success]

arNorm: قل كمۡ لبثۡتمۡ في الۡارۡض عدد سنين
en: [allah] will say, "how long did you remain on earth in number of years

arNorm: قالوا لبثۡنا يوۡما اوۡ بعۡض يوۡم فسۡل الۡعادين
en: they will say, "we remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate

arNorm: قل ان لبثۡتمۡ الا قليلاۖ لوۡ انكمۡ كنتمۡ تعۡلمون
en: he will say, "you stayed not but a little - if only you had known

arNorm: افحسبۡتمۡ انما خلقۡنكمۡ عبثا وانكمۡ اليۡنا لا ترۡجعون
en: then did you think that we created you uselessly and that to us you would not be returned

arNorm: فتعلي الله الۡملك الۡحقۖ لا اله الا هو رب الۡعرۡش الۡكريم
en: so exalted is allah, the sovereign, the truth; there is no deity except him, lord of the noble throne

arNorm: ومن يدۡع مع الله الها ءاخر لا برۡهن لهۥ بهۦ فانما حسابهۥ عند ربهۦۚ انهۥ لا يفۡلح الۡكفرون
en: and whoever invokes besides allah another deity for which he has no proof - then his account is only with his lord. indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed

arNorm: وقل رب اغۡفرۡ وارۡحمۡ وانت خيۡر الرحمين
en: and, [o muhammad], say, "my lord, forgive and have mercy, and you are the best of the merciful

arNorm: سوره انزلۡنها وفرضۡنها وانزلۡنا فيها ءايتۭ بينت لعلكمۡ تذكرون
en: [this is] a surah which we have sent down and made [that within it] obligatory and revealed therein verses of clear evidence that you might remember

arNorm: الزانيه والزاني فاجۡلدوا كل وحد منۡهما مائه جلۡدهۖ ولا تاۡخذۡكم بهما راۡفه في دين الله ان كنتمۡ تؤۡمنون بالله والۡيوۡم الۡاخرۖ ولۡيشۡهدۡ عذابهما طائفه من الۡمؤۡمنين
en: the [unmarried] woman or [unmarried] man found guilty of sexual intercourse - lash each one of them with a hundred lashes, and do not be taken by pity for them in the religion of allah, if you should believe in allah and the last day. and let a group of the believers witness their punishment

arNorm: الزاني لا ينكح الا زانيه اوۡ مشۡركه والزانيه لا ينكحها الا زان اوۡ مشۡركۚ وحرم ذلك علي الۡمؤۡمنين
en: the fornicator does not marry except a [female] fornicator or polytheist, and none marries her except a fornicator or a polytheist, and that has been made unlawful to the believers

arNorm: والذين يرۡمون الۡمحۡصنت ثم لمۡ ياۡتوا بارۡبعه شهداء فاجۡلدوهمۡ ثمنين جلۡده ولا تقۡبلوا لهمۡ شهده ابداۚ واولئك هم الۡفسقون
en: and those who accuse chaste women and then do not produce four witnesses - lash them with eighty lashes and do not accept from them testimony ever after. and those are the defiantly disobedient

arNorm: الا الذين تابوا منۢ بعۡد ذلك واصۡلحوا فان الله غفور رحيم
en: except for those who repent thereafter and reform, for indeed, allah is forgiving and merciful

arNorm: والذين يرۡمون ازۡوجهمۡ ولمۡ يكن لهمۡ شهداء الا انفسهمۡ فشهده احدهمۡ ارۡبع شهدتۭ بالله انهۥ لمن الصدقين
en: and those who accuse their wives [of adultery] and have no witnesses except themselves - then the witness of one of them [shall be] four testimonies [swearing] by allah that indeed, he is of the truthful

arNorm: والۡخمسه ان لعۡنت الله عليۡه ان كان من الۡكذبين
en: and the fifth [oath will be] that the curse of allah be upon him if he should be among the liars

arNorm: ويدۡرؤا عنۡها الۡعذاب ان تشۡهد ارۡبع شهدتۭ بالله انهۥ لمن الۡكذبين
en: but it will prevent punishment from her if she gives four testimonies [swearing] by allah that indeed, he is of the liars

arNorm: والۡخمسه ان غضب الله عليۡها ان كان من الصدقين
en: and the fifth [oath will be] that the wrath of allah be upon her if he was of the truthful

arNorm: ولوۡلا فضۡل الله عليۡكمۡ ورحۡمتهۥ وان الله تواب حكيم
en: and if not for the favor of allah upon you and his mercy... and because allah is accepting of repentance and wise

arNorm: ان الذين جاءو بالۡافۡك عصۡبه منكمۡۚ لا تحۡسبوه شرا لكمۖ بلۡ هو خيۡر لكمۡۚ لكل امۡري منۡهم ما اكۡتسب من الۡاثۡمۚ والذي تولي كبۡرهۥ منۡهمۡ لهۥ عذاب عظيم
en: indeed, those who came with falsehood are a group among you. do not think it bad for you; rather it is good for you. for every person among them is what [punishment] he has earned from the sin, and he who took upon himself the greater portion thereof - for him is a great punishment

arNorm: لوۡلا اذۡ سمعۡتموه ظن الۡمؤۡمنون والۡمؤۡمنت بانفسهمۡ خيۡرا وقالوا هذا افۡك مبين
en: why, when you heard it, did not the believing men and believing women think good of one another and say, "this is an obvious falsehood

arNorm: لوۡلا جاءو عليۡه بارۡبعه شهداءۚ فاذۡ لمۡ ياۡتوا بالشهداء فاولئك عند الله هم الۡكذبون
en: why did they [who slandered] not produce for it four witnesses? and when they do not produce the witnesses, then it is they, in the sight of allah, who are the liars

arNorm: ولوۡلا فضۡل الله عليۡكمۡ ورحۡمتهۥ في الدنۡيا والۡاخره لمسكمۡ في ما افضۡتمۡ فيه عذاب عظيم
en: and if it had not been for the favor of allah upon you and his mercy in this world and the hereafter, you would have been touched for that [lie] in which you were involved by a great punishment

arNorm: اذۡ تلقوۡنهۥ بالۡسنتكمۡ وتقولون بافۡواهكم ما ليۡس لكم بهۦ علۡم وتحۡسبونهۥ هينا وهو عند الله عظيم
en: when you received it with your tongues and said with your mouths that of which you had no knowledge and thought it was insignificant while it was, in the sight of allah, tremendous

arNorm: ولوۡلا اذۡ سمعۡتموه قلۡتم ما يكون لنا ان نتكلم بهذا سبۡحنك هذا بهۡتن عظيم
en: and why, when you heard it, did you not say, "it is not for us to speak of this. exalted are you, [o allah]; this is a great slander

arNorm: يعظكم الله ان تعودوا لمثۡلهۦ ابدا ان كنتم مؤۡمنين
en: allah warns you against returning to the likes of this [conduct], ever, if you should be believers

arNorm: ويبين الله لكم الۡايتۚ والله عليم حكيم
en: and allah makes clear to you the verses, and allah is knowing and wise

arNorm: ان الذين يحبون ان تشيع الۡفحشه في الذين ءامنوا لهمۡ عذاب اليم في الدنۡيا والۡاخرهۚ والله يعۡلم وانتمۡ لا تعۡلمون
en: indeed, those who like that immorality should be spread [or publicized] among those who have believed will have a painful punishment in this world and the hereafter. and allah knows and you do not know

arNorm: ولوۡلا فضۡل الله عليۡكمۡ ورحۡمتهۥ وان الله رءوف رحيم
en: and if it had not been for the favor of allah upon you and his mercy... and because allah is kind and merciful

arNorm: ۞يايها الذين ءامنوا لا تتبعوا خطوت الشيۡطنۚ ومن يتبعۡ خطوت الشيۡطن فانهۥ ياۡمر بالۡفحۡشاء والۡمنكرۚ ولوۡلا فضۡل الله عليۡكمۡ ورحۡمتهۥ ما زكي منكم منۡ احد ابدا ولكن الله يزكي من يشاءۗ والله سميع عليم
en: o you who have believed, do not follow the footsteps of satan. and whoever follows the footsteps of satan - indeed, he enjoins immorality and wrongdoing. and if not for the favor of allah upon you and his mercy, not one of you would have been pure, ever, but allah purifies whom he wills, and allah is hearing and knowing

arNorm: ولا ياۡتل اولوا الۡفضۡل منكمۡ والسعه ان يؤۡتوا اولي الۡقرۡبي والۡمسكين والۡمهجرين في سبيل اللهۖ ولۡيعۡفوا ولۡيصۡفحواۗ الا تحبون ان يغۡفر الله لكمۡۚ والله غفور رحيم
en: and let not those of virtue among you and wealth swear not to give [aid] to their relatives and the needy and the emigrants for the cause of allah, and let them pardon and overlook. would you not like that allah should forgive you? and allah is forgiving and merciful

arNorm: ان الذين يرۡمون الۡمحۡصنت الۡغفلت الۡمؤۡمنت لعنوا في الدنۡيا والۡاخره ولهمۡ عذاب عظيم
en: indeed, those who [falsely] accuse chaste, unaware and believing women are cursed in this world and the hereafter; and they will have a great punishment

arNorm: يوۡم تشۡهد عليۡهمۡ الۡسنتهمۡ وايۡديهمۡ وارۡجلهم بما كانوا يعۡملون
en: on a day when their tongues, their hands and their feet will bear witness against them as to what they used to do

arNorm: يوۡمئذ يوفيهم الله دينهم الۡحق ويعۡلمون ان الله هو الۡحق الۡمبين
en: that day, allah will pay them in full their deserved recompense, and they will know that it is allah who is the perfect in justice

arNorm: الۡخبيثت للۡخبيثين والۡخبيثون للۡخبيثتۖ والطيبت للطيبين والطيبون للطيبتۚ اولئك مبرءون مما يقولونۖ لهم مغۡفره ورزۡق كريم
en: evil words are for evil men, and evil men are [subjected] to evil words. and good words are for good men, and good men are [an object] of good words. those [good people] are declared innocent of what the slanderers say. for them is forgiveness and noble provision

arNorm: يايها الذين ءامنوا لا تدۡخلوا بيوتا غيۡر بيوتكمۡ حتي تسۡتاۡنسوا وتسلموا علي اهۡلهاۚ ذلكمۡ خيۡر لكمۡ لعلكمۡ تذكرون
en: o you who have believed, do not enter houses other than your own houses until you ascertain welcome and greet their inhabitants. that is best for you; perhaps you will be reminded

arNorm: فان لمۡ تجدوا فيها احدا فلا تدۡخلوها حتي يؤۡذن لكمۡۖ وان قيل لكم ارۡجعوا فارۡجعواۖ هو ازۡكي لكمۡۚ والله بما تعۡملون عليم
en: and if you do not find anyone therein, do not enter them until permission has been given you. and if it is said to you, "go back," then go back; it is purer for you. and allah is knowing of what you do

arNorm: ليۡس عليۡكمۡ جناح ان تدۡخلوا بيوتا غيۡر مسۡكونه فيها متع لكمۡۚ والله يعۡلم ما تبۡدون وما تكۡتمون
en: there is no blame upon you for entering houses not inhabited in which there is convenience for you. and allah knows what you reveal and what you conceal

arNorm: قل للۡمؤۡمنين يغضوا منۡ ابۡصرهمۡ ويحۡفظوا فروجهمۡۚ ذلك ازۡكي لهمۡۚ ان الله خبيرۢ بما يصۡنعون
en: tell the believing men to reduce [some] of their vision and guard their private parts. that is purer for them. indeed, allah is acquainted with what they do

arNorm: وقل للۡمؤۡمنت يغۡضضۡن منۡ ابۡصرهن ويحۡفظۡن فروجهن ولا يبۡدين زينتهن الا ما ظهر منۡهاۖ ولۡيضۡربۡن بخمرهن علي جيوبهنۖ ولا يبۡدين زينتهن الا لبعولتهن اوۡ ءابائهن اوۡ ءاباء بعولتهن اوۡ ابۡنائهن اوۡ ابۡناء بعولتهن اوۡ اخۡونهن اوۡ بني اخۡونهن اوۡ بني اخوتهن اوۡ نسائهن اوۡ ما ملكتۡ ايۡمنهن او التبعين غيۡر اولي الۡارۡبه من الرجال او الطفۡل الذين لمۡ يظۡهروا علي عوۡرت النساءۖ ولا يضۡربۡن بارۡجلهن ليعۡلم ما يخۡفين من زينتهنۚ وتوبوا الي الله جميعا ايه الۡمؤۡمنون لعلكمۡ تفۡلحون
en: and tell the believing women to reduce [some] of their vision and guard their private parts and not expose their adornment except that which [necessarily] appears thereof and to wrap [a portion of] their headcovers over their chests and not expose their adornment except to their husbands, their fathers, their husbands' fathers, their sons, their husbands' sons, their brothers, their brothers' sons, their sisters' sons, their women, that which their right hands possess, or those male attendants having no physical desire, or children who are not yet aware of the private aspects of women. and let them not stamp their feet to make known what they conceal of their adornment. and turn to allah in repentance, all of you, o believers, that you might succeed
