en: it is he who confers blessing upon you, and his angels [ask him to do so] that he may bring you out from darknesses into the light. and ever is he, to the believers, merciful

arNorm: تحيتهمۡ يوۡم يلۡقوۡنهۥ سلمۚ واعد لهمۡ اجۡرا كريما
en: their greeting the day they meet him will be, "peace." and he has prepared for them a noble reward

arNorm: يايها النبي انا ارۡسلۡنك شهدا ومبشرا ونذيرا
en: o prophet, indeed we have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner

arNorm: وداعيا الي الله باذۡنهۦ وسراجا منيرا
en: and one who invites to allah, by his permission, and an illuminating lamp

arNorm: وبشر الۡمؤۡمنين بان لهم من الله فضۡلا كبيرا
en: and give good tidings to the believers that they will have from allah great bounty

arNorm: ولا تطع الۡكفرين والۡمنفقين ودعۡ اذيهمۡ وتوكلۡ علي اللهۚ وكفي بالله وكيلا
en: and do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites but do not harm them, and rely upon allah. and sufficient is allah as disposer of affairs

arNorm: يايها الذين ءامنوا اذا نكحۡتم الۡمؤۡمنت ثم طلقۡتموهن من قبۡل ان تمسوهن فما لكمۡ عليۡهن منۡ عده تعۡتدونهاۖ فمتعوهن وسرحوهن سراحا جميلا
en: o you who have believed, when you marry believing women and then divorce them before you have touched them, then there is not for you any waiting period to count concerning them. so provide for them and give them a gracious release

arNorm: يايها النبي انا احۡللۡنا لك ازۡوجك التي ءاتيۡت اجورهن وما ملكتۡ يمينك مما افاء الله عليۡك وبنات عمك وبنات عمتك وبنات خالك وبنات خلتك التي هاجرۡن معك وامۡراه مؤۡمنه ان وهبتۡ نفۡسها للنبي انۡ اراد النبي ان يسۡتنكحها خالصه لك من دون الۡمؤۡمنينۗ قدۡ علمۡنا ما فرضۡنا عليۡهمۡ في ازۡوجهمۡ وما ملكتۡ ايۡمنهمۡ لكيۡلا يكون عليۡك حرجۗ وكان الله غفورا رحيما
en: o prophet, indeed we have made lawful to you your wives to whom you have given their due compensation and those your right hand possesses from what allah has returned to you [of captives] and the daughters of your paternal uncles and the daughters of your paternal aunts and the daughters of your maternal uncles and the daughters of your maternal aunts who emigrated with you and a believing woman if she gives herself to the prophet [and] if the prophet wishes to marry her, [this is] only for you, excluding the [other] believers. we certainly know what we have made obligatory upon them concerning their wives and those their right hands possess, [but this is for you] in order that there will be upon you no discomfort. and ever is allah forgiving and merciful

arNorm: ۞ترۡجي من تشاء منۡهن وتۡوي اليۡك من تشاءۖ ومن ابۡتغيۡت ممنۡ عزلۡت فلا جناح عليۡكۚ ذلك ادۡني ان تقر اعۡينهن ولا يحۡزن ويرۡضيۡن بما ءاتيۡتهن كلهنۚ والله يعۡلم ما في قلوبكمۡۚ وكان الله عليما حليما
en: you, [o muhammad], may put aside whom you will of them or take to yourself whom you will. and any that you desire of those [wives] from whom you had [temporarily] separated - there is no blame upon you [in returning her]. that is more suitable that they should be content and not grieve and that they should be satisfied with what you have given them - all of them. and allah knows what is in your hearts. and ever is allah knowing and forbearing

arNorm: لا يحل لك النساء منۢ بعۡد ولا ان تبدل بهن منۡ ازۡوج ولوۡ اعۡجبك حسۡنهن الا ما ملكتۡ يمينكۗ وكان الله علي كل شيۡء رقيبا
en: not lawful to you, [o muhammad], are [any additional] women after [this], nor [is it] for you to exchange them for [other] wives, even if their beauty were to please you, except what your right hand possesses. and ever is allah, over all things, an observer

arNorm: يايها الذين ءامنوا لا تدۡخلوا بيوت النبي الا ان يؤۡذن لكمۡ الي طعام غيۡر نظرين انيه ولكنۡ اذا دعيتمۡ فادۡخلوا فاذا طعمۡتمۡ فانتشروا ولا مسۡتۡنسين لحديثۚ ان ذلكمۡ كان يؤۡذي النبي فيسۡتحۡيۦ منكمۡۖ والله لا يسۡتحۡيۦ من الۡحقۚ واذا سالۡتموهن متعا فسۡلوهن من وراء حجابۚ ذلكمۡ اطۡهر لقلوبكمۡ وقلوبهنۚ وما كان لكمۡ ان تؤۡذوا رسول الله ولا ان تنكحوا ازۡوجهۥ منۢ بعۡدهۦ ابداۚ ان ذلكمۡ كان عند الله عظيما
en: o you who have believed, do not enter the houses of the prophet except when you are permitted for a meal, without awaiting its readiness. but when you are invited, then enter; and when you have eaten, disperse without seeking to remain for conversation. indeed, that [behavior] was troubling the prophet, and he is shy of [dismissing] you. but allah is not shy of the truth. and when you ask [his wives] for something, ask them from behind a partition. that is purer for your hearts and their hearts. and it is not [conceivable or lawful] for you to harm the messenger of allah or to marry his wives after him, ever. indeed, that would be in the sight of allah an enormity

arNorm: ان تبۡدوا شيۡا اوۡ تخۡفوه فان الله كان بكل شيۡء عليما
en: whether you reveal a thing or conceal it, indeed allah is ever, of all things, knowing

arNorm: لا جناح عليۡهن في ءابائهن ولا ابۡنائهن ولا اخۡونهن ولا ابۡناء اخۡونهن ولا ابۡناء اخوتهن ولا نسائهن ولا ما ملكتۡ ايۡمنهنۗ واتقين اللهۚ ان الله كان علي كل شيۡء شهيدا
en: there is no blame upon women concerning their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their brothers' sons or their sisters' sons or their women or those their right hands possess. and fear allah. indeed allah is ever, over all things, witness

arNorm: ان الله وملئكتهۥ يصلون علي النبيۚ يايها الذين ءامنوا صلوا عليۡه وسلموا تسۡليما
en: indeed, allah confers blessing upon the prophet, and his angels [ask him to do so]. o you who have believed, ask [allah to confer] blessing upon him and ask [allah to grant him] peace

arNorm: ان الذين يؤۡذون الله ورسولهۥ لعنهم الله في الدنۡيا والۡاخره واعد لهمۡ عذابا مهينا
en: indeed, those who abuse allah and his messenger - allah has cursed them in this world and the hereafter and prepared for them a humiliating punishment

arNorm: والذين يؤۡذون الۡمؤۡمنين والۡمؤۡمنت بغيۡر ما اكۡتسبوا فقد احۡتملوا بهۡتنا واثۡما مبينا
en: and those who harm believing men and believing women for [something] other than what they have earned have certainly born upon themselves a slander and manifest sin

arNorm: يايها النبي قل لازۡوجك وبناتك ونساء الۡمؤۡمنين يدۡنين عليۡهن من جلبيبهنۚ ذلك ادۡني ان يعۡرفۡن فلا يؤۡذيۡنۗ وكان الله غفورا رحيما
en: o prophet, tell your wives and your daughters and the women of the believers to bring down over themselves [part] of their outer garments. that is more suitable that they will be known and not be abused. and ever is allah forgiving and merciful

arNorm: ۞لئن لمۡ ينته الۡمنفقون والذين في قلوبهم مرض والۡمرۡجفون في الۡمدينه لنغۡرينك بهمۡ ثم لا يجاورونك فيها الا قليلا
en: if the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is disease and those who spread rumors in al-madinah do not cease, we will surely incite you against them; then they will not remain your neighbors therein except for a little

arNorm: ملۡعونينۖ ايۡنما ثقفوا اخذوا وقتلوا تقۡتيلا
en: accursed wherever they are found, [being] seized and massacred completely

arNorm: سنه الله في الذين خلوۡا من قبۡلۖ ولن تجد لسنه الله تبۡديلا
en: [this is] the established way of allah with those who passed on before; and you will not find in the way of allah any change

arNorm: يسۡلك الناس عن الساعهۖ قلۡ انما علۡمها عند اللهۚ وما يدۡريك لعل الساعه تكون قريبا
en: people ask you concerning the hour. say," knowledge of it is only with allah. and what may make you perceive? perhaps the hour is near

arNorm: ان الله لعن الۡكفرين واعد لهمۡ سعيرا
en: indeed, allah has cursed the disbelievers and prepared for them a blaze

arNorm: خلدين فيها ابداۖ لا يجدون وليا ولا نصيرا
en: abiding therein forever, they will not find a protector or a helper

arNorm: يوۡم تقلب وجوههمۡ في النار يقولون يليۡتنا اطعۡنا الله واطعۡنا الرسولا۠
en: the day their faces will be turned about in the fire, they will say, "how we wish we had obeyed allah and obeyed the messenger

arNorm: وقالوا ربنا انا اطعۡنا سادتنا وكبراءنا فاضلونا السبيلا۠
en: and they will say, "our lord, indeed we obeyed our masters and our dignitaries, and they led us astray from the [right] way

arNorm: ربنا ءاتهمۡ ضعۡفيۡن من الۡعذاب والۡعنۡهمۡ لعۡنا كبيرا
en: our lord, give them double the punishment and curse them with a great curse

arNorm: يايها الذين ءامنوا لا تكونوا كالذين ءاذوۡا موسي فبراه الله مما قالواۚ وكان عند الله وجيها
en: o you who have believed, be not like those who abused moses; then allah cleared him of what they said. and he, in the sight of allah, was distinguished

arNorm: يايها الذين ءامنوا اتقوا الله وقولوا قوۡلا سديدا
en: o you who have believed, fear allah and speak words of appropriate justice

arNorm: يصۡلحۡ لكمۡ اعۡملكمۡ ويغۡفرۡ لكمۡ ذنوبكمۡۗ ومن يطع الله ورسولهۥ فقدۡ فاز فوۡزا عظيما
en: he will [then] amend for you your deeds and forgive you your sins. and whoever obeys allah and his messenger has certainly attained a great attainment

arNorm: انا عرضۡنا الۡامانه علي السموت والۡارۡض والۡجبال فابيۡن ان يحۡملۡنها واشۡفقۡن منۡها وحملها الۡانسنۖ انهۥ كان ظلوما جهولا
en: indeed, we offered the trust to the heavens and the earth and the mountains, and they declined to bear it and feared it; but man [undertook to] bear it. indeed, he was unjust and ignorant

arNorm: ليعذب الله الۡمنفقين والۡمنفقت والۡمشۡركين والۡمشۡركت ويتوب الله علي الۡمؤۡمنين والۡمؤۡمنتۗ وكان الله غفورا رحيمۢا
en: [it was] so that allah may punish the hypocrite men and hypocrite women and the men and women who associate others with him and that allah may accept repentance from the believing men and believing women. and ever is allah forgiving and merciful

arNorm: الۡحمۡد لله الذي لهۥ ما في السموت وما في الۡارۡض وله الۡحمۡد في الۡاخرهۚ وهو الۡحكيم الۡخبير
en: [all] praise is [due] to allah, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and to him belongs [all] praise in the hereafter. and he is the wise, the acquainted

arNorm: يعۡلم ما يلج في الۡارۡض وما يخۡرج منۡها وما ينزل من السماء وما يعۡرج فيهاۚ وهو الرحيم الۡغفور
en: he knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein. and he is the merciful, the forgiving

arNorm: وقال الذين كفروا لا تاۡتينا الساعهۖ قلۡ بلي وربي لتاۡتينكمۡ علم الۡغيۡبۖ لا يعۡزب عنۡه مثۡقال ذره في السموت ولا في الۡارۡض ولا اصۡغر من ذلك ولا اكۡبر الا في كتب مبين
en: but those who disbelieve say, "the hour will not come to us." say, "yes, by my lord, it will surely come to you. [allah is] the knower of the unseen." not absent from him is an atom's weight within the heavens or within the earth or [what is] smaller than that or greater, except that it is in a clear register

arNorm: ليجۡزي الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحتۚ اولئك لهم مغۡفره ورزۡق كريم
en: that he may reward those who believe and do righteous deeds. those will have forgiveness and noble provision

arNorm: والذين سعوۡ في ءايتنا معجزين اولئك لهمۡ عذاب من رجۡز اليم
en: but those who strive against our verses [seeking] to cause failure - for them will be a painful punishment of foul nature

arNorm: ويري الذين اوتوا الۡعلۡم الذي انزل اليۡك من ربك هو الۡحق ويهۡدي الي صرط الۡعزيز الۡحميد
en: and those who have been given knowledge see that what is revealed to you from your lord is the truth, and it guides to the path of the exalted in might, the praiseworthy

arNorm: وقال الذين كفروا هلۡ ندلكمۡ علي رجل ينبئكمۡ اذا مزقۡتمۡ كل ممزق انكمۡ لفي خلۡق جديد
en: but those who disbelieve say, "shall we direct you to a man who will inform you [that] when you have disintegrated in complete disintegration, you will [then] be [recreated] in a new creation

arNorm: افۡتري علي الله كذبا ام بهۦ جنهۢۗ بل الذين لا يؤۡمنون بالۡاخره في الۡعذاب والضلل الۡبعيد
en: has he invented about allah a lie or is there in him madness?" rather, they who do not believe in the hereafter will be in the punishment and [are in] extreme error

arNorm: افلمۡ يروۡا الي ما بيۡن ايۡديهمۡ وما خلۡفهم من السماء والۡارۡضۚ ان نشاۡ نخۡسفۡ بهم الۡارۡض اوۡ نسۡقطۡ عليۡهمۡ كسفا من السماءۚ ان في ذلك لايه لكل عبۡد منيب
en: then, do they not look at what is before them and what is behind them of the heaven and earth? if we should will, we could cause the earth to swallow them or [could] let fall upon them fragments from the sky. indeed in that is a sign for every servant turning back [to allah]

arNorm: ۞ولقدۡ ءاتيۡنا داوۥد منا فضۡلاۖ يجبال اوبي معهۥ والطيۡرۖ والنا له الۡحديد
en: and we certainly gave david from us bounty. [we said], "o mountains, repeat [our] praises with him, and the birds [as well]." and we made pliable for him iron

arNorm: ان اعۡملۡ سبغت وقدرۡ في السرۡدۖ واعۡملوا صلحاۖ اني بما تعۡملون بصير
en: [commanding him], "make full coats of mail and calculate [precisely] the links, and work [all of you] righteousness. indeed i, of what you do, am seeing

arNorm: ولسليۡمن الريح غدوها شهۡر ورواحها شهۡرۖ واسلۡنا لهۥ عيۡن الۡقطۡرۖ ومن الۡجن من يعۡمل بيۡن يديۡه باذۡن ربهۦۖ ومن يزغۡ منۡهمۡ عنۡ امۡرنا نذقۡه منۡ عذاب السعير
en: and to solomon [we subjected] the wind - its morning [journey was that of] a month - and its afternoon [journey was that of] a month, and we made flow for him a spring of [liquid] copper. and among the jinn were those who worked for him by the permission of his lord. and whoever deviated among them from our command - we will make him taste of the punishment of the blaze

arNorm: يعۡملون لهۥ ما يشاء من محريب وتمثيل وجفان كالۡجواب وقدور راسيتۚ اعۡملوا ءال داوۥد شكۡراۚ وقليل منۡ عبادي الشكور
en: they made for him what he willed of elevated chambers, statues, bowls like reservoirs, and stationary kettles. [we said], "work, o family of david, in gratitude." and few of my servants are grateful

arNorm: فلما قضيۡنا عليۡه الۡموۡت ما دلهمۡ علي موۡتهۦ الا دابه الۡارۡض تاۡكل منساتهۥۖ فلما خر تبينت الۡجن ان لوۡ كانوا يعۡلمون الۡغيۡب ما لبثوا في الۡعذاب الۡمهين
en: and when we decreed for solomon death, nothing indicated to the jinn his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. but when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment

arNorm: لقدۡ كان لسبا في مسۡكنهمۡ ءايهۖ جنتان عن يمين وشمالۖ كلوا من رزۡق ربكمۡ واشۡكروا لهۥۚ بلۡده طيبه ورب غفور
en: there was for [the tribe of] saba' in their dwelling place a sign: two [fields of] gardens on the right and on the left. [they were told], "eat from the provisions of your lord and be grateful to him. a good land [have you], and a forgiving lord

arNorm: فاعۡرضوا فارۡسلۡنا عليۡهمۡ سيۡل الۡعرم وبدلۡنهم بجنتيۡهمۡ جنتيۡن ذواتيۡ اكل خمۡط واثۡل وشيۡء من سدۡر قليل
en: but they turned away [refusing], so we sent upon them the flood of the dam, and we replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees

arNorm: ذلك جزيۡنهم بما كفرواۖ وهلۡ نجزي الا الۡكفور
en: [by] that we repaid them because they disbelieved. and do we [thus] repay except the ungrateful

arNorm: وجعلۡنا بيۡنهمۡ وبيۡن الۡقري التي بركۡنا فيها قري ظهره وقدرۡنا فيها السيۡرۖ سيروا فيها ليالي واياما ءامنين
en: and we placed between them and the cities which we had blessed [many] visible cities. and we determined between them the [distances of] journey, [saying], "travel between them by night or day in safety

arNorm: فقالوا ربنا بعدۡ بيۡن اسۡفارنا وظلموا انفسهمۡ فجعلۡنهمۡ احاديث ومزقۡنهمۡ كل ممزقۚ ان في ذلك لايت لكل صبار شكور
en: but [insolently] they said, "our lord, lengthen the distance between our journeys," and wronged themselves, so we made them narrations and dispersed them in total dispersion. indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful

arNorm: ولقدۡ صدق عليۡهمۡ ابۡليس ظنهۥ فاتبعوه الا فريقا من الۡمؤۡمنين
en: and iblees had already confirmed through them his assumption, so they followed him, except for a party of believers

arNorm: وما كان لهۥ عليۡهم من سلۡطن الا لنعۡلم من يؤۡمن بالۡاخره ممنۡ هو منۡها في شكۗ وربك علي كل شيۡء حفيظ
en: and he had over them no authority except [it was decreed] that we might make evident who believes in the hereafter from who is thereof in doubt. and your lord, over all things, is guardian

arNorm: قل ادۡعوا الذين زعمۡتم من دون الله لا يمۡلكون مثۡقال ذره في السموت ولا في الۡارۡض وما لهمۡ فيهما من شرۡك وما لهۥ منۡهم من ظهير
en: say, [o muhammad], "invoke those you claim [as deities] besides allah." they do not possess an atom's weight [of ability] in the heavens or on the earth, and they do not have therein any partnership [with him], nor is there for him from among them any assistant

arNorm: ولا تنفع الشفعه عندهۥ الا لمنۡ اذن لهۥۚ حتي اذا فزع عن قلوبهمۡ قالوا ماذا قال ربكمۡۖ قالوا الۡحقۖ وهو الۡعلي الۡكبير
en: and intercession does not benefit with him except for one whom he permits. [and those wait] until, when terror is removed from their hearts, they will say [to one another], "what has your lord said?" they will say, "the truth." and he is the most high, the grand

arNorm: ۞قلۡ من يرۡزقكم من السموت والۡارۡضۖ قل اللهۖ وانا اوۡ اياكمۡ لعلي هدي اوۡ في ضلل مبين
en: say, "who provides for you from the heavens and the earth?" say, "allah. and indeed, we or you are either upon guidance or in clear error

arNorm: قل لا تسۡلون عما اجۡرمۡنا ولا نسۡل عما تعۡملون
en: say, "you will not be asked about what we committed, and we will not be asked about what you do

arNorm: قلۡ يجۡمع بيۡننا ربنا ثم يفۡتح بيۡننا بالۡحق وهو الۡفتاح الۡعليم
en: say, "our lord will bring us together; then he will judge between us in truth. and he is the knowing judge

arNorm: قلۡ اروني الذين الۡحقۡتم بهۦ شركاءۖ كلاۚ بلۡ هو الله الۡعزيز الۡحكيم
en: say, "show me those whom you have attached to him as partners. no! rather, he [alone] is allah, the exalted in might, the wise

arNorm: وما ارۡسلۡنك الا كافه للناس بشيرا ونذيرا ولكن اكۡثر الناس لا يعۡلمون
en: and we have not sent you except comprehensively to mankind as a bringer of good tidings and a warner. but most of the people do not know

arNorm: ويقولون متي هذا الۡوعۡد ان كنتمۡ صدقين
en: and they say, "when is this promise, if you should be truthful

arNorm: قل لكم ميعاد يوۡم لا تسۡتۡخرون عنۡه ساعه ولا تسۡتقۡدمون
en: say, "for you is the appointment of a day [when] you will not remain thereafter an hour, nor will you precede [it]

arNorm: وقال الذين كفروا لن نؤۡمن بهذا الۡقرۡءان ولا بالذي بيۡن يديۡهۗ ولوۡ تري اذ الظلمون موۡقوفون عند ربهمۡ يرۡجع بعۡضهمۡ الي بعۡض الۡقوۡل يقول الذين اسۡتضۡعفوا للذين اسۡتكۡبروا لوۡلا انتمۡ لكنا مؤۡمنين
en: and those who disbelieve say, "we will never believe in this qur'an nor in that before it." but if you could see when the wrongdoers are made to stand before their lord, refuting each other's words... those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, "if not for you, we would have been believers

arNorm: قال الذين اسۡتكۡبروا للذين اسۡتضۡعفوا انحۡن صددۡنكمۡ عن الۡهدي بعۡد اذۡ جاءكمۖ بلۡ كنتم مجۡرمين
en: those who were arrogant will say to those who were oppressed, "did we avert you from guidance after it had come to you? rather, you were criminals

arNorm: وقال الذين اسۡتضۡعفوا للذين اسۡتكۡبروا بلۡ مكۡر اليۡل والنهار اذۡ تاۡمروننا ان نكۡفر بالله ونجۡعل لهۥ انداداۚ واسروا الندامه لما راوا الۡعذابۚ وجعلۡنا الۡاغۡلل في اعۡناق الذين كفرواۖ هلۡ يجۡزوۡن الا ما كانوا يعۡملون
en: those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, "rather, [it was your] conspiracy of night and day when you were ordering us to disbelieve in allah and attribute to him equals." but they will [all] confide regret when they see the punishment; and we will put shackles on the necks of those who disbelieved. will they be recompensed except for what they used to do

arNorm: وما ارۡسلۡنا في قرۡيه من نذير الا قال متۡرفوها انا بما ارۡسلۡتم بهۦ كفرون
en: and we did not send into a city any warner except that its affluent said, "indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers

arNorm: وقالوا نحۡن اكۡثر امۡولا واوۡلدا وما نحۡن بمعذبين
en: and they said, "we are more [than the believers] in wealth and children, and we are not to be punished

arNorm: قلۡ ان ربي يبۡسط الرزۡق لمن يشاء ويقۡدر ولكن اكۡثر الناس لا يعۡلمون
en: say, "indeed, my lord extends provision for whom he wills and restricts [it], but most of the people do not know

arNorm: وما امۡولكمۡ ولا اوۡلدكم بالتي تقربكمۡ عندنا زلۡفي الا منۡ ءامن وعمل صلحا فاولئك لهمۡ جزاء الضعۡف بما عملوا وهمۡ في الۡغرفت ءامنون
en: and it is not your wealth or your children that bring you nearer to us in position, but it is [by being] one who has believed and done righteousness. for them there will be the double reward for what they did, and they will be in the upper chambers [of paradise], safe [and secure]

arNorm: والذين يسۡعوۡن في ءايتنا معجزين اولئك في الۡعذاب محۡضرون
en: and the ones who strive against our verses to cause [them] failure - those will be brought into the punishment [to remain]

arNorm: قلۡ ان ربي يبۡسط الرزۡق لمن يشاء منۡ عبادهۦ ويقۡدر لهۥۚ وما انفقۡتم من شيۡء فهو يخۡلفهۥۖ وهو خيۡر الرزقين
en: say, "indeed, my lord extends provision for whom he wills of his servants and restricts [it] for him. but whatever thing you spend [in his cause] - he will compensate it; and he is the best of providers

arNorm: ويوۡم يحۡشرهمۡ جميعا ثم يقول للۡملئكه اهؤلاء اياكمۡ كانوا يعۡبدون
en: and [mention] the day when he will gather them all and then say to the angels, "did these [people] used to worship you

arNorm: قالوا سبۡحنك انت ولينا من دونهمۖ بلۡ كانوا يعۡبدون الۡجنۖ اكۡثرهم بهم مؤۡمنون
en: they will say, "exalted are you! you, [o allah], are our benefactor not them. rather, they used to worship the jinn; most of them were believers in them

arNorm: فالۡيوۡم لا يمۡلك بعۡضكمۡ لبعۡض نفۡعا ولا ضرا ونقول للذين ظلموا ذوقوا عذاب النار التي كنتم بها تكذبون
en: but today you do not hold for one another [the power of] benefit or harm, and we will say to those who wronged, "taste the punishment of the fire, which you used to deny

arNorm: واذا تتۡلي عليۡهمۡ ءايتنا بينت قالوا ما هذا الا رجل يريد ان يصدكمۡ عما كان يعۡبد ءاباؤكمۡ وقالوا ما هذا الا افۡك مفۡتريۚ وقال الذين كفروا للۡحق لما جاءهمۡ انۡ هذا الا سحۡر مبين
en: and when our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, they say, "this is not but a man who wishes to avert you from that which your fathers were worshipping." and they say, "this is not except a lie invented." and those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "this is not but obvious magic

arNorm: وما ءاتيۡنهم من كتب يدۡرسونهاۖ وما ارۡسلۡنا اليۡهمۡ قبۡلك من نذير
en: and we had not given them any scriptures which they could study, and we had not sent to them before you, [o muhammad], any warner

arNorm: وكذب الذين من قبۡلهمۡ وما بلغوا معۡشار ما ءاتيۡنهمۡ فكذبوا رسليۖ فكيۡف كان نكير
en: and those before them denied, and the people of makkah have not attained a tenth of what we had given them. but the former peoples denied my messengers, so how [terrible] was my reproach

arNorm: ۞قلۡ انما اعظكم بوحدهۖ ان تقوموا لله مثۡني وفردي ثم تتفكرواۚ ما بصاحبكم من جنهۚ انۡ هو الا نذير لكم بيۡن يديۡ عذاب شديد
en: say, "i only advise you of one [thing] - that you stand for allah, [seeking truth] in pairs and individually, and then give thought." there is not in your companion any madness. he is only a warner to you before a severe punishment

arNorm: قلۡ ما سالۡتكم منۡ اجۡر فهو لكمۡۖ انۡ اجۡري الا علي اللهۖ وهو علي كل شيۡء شهيد
en: say, "whatever payment i might have asked of you - it is yours. my payment is only from allah, and he is, over all things, witness

arNorm: قلۡ ان ربي يقۡذف بالۡحق علم الۡغيوب
en: say, "indeed, my lord projects the truth. knower of the unseen

arNorm: قلۡ جاء الۡحق وما يبۡدئ الۡبطل وما يعيد
en: say, "the truth has come, and falsehood can neither begin [anything] nor repeat [it]

arNorm: قلۡ ان ضللۡت فانما اضل علي نفۡسيۖ وان اهۡتديۡت فبما يوحي الي ربيۚ انهۥ سميع قريب
en: say, "if i should err, i would only err against myself. but if i am guided, it is by what my lord reveals to me. indeed, he is hearing and near

arNorm: ولوۡ تري اذۡ فزعوا فلا فوۡت واخذوا من مكان قريب
en: and if you could see when they are terrified but there is no escape, and they will be seized from a place nearby

arNorm: وقالوا ءامنا بهۦ واني لهم التناوش من مكانۭ بعيد
en: and they will [then] say, "we believe in it!" but how for them will be the taking [of faith] from a place far away

arNorm: وقدۡ كفروا بهۦ من قبۡلۖ ويقۡذفون بالۡغيۡب من مكانۭ بعيد
en: and they had already disbelieved in it before and would assault the unseen from a place far away

arNorm: وحيل بيۡنهمۡ وبيۡن ما يشۡتهون كما فعل باشۡياعهم من قبۡلۚ انهمۡ كانوا في شك مريبۭ
en: and prevention will be placed between them and what they desire, as was done with their kind before. indeed, they were in disquieting denial

arNorm: الۡحمۡد لله فاطر السموت والۡارۡض جاعل الۡملئكه رسلا اولي اجۡنحه مثۡني وثلث وربعۚ يزيد في الۡخلۡق ما يشاءۚ ان الله علي كل شيۡء قدير
en: [all] praise is [due] to allah, creator of the heavens and the earth, [who] made the angels messengers having wings, two or three or four. he increases in creation what he wills. indeed, allah is over all things competent

arNorm: ما يفۡتح الله للناس من رحۡمه فلا ممۡسك لهاۖ وما يمۡسكۡ فلا مرۡسل لهۥ منۢ بعۡدهۦۚ وهو الۡعزيز الۡحكيم
en: whatever allah grants to people of mercy - none can withhold it; and whatever he withholds - none can release it thereafter. and he is the exalted in might, the wise

arNorm: يايها الناس اذۡكروا نعۡمت الله عليۡكمۡۚ هلۡ منۡ خلق غيۡر الله يرۡزقكم من السماء والۡارۡضۚ لا اله الا هوۖ فاني تؤۡفكون
en: o mankind, remember the favor of allah upon you. is there any creator other than allah who provides for you from the heaven and earth? there is no deity except him, so how are you deluded

arNorm: وان يكذبوك فقدۡ كذبتۡ رسل من قبۡلكۚ والي الله ترۡجع الۡامور
en: and if they deny you, [o muhammad] - already were messengers denied before you. and to allah are returned [all] matters

arNorm: يايها الناس ان وعۡد الله حقۖ فلا تغرنكم الۡحيوه الدنۡيا ولا يغرنكم بالله الۡغرور
en: o mankind, indeed the promise of allah is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you and be not deceived about allah by the deceiver

arNorm: ان الشيۡطن لكمۡ عدو فاتخذوه عدواۚ انما يدۡعوا حزۡبهۥ ليكونوا منۡ اصۡحب السعير
en: indeed, satan is an enemy to you; so take him as an enemy. he only invites his party to be among the companions of the blaze

arNorm: الذين كفروا لهمۡ عذاب شديدۖ والذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت لهم مغۡفره واجۡر كبير
en: those who disbelieve will have a severe punishment, and those who believe and do righteous deeds will have forgiveness and great reward

arNorm: افمن زين لهۥ سوء عملهۦ فرءاه حسناۖ فان الله يضل من يشاء ويهۡدي من يشاءۖ فلا تذۡهبۡ نفۡسك عليۡهمۡ حسرتۚ ان الله عليمۢ بما يصۡنعون
en: then is one to whom the evil of his deed has been made attractive so he considers it good [like one rightly guided]? for indeed, allah sends astray whom he wills and guides whom he wills. so do not let yourself perish over them in regret. indeed, allah is knowing of what they do

arNorm: والله الذي ارۡسل الريح فتثير سحابا فسقۡنه الي بلد ميت فاحۡييۡنا به الۡارۡض بعۡد موۡتهاۚ كذلك النشور
en: and it is allah who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds, and we drive them to a dead land and give life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness. thus is the resurrection

arNorm: من كان يريد الۡعزه فلله الۡعزه جميعاۚ اليۡه يصۡعد الۡكلم الطيب والۡعمل الصلح يرۡفعهۥۚ والذين يمۡكرون السيات لهمۡ عذاب شديدۖ ومكۡر اولئك هو يبور
en: whoever desires honor [through power] - then to allah belongs all honor. to him ascends good speech, and righteous work raises it. but they who plot evil deeds will have a severe punishment, and the plotting of those - it will perish

arNorm: والله خلقكم من تراب ثم من نطۡفه ثم جعلكمۡ ازۡوجاۚ وما تحۡمل منۡ انثي ولا تضع الا بعلۡمهۦۚ وما يعمر من معمر ولا ينقص منۡ عمرهۦ الا في كتبۚ ان ذلك علي الله يسير
en: and allah created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop; then he made you mates. and no female conceives nor does she give birth except with his knowledge. and no aged person is granted [additional] life nor is his lifespan lessened but that it is in a register. indeed, that for allah is easy

arNorm: وما يسۡتوي الۡبحۡران هذا عذۡب فرات سائغ شرابهۥ وهذا ملۡح اجاجۖ ومن كل تاۡكلون لحۡما طريا وتسۡتخۡرجون حلۡيه تلۡبسونهاۖ وتري الۡفلۡك فيه مواخر لتبۡتغوا من فضۡلهۦ ولعلكمۡ تشۡكرون
en: and not alike are the two bodies of water. one is fresh and sweet, palatable for drinking, and one is salty and bitter. and from each you eat tender meat and extract ornaments which you wear, and you see the ships plowing through [them] that you might seek of his bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful

arNorm: يولج اليۡل في النهار ويولج النهار في اليۡل وسخر الشمۡس والۡقمرۖ كل يجۡري لاجل مسميۚ ذلكم الله ربكمۡ له الۡملۡكۚ والذين تدۡعون من دونهۦ ما يمۡلكون من قطۡمير
en: he causes the night to enter the day, and he causes the day to enter the night and has subjected the sun and the moon - each running [its course] for a specified term. that is allah, your lord; to him belongs sovereignty. and those whom you invoke other than him do not possess [as much as] the membrane of a date seed

arNorm: ان تدۡعوهمۡ لا يسۡمعوا دعاءكمۡ ولوۡ سمعوا ما اسۡتجابوا لكمۡۖ ويوۡم الۡقيمه يكۡفرون بشرۡككمۡۚ ولا ينبئك مثۡل خبير
en: if you invoke them, they do not hear your supplication; and if they heard, they would not respond to you. and on the day of resurrection they will deny your association. and none can inform you like [one] acquainted [with all matters]

arNorm: ۞يايها الناس انتم الۡفقراء الي اللهۖ والله هو الۡغني الۡحميد
en: o mankind, you are those in need of allah, while allah is the free of need, the praiseworthy

arNorm: ان يشاۡ يذۡهبۡكمۡ وياۡت بخلۡق جديد
en: if he wills, he can do away with you and bring forth a new creation

arNorm: وما ذلك علي الله بعزيز
en: and that is for allah not difficult

arNorm: ولا تزر وازره وزۡر اخۡريۚ وان تدۡع مثۡقله الي حمۡلها لا يحۡملۡ منۡه شيۡء ولوۡ كان ذا قرۡبيۗ انما تنذر الذين يخۡشوۡن ربهم بالۡغيۡب واقاموا الصلوهۚ ومن تزكي فانما يتزكي لنفۡسهۦۚ والي الله الۡمصير
en: and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. and if a heavily laden soul calls [another] to [carry some of] its load, nothing of it will be carried, even if he should be a close relative. you can only warn those who fear their lord unseen and have established prayer. and whoever purifies himself only purifies himself for [the benefit of] his soul. and to allah is the [final] destination

arNorm: وما يسۡتوي الۡاعۡمي والۡبصير
en: not equal are the blind and the seeing

arNorm: ولا الظلمت ولا النور
en: nor are the darknesses and the light

arNorm: ولا الظل ولا الۡحرور
en: nor are the shade and the heat

arNorm: وما يسۡتوي الۡاحۡياء ولا الۡامۡوتۚ ان الله يسۡمع من يشاءۖ وما انت بمسۡمع من في الۡقبور
en: and not equal are the living and the dead. indeed, allah causes to hear whom he wills, but you cannot make hear those in the graves

arNorm: انۡ انت الا نذير
en: you, [o muhammad], are not but a warner

arNorm: انا ارۡسلۡنك بالۡحق بشيرا ونذيراۚ وان منۡ امه الا خلا فيها نذير
en: indeed, we have sent you with the truth as a bringer of good tidings and a warner. and there was no nation but that there had passed within it a warner

arNorm: وان يكذبوك فقدۡ كذب الذين من قبۡلهمۡ جاءتۡهمۡ رسلهم بالۡبينت وبالزبر وبالۡكتب الۡمنير
en: and if they deny you - then already have those before them denied. their messengers came to them with clear proofs and written ordinances and with the enlightening scripture

arNorm: ثم اخذۡت الذين كفرواۖ فكيۡف كان نكير
en: then i seized the ones who disbelieved, and how [terrible] was my reproach

arNorm: المۡ تر ان الله انزل من السماء ماء فاخۡرجۡنا بهۦ ثمرت مخۡتلفا الۡونهاۚ ومن الۡجبال جددۢ بيض وحمۡر مخۡتلف الۡونها وغرابيب سود
en: do you not see that allah sends down rain from the sky, and we produce thereby fruits of varying colors? and in the mountains are tracts, white and red of varying shades and [some] extremely black

arNorm: ومن الناس والدواب والۡانۡعم مخۡتلف الۡونهۥ كذلكۗ انما يخۡشي الله منۡ عباده الۡعلمؤاۗ ان الله عزيز غفور
en: and among people and moving creatures and grazing livestock are various colors similarly. only those fear allah, from among his servants, who have knowledge. indeed, allah is exalted in might and forgiving

arNorm: ان الذين يتۡلون كتب الله واقاموا الصلوه وانفقوا مما رزقۡنهمۡ سرا وعلانيه يرۡجون تجره لن تبور
en: indeed, those who recite the book of allah and establish prayer and spend [in his cause] out of what we have provided them, secretly and publicly, [can] expect a profit that will never perish

arNorm: ليوفيهمۡ اجورهمۡ ويزيدهم من فضۡلهۦۚ انهۥ غفور شكور
en: that he may give them in full their rewards and increase for them of his bounty. indeed, he is forgiving and appreciative

arNorm: والذي اوۡحيۡنا اليۡك من الۡكتب هو الۡحق مصدقا لما بيۡن يديۡهۗ ان الله بعبادهۦ لخبيرۢ بصير
en: and that which we have revealed to you, [o muhammad], of the book is the truth, confirming what was before it. indeed, allah, of his servants, is acquainted and seeing

arNorm: ثم اوۡرثۡنا الۡكتب الذين اصۡطفيۡنا منۡ عبادناۖ فمنۡهمۡ ظالم لنفۡسهۦ ومنۡهم مقۡتصد ومنۡهمۡ سابقۢ بالۡخيۡرت باذۡن اللهۚ ذلك هو الۡفضۡل الۡكبير
en: then we caused to inherit the book those we have chosen of our servants; and among them is he who wrongs himself, and among them is he who is moderate, and among them is he who is foremost in good deeds by permission of allah. that [inheritance] is what is the great bounty

arNorm: جنت عدۡن يدۡخلونها يحلوۡن فيها منۡ اساور من ذهب ولؤۡلؤاۖ ولباسهمۡ فيها حرير
en: [for them are] gardens of perpetual residence which they will enter. they will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and pearls, and their garments therein will be silk

arNorm: وقالوا الۡحمۡد لله الذي اذۡهب عنا الۡحزنۖ ان ربنا لغفور شكور
en: and they will say, "praise to allah, who has removed from us [all] sorrow. indeed, our lord is forgiving and appreciative

arNorm: الذي احلنا دار الۡمقامه من فضۡلهۦ لا يمسنا فيها نصب ولا يمسنا فيها لغوب
en: he who has settled us in the home of duration out of his bounty. there touches us not in it any fatigue, and there touches us not in it weariness [of mind]

arNorm: والذين كفروا لهمۡ نار جهنم لا يقۡضي عليۡهمۡ فيموتوا ولا يخفف عنۡهم منۡ عذابهاۚ كذلك نجۡزي كل كفور
en: and for those who disbelieve will be the fire of hell. [death] is not decreed for them so they may die, nor will its torment be lightened for them. thus do we recompense every ungrateful one

arNorm: وهمۡ يصۡطرخون فيها ربنا اخۡرجۡنا نعۡملۡ صلحا غيۡر الذي كنا نعۡملۚ اولمۡ نعمرۡكم ما يتذكر فيه من تذكر وجاءكم النذيرۖ فذوقوا فما للظلمين من نصير
en: and they will cry out therein, "our lord, remove us; we will do righteousness - other than what we were doing!" but did we not grant you life enough for whoever would remember therein to remember, and the warner had come to you? so taste [the punishment], for there is not for the wrongdoers any helper

arNorm: ان الله علم غيۡب السموت والۡارۡضۚ انهۥ عليمۢ بذات الصدور
en: indeed, allah is knower of the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and earth. indeed, he is knowing of that within the breasts

arNorm: هو الذي جعلكمۡ خلئف في الۡارۡضۚ فمن كفر فعليۡه كفۡرهۥۖ ولا يزيد الۡكفرين كفۡرهمۡ عند ربهمۡ الا مقۡتاۖ ولا يزيد الۡكفرين كفۡرهمۡ الا خسارا
en: it is he who has made you successors upon the earth. and whoever disbelieves - upon him will be [the consequence of] his disbelief. and the disbelief of the disbelievers does not increase them in the sight of their lord except in hatred; and the disbelief of the disbelievers does not increase them except in loss

arNorm: قلۡ ارءيۡتمۡ شركاءكم الذين تدۡعون من دون الله اروني ماذا خلقوا من الۡارۡض امۡ لهمۡ شرۡك في السموت امۡ ءاتيۡنهمۡ كتبا فهمۡ علي بينت منۡهۚ بلۡ ان يعد الظلمون بعۡضهم بعۡضا الا غرورا
en: say, "have you considered your 'partners' whom you invoke besides allah? show me what they have created from the earth, or have they partnership [with him] in the heavens? or have we given them a book so they are [standing] on evidence therefrom? [no], rather, the wrongdoers do not promise each other except delusion

arNorm: ۞ان الله يمۡسك السموت والۡارۡض ان تزولاۚ ولئن زالتا انۡ امۡسكهما منۡ احد منۢ بعۡدهۦۚ انهۥ كان حليما غفورا
en: indeed, allah holds the heavens and the earth, lest they cease. and if they should cease, no one could hold them [in place] after him. indeed, he is forbearing and forgiving

arNorm: واقۡسموا بالله جهۡد ايۡمنهمۡ لئن جاءهمۡ نذير ليكونن اهۡدي منۡ احۡدي الۡاممۖ فلما جاءهمۡ نذير ما زادهمۡ الا نفورا
en: and they swore by allah their strongest oaths that if a warner came to them, they would be more guided than [any] one of the [previous] nations. but when a warner came to them, it did not increase them except in aversion

arNorm: اسۡتكۡبارا في الۡارۡض ومكۡر السييۚ ولا يحيق الۡمكۡر السيئ الا باهۡلهۦۚ فهلۡ ينظرون الا سنت الۡاولينۚ فلن تجد لسنت الله تبۡديلاۖ ولن تجد لسنت الله تحۡويلا
en: [due to] arrogance in the land and plotting of evil; but the evil plot does not encompass except its own people. then do they await except the way of the former peoples? but you will never find in the way of allah any change, and you will never find in the way of allah any alteration

arNorm: اولمۡ يسيروا في الۡارۡض فينظروا كيۡف كان عقبه الذين من قبۡلهمۡ وكانوا اشد منۡهمۡ قوهۚ وما كان الله ليعۡجزهۥ من شيۡء في السموت ولا في الۡارۡضۚ انهۥ كان عليما قديرا
en: have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? and they were greater than them in power. but allah is not to be caused failure by anything in the heavens or on the earth. indeed, he is ever knowing and competent

arNorm: ولوۡ يؤاخذ الله الناس بما كسبوا ما ترك علي ظهۡرها من دابه ولكن يؤخرهمۡ الي اجل مسميۖ فاذا جاء اجلهمۡ فان الله كان بعبادهۦ بصيرۢا
en: and if allah were to impose blame on the people for what they have earned, he would not leave upon the earth any creature. but he defers them for a specified term. and when their time comes, then indeed allah has ever been, of his servants, seeing

arNorm: يس
en: ya, seen

arNorm: والۡقرۡءان الۡحكيم
en: by the wise qur'an

arNorm: انك لمن الۡمرۡسلين
en: indeed you, [o muhammad], are from among the messengers

arNorm: علي صرط مسۡتقيم
en: on a straight path

arNorm: تنزيل الۡعزيز الرحيم
en: [this is] a revelation of the exalted in might, the merciful

arNorm: لتنذر قوۡما ما انذر ءاباؤهمۡ فهمۡ غفلون
en: that you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware

arNorm: لقدۡ حق الۡقوۡل علي اكۡثرهمۡ فهمۡ لا يؤۡمنون
en: already the word has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe

arNorm: انا جعلۡنا في اعۡنقهمۡ اغۡللا فهي الي الۡاذۡقان فهم مقۡمحون
en: indeed, we have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft

arNorm: وجعلۡنا منۢ بيۡن ايۡديهمۡ سدا ومنۡ خلۡفهمۡ سدا فاغۡشيۡنهمۡ فهمۡ لا يبۡصرون
en: and we have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see

arNorm: وسواء عليۡهمۡ ءانذرۡتهمۡ امۡ لمۡ تنذرۡهمۡ لا يؤۡمنون
en: and it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe

arNorm: انما تنذر من اتبع الذكۡر وخشي الرحۡمن بالۡغيۡبۖ فبشرۡه بمغۡفره واجۡر كريم
en: you can only warn one who follows the message and fears the most merciful unseen. so give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward

arNorm: انا نحۡن نحۡي الۡموۡتي ونكۡتب ما قدموا وءاثرهمۡۚ وكل شيۡء احۡصيۡنه في امام مبين
en: indeed, it is we who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things we have enumerated in a clear register

arNorm: واضۡربۡ لهم مثلا اصۡحب الۡقرۡيه اذۡ جاءها الۡمرۡسلون
en: and present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it

arNorm: اذۡ ارۡسلۡنا اليۡهم اثۡنيۡن فكذبوهما فعززۡنا بثالث فقالوا انا اليۡكم مرۡسلون
en: when we sent to them two but they denied them, so we strengthened them with a third, and they said, "indeed, we are messengers to you

arNorm: قالوا ما انتمۡ الا بشر مثۡلنا وما انزل الرحۡمن من شيۡء انۡ انتمۡ الا تكۡذبون
en: they said, "you are not but human beings like us, and the most merciful has not revealed a thing. you are only telling lies

arNorm: قالوا ربنا يعۡلم انا اليۡكمۡ لمرۡسلون
en: they said, "our lord knows that we are messengers to you

arNorm: وما عليۡنا الا الۡبلغ الۡمبين
en: and we are not responsible except for clear notification

arNorm: قالوا انا تطيرۡنا بكمۡۖ لئن لمۡ تنتهوا لنرۡجمنكمۡ وليمسنكم منا عذاب اليم
en: they said, "indeed, we consider you a bad omen. if you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment

arNorm: قالوا طئركم معكمۡ ائن ذكرۡتمۚ بلۡ انتمۡ قوۡم مسۡرفون
en: they said, "your omen is with yourselves. is it because you were reminded? rather, you are a transgressing people

arNorm: وجاء منۡ اقۡصا الۡمدينه رجل يسۡعي قال يقوۡم اتبعوا الۡمرۡسلين
en: and there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. he said, "o my people, follow the messengers

arNorm: اتبعوا من لا يسۡلكمۡ اجۡرا وهم مهۡتدون
en: follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided

arNorm: ومالي لا اعۡبد الذي فطرني واليۡه ترۡجعون
en: and why should i not worship he who created me and to whom you will be returned

arNorm: ءاتخذ من دونهۦ ءالهه ان يردۡن الرحۡمن بضر لا تغۡن عني شفعتهمۡ شيۡا ولا ينقذون
en: should i take other than him [false] deities [while], if the most merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me

arNorm: اني اذا لفي ضلل مبين
en: indeed, i would then be in manifest error

arNorm: اني ءامنت بربكمۡ فاسۡمعون
en: indeed, i have believed in your lord, so listen to me

arNorm: قيل ادۡخل الۡجنهۖ قال يليۡت قوۡمي يعۡلمون
en: it was said, "enter paradise." he said, "i wish my people could know

arNorm: بما غفر لي ربي وجعلني من الۡمكۡرمين
en: of how my lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored

arNorm: ۞وما انزلۡنا علي قوۡمهۦ منۢ بعۡدهۦ من جند من السماء وما كنا منزلين
en: and we did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would we have done so

arNorm: ان كانتۡ الا صيۡحه وحده فاذا همۡ خمدون
en: it was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished

arNorm: يحسۡره علي الۡعبادۚ ما ياۡتيهم من رسول الا كانوا بهۦ يسۡتهۡزءون
en: how regretful for the servants. there did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him

arNorm: المۡ يروۡا كمۡ اهۡلكۡنا قبۡلهم من الۡقرون انهمۡ اليۡهمۡ لا يرۡجعون
en: have they not considered how many generations we destroyed before them - that they to them will not return

arNorm: وان كل لما جميع لديۡنا محۡضرون
en: and indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before us

arNorm: وءايه لهم الۡارۡض الۡميۡته احۡييۡنها واخۡرجۡنا منۡها حبا فمنۡه ياۡكلون
en: and a sign for them is the dead earth. we have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat

arNorm: وجعلۡنا فيها جنت من نخيل واعۡنب وفجرۡنا فيها من الۡعيون
en: and we placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs

arNorm: لياۡكلوا من ثمرهۦ وما عملتۡه ايۡديهمۡۚ افلا يشۡكرون
en: that they may eat of his fruit. and their hands have not produced it, so will they not be grateful

arNorm: سبۡحن الذي خلق الۡازۡوج كلها مما تنۢبت الۡارۡض ومنۡ انفسهمۡ ومما لا يعۡلمون
en: exalted is he who created all pairs - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know

arNorm: وءايه لهم اليۡل نسۡلخ منۡه النهار فاذا هم مظۡلمون
en: and a sign for them is the night. we remove from it [the light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness

arNorm: والشمۡس تجۡري لمسۡتقر لهاۚ ذلك تقۡدير الۡعزيز الۡعليم
en: and the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. that is the determination of the exalted in might, the knowing

arNorm: والۡقمر قدرۡنه منازل حتي عاد كالۡعرۡجون الۡقديم
en: and the moon - we have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk

arNorm: لا الشمۡس ينۢبغي لها ان تدۡرك الۡقمر ولا اليۡل سابق النهارۚ وكل في فلك يسۡبحون
en: it is not allowable for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming

arNorm: وءايه لهمۡ انا حملۡنا ذريتهمۡ في الۡفلۡك الۡمشۡحون
en: and a sign for them is that we carried their forefathers in a laden ship

arNorm: وخلقۡنا لهم من مثۡلهۦ ما يرۡكبون
en: and we created for them from the likes of it that which they ride

arNorm: وان نشاۡ نغۡرقۡهمۡ فلا صريخ لهمۡ ولا همۡ ينقذون
en: and if we should will, we could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved

arNorm: الا رحۡمه منا ومتعا الي حين
en: except as a mercy from us and provision for a time

arNorm: واذا قيل لهم اتقوا ما بيۡن ايۡديكمۡ وما خلۡفكمۡ لعلكمۡ ترۡحمون
en: but when it is said to them, "beware of what is before you and what is behind you; perhaps you will receive mercy

arNorm: وما تاۡتيهم منۡ ءايه منۡ ءايت ربهمۡ الا كانوا عنۡها معۡرضين
en: and no sign comes to them from the signs of their lord except that they are from it turning away

arNorm: واذا قيل لهمۡ انفقوا مما رزقكم الله قال الذين كفروا للذين ءامنوا انطۡعم من لوۡ يشاء الله اطۡعمهۥ انۡ انتمۡ الا في ضلل مبين
en: and when it is said to them, "spend from that which allah has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "should we feed one whom, if allah had willed, he would have fed? you are not but in clear error

arNorm: ويقولون متي هذا الۡوعۡد ان كنتمۡ صدقين
en: and they say, "when is this promise, if you should be truthful

arNorm: ما ينظرون الا صيۡحه وحده تاۡخذهمۡ وهمۡ يخصمون
en: they do not await except one blast which will seize them while they are disputing

arNorm: فلا يسۡتطيعون توۡصيه ولا الي اهۡلهمۡ يرۡجعون
en: and they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return

arNorm: ونفخ في الصور فاذا هم من الۡاجۡداث الي ربهمۡ ينسلون
en: and the horn will be blown; and at once from the graves to their lord they will hasten

arNorm: قالوا يويۡلنا منۢ بعثنا من مرۡقدناۜۗ هذا ما وعد الرحۡمن وصدق الۡمرۡسلون
en: they will say, "o woe to us! who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [the reply will be], "this is what the most merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth

arNorm: ان كانتۡ الا صيۡحه وحده فاذا همۡ جميع لديۡنا محۡضرون
en: it will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before us

arNorm: فالۡيوۡم لا تظۡلم نفۡس شيۡا ولا تجۡزوۡن الا ما كنتمۡ تعۡملون
en: so today no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do

arNorm: ان اصۡحب الۡجنه الۡيوۡم في شغل فكهون
en: indeed the companions of paradise, that day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation

arNorm: همۡ وازۡوجهمۡ في ظلل علي الۡارائك متكون
en: they and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches

arNorm: لهمۡ فيها فكهه ولهم ما يدعون
en: for them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]

arNorm: سلم قوۡلا من رب رحيم
en: [and] "peace," a word from a merciful lord

arNorm: وامۡتزوا الۡيوۡم ايها الۡمجۡرمون
en: [then he will say], "but stand apart today, you criminals

arNorm: ۞المۡ اعۡهدۡ اليۡكمۡ يبني ءادم ان لا تعۡبدوا الشيۡطنۖ انهۥ لكمۡ عدو مبين
en: did i not enjoin upon you, o children of adam, that you not worship satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy

arNorm: وان اعۡبدونيۚ هذا صرط مسۡتقيم
en: and that you worship [only] me? this is a straight path

arNorm: ولقدۡ اضل منكمۡ جبلا كثيراۖ افلمۡ تكونوا تعۡقلون
en: and he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason

arNorm: هذهۦ جهنم التي كنتمۡ توعدون
en: this is the hellfire which you were promised

arNorm: اصۡلوۡها الۡيوۡم بما كنتمۡ تكۡفرون
en: [enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny

arNorm: الۡيوۡم نخۡتم علي افۡوههمۡ وتكلمنا ايۡديهمۡ وتشۡهد ارۡجلهم بما كانوا يكۡسبون
en: that day, we will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn

arNorm: ولوۡ نشاء لطمسۡنا علي اعۡينهمۡ فاسۡتبقوا الصرط فاني يبۡصرون
en: and if we willed, we could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see

arNorm: ولوۡ نشاء لمسخۡنهمۡ علي مكانتهمۡ فما اسۡتطعوا مضيا ولا يرۡجعون
en: and if we willed, we could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return

arNorm: ومن نعمرۡه ننكسۡه في الۡخلۡقۚ افلا يعۡقلون
en: and he to whom we grant long life we reverse in creation; so will they not understand

arNorm: وما علمۡنه الشعۡر وما ينۢبغي لهۥۚ انۡ هو الا ذكۡر وقرۡءان مبين
en: and we did not give prophet muhammad, knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. it is not but a message and a clear qur'an

arNorm: لينذر من كان حيا ويحق الۡقوۡل علي الۡكفرين
en: to warn whoever is alive and justify the word against the disbelievers

arNorm: اولمۡ يروۡا انا خلقۡنا لهم مما عملتۡ ايۡدينا انۡعما فهمۡ لها ملكون
en: do they not see that we have created for them from what our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners

arNorm: وذللۡنها لهمۡ فمنۡها ركوبهمۡ ومنۡها ياۡكلون
en: and we have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat

arNorm: ولهمۡ فيها منفع ومشاربۚ افلا يشۡكرون
en: and for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful

arNorm: واتخذوا من دون الله ءالهه لعلهمۡ ينصرون
en: but they have taken besides allah [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped

arNorm: لا يسۡتطيعون نصۡرهمۡ وهمۡ لهمۡ جند محۡضرون
en: they are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance

arNorm: فلا يحۡزنك قوۡلهمۡۘ انا نعۡلم ما يسرون وما يعۡلنون
en: so let not their speech grieve you. indeed, we know what they conceal and what they declare

arNorm: اولمۡ ير الۡانسن انا خلقۡنه من نطۡفه فاذا هو خصيم مبين
en: does man not consider that we created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary

arNorm: وضرب لنا مثلا ونسي خلۡقهۥۖ قال من يحۡي الۡعظم وهي رميم
en: and he presents for us an example and forgets his [own] creation. he says, "who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated

arNorm: قلۡ يحۡييها الذي انشاها اول مرهۖ وهو بكل خلۡق عليم
en: say, "he will give them life who produced them the first time; and he is, of all creation, knowing

arNorm: الذي جعل لكم من الشجر الۡاخۡضر نارا فاذا انتم منۡه توقدون
en: [it is] he who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite

arNorm: اوليۡس الذي خلق السموت والۡارۡض بقدر علي ان يخۡلق مثۡلهمۚ بلي وهو الۡخلق الۡعليم
en: is not he who created the heavens and the earth able to create the likes of them? yes, [it is so]; and he is the knowing creator

arNorm: انما امۡرهۥ اذا اراد شيۡا ان يقول لهۥ كن فيكون
en: his command is only when he intends a thing that he says to it, "be," and it is

arNorm: فسبۡحن الذي بيدهۦ ملكوت كل شيۡء واليۡه ترۡجعون
en: so exalted is he in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to him you will be returned

arNorm: والصفت صفا
en: by those [angels] lined up in rows

arNorm: فالزجرت زجۡرا
en: and those who drive [the clouds]

arNorm: فالتليت ذكۡرا
en: and those who recite the message

arNorm: ان الهكمۡ لوحد
en: indeed, your god is one

arNorm: رب السموت والۡارۡض وما بيۡنهما ورب الۡمشرق
en: lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and lord of the sunrises

arNorm: انا زينا السماء الدنۡيا بزينه الۡكواكب
en: indeed, we have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars

arNorm: وحفۡظا من كل شيۡطن مارد
en: and as protection against every rebellious devil

arNorm: لا يسمعون الي الۡملا الۡاعۡلي ويقۡذفون من كل جانب
en: [so] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side

arNorm: دحوراۖ ولهمۡ عذاب واصب
en: repelled; and for them is a constant punishment

arNorm: الا منۡ خطف الۡخطۡفه فاتۡبعهۥ شهاب ثاقب
en: except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness]

arNorm: فاسۡتفۡتهمۡ اهمۡ اشد خلۡقا ام منۡ خلقۡناۚ انا خلقۡنهم من طين لازبۭ
en: then inquire of them, [o muhammad], "are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] we have created?" indeed, we created men from sticky clay

arNorm: بلۡ عجبۡت ويسۡخرون
en: but you wonder, while they mock

arNorm: واذا ذكروا لا يذۡكرون
en: and when they are reminded, they remember not

arNorm: واذا راوۡا ءايه يسۡتسۡخرون
en: and when they see a sign, they ridicule

arNorm: وقالوا انۡ هذا الا سحۡر مبين
en: and say, "this is not but obvious magic

arNorm: اءذا متۡنا وكنا ترابا وعظما اءنا لمبۡعوثون
en: when we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected

arNorm: اوءاباؤنا الۡاولون
en: and our forefathers [as well]

arNorm: قلۡ نعمۡ وانتمۡ دخرون
en: say, "yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible

arNorm: فانما هي زجۡره وحده فاذا همۡ ينظرون
en: it will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing

arNorm: وقالوا يويۡلنا هذا يوۡم الدين
en: they will say, "o woe to us! this is the day of recompense

arNorm: هذا يوۡم الۡفصۡل الذي كنتم بهۦ تكذبون
en: [they will be told], "this is the day of judgement which you used to deny

arNorm: ۞احۡشروا الذين ظلموا وازۡوجهمۡ وما كانوا يعۡبدون
en: [the angels will be ordered], "gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship

arNorm: من دون الله فاهۡدوهمۡ الي صرط الۡجحيم
en: other than allah, and guide them to the path of hellfire

arNorm: وقفوهمۡۖ انهم مسۡولون
en: and stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned

arNorm: ما لكمۡ لا تناصرون
en: [they will be asked], "what is [wrong] with you? why do you not help each other

arNorm: بلۡ هم الۡيوۡم مسۡتسۡلمون
en: but they, that day, are in surrender

arNorm: واقۡبل بعۡضهمۡ علي بعۡض يتساءلون
en: and they will approach one another blaming each other

arNorm: قالوا انكمۡ كنتمۡ تاۡتوننا عن الۡيمين
en: they will say, "indeed, you used to come at us from the right

arNorm: قالوا بل لمۡ تكونوا مؤۡمنين
en: the oppressors will say, "rather, you [yourselves] were not believers

arNorm: وما كان لنا عليۡكم من سلۡطنۭۖ بلۡ كنتمۡ قوۡما طغين
en: and we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people

arNorm: فحق عليۡنا قوۡل ربناۖ انا لذائقون
en: so the word of our lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment]

arNorm: فاغۡويۡنكمۡ انا كنا غوين
en: and we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators

arNorm: فانهمۡ يوۡمئذ في الۡعذاب مشۡتركون
en: so indeed they, that day, will be sharing in the punishment

arNorm: انا كذلك نفۡعل بالۡمجۡرمين
en: indeed, that is how we deal with the criminals

arNorm: انهمۡ كانوا اذا قيل لهمۡ لا اله الا الله يسۡتكۡبرون
en: indeed they, when it was said to them, "there is no deity but allah," were arrogant

arNorm: ويقولون ائنا لتاركوا ءالهتنا لشاعر مجۡنونۭ
en: and were saying, "are we to leave our gods for a mad poet

arNorm: بلۡ جاء بالۡحق وصدق الۡمرۡسلين
en: rather, the prophet has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers

arNorm: انكمۡ لذائقوا الۡعذاب الۡاليم
en: indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment

arNorm: وما تجۡزوۡن الا ما كنتمۡ تعۡملون
en: and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do

arNorm: الا عباد الله الۡمخۡلصين
en: but not the chosen servants of allah

arNorm: اولئك لهمۡ رزۡق معۡلوم
en: those will have a provision determined

arNorm: فوكه وهم مكۡرمون
en: fruits; and they will be honored

arNorm: في جنت النعيم
en: in gardens of pleasure

arNorm: علي سرر متقبلين
en: on thrones facing one another

arNorm: يطاف عليۡهم بكاۡس من معينۭ
en: there will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring

arNorm: بيۡضاء لذه للشربين
en: white and delicious to the drinkers

arNorm: لا فيها غوۡل ولا همۡ عنۡها ينزفون
en: no bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated

arNorm: وعندهمۡ قصرت الطرۡف عين
en: and with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes

arNorm: كانهن بيۡض مكۡنون
en: as if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected

arNorm: فاقۡبل بعۡضهمۡ علي بعۡض يتساءلون
en: and they will approach one another, inquiring of each other

arNorm: قال قائل منۡهمۡ اني كان لي قرين
en: a speaker among them will say, "indeed, i had a companion [on earth]

arNorm: يقول اءنك لمن الۡمصدقين
en: who would say, 'are you indeed of those who believe

arNorm: اءذا متۡنا وكنا ترابا وعظما اءنا لمدينون
en: that when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed

arNorm: قال هلۡ انتم مطلعون
en: he will say, "would you [care to] look

arNorm: فاطلع فرءاه في سواء الۡجحيم
en: and he will look and see him in the midst of the hellfire

arNorm: قال تالله ان كدت لترۡدين
en: he will say, "by allah, you almost ruined me

arNorm: ولوۡلا نعۡمه ربي لكنت من الۡمحۡضرين
en: if not for the favor of my lord, i would have been of those brought in [to hell]

arNorm: افما نحۡن بميتين
en: then, are we not to die

arNorm: الا موۡتتنا الۡاولي وما نحۡن بمعذبين
en: except for our first death, and we will not be punished

arNorm: ان هذا لهو الۡفوۡز الۡعظيم
en: indeed, this is the great attainment

arNorm: لمثۡل هذا فلۡيعۡمل الۡعملون
en: for the like of this let the workers [on earth] work

arNorm: اذلك خيۡر نزلا امۡ شجره الزقوم
en: is paradise a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqum

arNorm: انا جعلۡنها فتۡنه للظلمين
en: indeed, we have made it a torment for the wrongdoers

arNorm: انها شجره تخۡرج في اصۡل الۡجحيم
en: indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the hellfire

arNorm: طلۡعها كانهۥ رءوس الشيطين
en: its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils

arNorm: فانهمۡ لاكلون منۡها فمالون منۡها الۡبطون
en: and indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies

arNorm: ثم ان لهمۡ عليۡها لشوۡبا منۡ حميم
en: then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water

arNorm: ثم ان مرۡجعهمۡ لالي الۡجحيم
en: then indeed, their return will be to the hellfire

arNorm: انهمۡ الۡفوۡا ءاباءهمۡ ضالين
en: indeed they found their fathers astray

arNorm: فهمۡ علي ءاثرهمۡ يهۡرعون
en: so they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps

arNorm: ولقدۡ ضل قبۡلهمۡ اكۡثر الۡاولين
en: and there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples

arNorm: ولقدۡ ارۡسلۡنا فيهم منذرين
en: and we had already sent among them warners

arNorm: فانظرۡ كيۡف كان عقبه الۡمنذرين
en: then look how was the end of those who were warned

arNorm: الا عباد الله الۡمخۡلصين
en: but not the chosen servants of allah

arNorm: ولقدۡ نادينا نوح فلنعۡم الۡمجيبون
en: and noah had certainly called us, and [we are] the best of responders

arNorm: ونجيۡنه واهۡلهۥ من الۡكرۡب الۡعظيم
en: and we saved him and his family from the great affliction

arNorm: وجعلۡنا ذريتهۥ هم الۡباقين
en: and we made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]

arNorm: وتركۡنا عليۡه في الۡاخرين
en: and left for him [favorable mention] among later generations

arNorm: سلم علي نوح في الۡعلمين
en: peace upon noah among the worlds

arNorm: انا كذلك نجۡزي الۡمحۡسنين
en: indeed, we thus reward the doers of good

arNorm: انهۥ منۡ عبادنا الۡمؤۡمنين
en: indeed, he was of our believing servants

arNorm: ثم اغۡرقۡنا الۡاخرين
en: then we drowned the disbelievers

arNorm: ۞وان من شيعتهۦ لابۡرهيم
en: and indeed, among his kind was abraham

arNorm: اذۡ جاء ربهۥ بقلۡب سليم
en: when he came to his lord with a sound heart

arNorm: اذۡ قال لابيه وقوۡمهۦ ماذا تعۡبدون
en: [and] when he said to his father and his people, "what do you worship

arNorm: ائفۡكا ءالهه دون الله تريدون
en: is it falsehood [as] gods other than allah you desire

arNorm: فما ظنكم برب الۡعلمين
en: then what is your thought about the lord of the worlds

arNorm: فنظر نظۡره في النجوم
en: and he cast a look at the stars

arNorm: فقال اني سقيم
en: and said, "indeed, i am [about to be] ill

arNorm: فتولوۡا عنۡه مدۡبرين
en: so they turned away from him, departing

arNorm: فراغ الي ءالهتهمۡ فقال الا تاۡكلون
en: then he turned to their gods and said, "do you not eat

arNorm: ما لكمۡ لا تنطقون
en: what is [wrong] with you that you do not speak

arNorm: فراغ عليۡهمۡ ضرۡبۢا بالۡيمين
en: and he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand

arNorm: فاقۡبلوا اليۡه يزفون
en: then the people came toward him, hastening

arNorm: قال اتعۡبدون ما تنۡحتون
en: he said, "do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve

arNorm: والله خلقكمۡ وما تعۡملون
en: while allah created you and that which you do

arNorm: قالوا ابۡنوا لهۥ بنۡينا فالۡقوه في الۡجحيم
en: they said, "construct for him a furnace and throw him into the burning fire

arNorm: فارادوا بهۦ كيۡدا فجعلۡنهم الۡاسۡفلين
en: and they intended for him a plan, but we made them the most debased

arNorm: وقال اني ذاهب الي ربي سيهۡدين
en: and [then] he said, "indeed, i will go to [where i am ordered by] my lord; he will guide me

arNorm: رب هبۡ لي من الصلحين
en: my lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous

arNorm: فبشرۡنه بغلم حليم
en: so we gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy

arNorm: فلما بلغ معه السعۡي قال يبني اني اري في الۡمنام اني اذۡبحك فانظرۡ ماذا تريۚ قال يابت افۡعلۡ ما تؤۡمرۖ ستجدني ان شاء الله من الصبرين
en: and when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "o my son, indeed i have seen in a dream that i [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." he said, "o my father, do as you are commanded. you will find me, if allah wills, of the steadfast

arNorm: فلما اسۡلما وتلهۥ للۡجبين
en: and when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead

arNorm: ونديۡنه ان يابۡرهيم
en: we called to him, "o abraham

arNorm: قدۡ صدقۡت الرءۡياۚ انا كذلك نجۡزي الۡمحۡسنين
en: you have fulfilled the vision." indeed, we thus reward the doers of good

arNorm: ان هذا لهو الۡبلؤا الۡمبين
en: indeed, this was the clear trial

arNorm: وفديۡنه بذبۡح عظيم
en: and we ransomed him with a great sacrifice

arNorm: وتركۡنا عليۡه في الۡاخرين
en: and we left for him [favorable mention] among later generations

arNorm: سلم علي ابۡرهيم
en: peace upon abraham

arNorm: كذلك نجۡزي الۡمحۡسنين
en: indeed, we thus reward the doers of good

arNorm: انهۥ منۡ عبادنا الۡمؤۡمنين
en: indeed, he was of our believing servants

arNorm: وبشرۡنه باسۡحق نبيا من الصلحين
en: and we gave him good tidings of isaac, a prophet from among the righteous

arNorm: وبركۡنا عليۡه وعلي اسۡحقۚ ومن ذريتهما محۡسن وظالم لنفۡسهۦ مبين
en: and we blessed him and isaac. but among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself

arNorm: ولقدۡ مننا علي موسي وهرون
en: and we did certainly confer favor upon moses and aaron

arNorm: ونجيۡنهما وقوۡمهما من الۡكرۡب الۡعظيم
en: and we saved them and their people from the great affliction

arNorm: ونصرۡنهمۡ فكانوا هم الۡغلبين
en: and we supported them so it was they who overcame

arNorm: وءاتيۡنهما الۡكتب الۡمسۡتبين
en: and we gave them the explicit scripture

arNorm: وهديۡنهما الصرط الۡمسۡتقيم
en: and we guided them on the straight path

arNorm: وتركۡنا عليۡهما في الۡاخرين
en: and we left for them [favorable mention] among later generations

arNorm: سلم علي موسي وهرون
en: peace upon moses and aaron

arNorm: انا كذلك نجۡزي الۡمحۡسنين
en: indeed, we thus reward the doers of good

arNorm: انهما منۡ عبادنا الۡمؤۡمنين
en: indeed, they were of our believing servants

arNorm: وان الۡياس لمن الۡمرۡسلين
en: and indeed, elias was from among the messengers

arNorm: اذۡ قال لقوۡمهۦ الا تتقون
en: when he said to his people, "will you not fear allah

arNorm: اتدۡعون بعۡلا وتذرون احۡسن الۡخلقين
en: do you call upon ba'l and leave the best of creators

arNorm: الله ربكمۡ ورب ءابائكم الۡاولين
en: allah, your lord and the lord of your first forefathers

arNorm: فكذبوه فانهمۡ لمحۡضرون
en: and they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment]

arNorm: الا عباد الله الۡمخۡلصين
en: except the chosen servants of allah

arNorm: وتركۡنا عليۡه في الۡاخرين
en: and we left for him [favorable mention] among later generations

arNorm: سلم علي الۡ ياسين
en: peace upon elias

arNorm: انا كذلك نجۡزي الۡمحۡسنين
en: indeed, we thus reward the doers of good

arNorm: انهۥ منۡ عبادنا الۡمؤۡمنين
en: indeed, he was of our believing servants

arNorm: وان لوطا لمن الۡمرۡسلين
en: and indeed, lot was among the messengers

arNorm: اذۡ نجيۡنه واهۡلهۥ اجۡمعين
en: [so mention] when we saved him and his family, all

arNorm: الا عجوزا في الۡغبرين
en: except his wife among those who remained [with the evildoers]

arNorm: ثم دمرۡنا الۡاخرين
en: then we destroyed the others

arNorm: وانكمۡ لتمرون عليۡهم مصۡبحين
en: and indeed, you pass by them in the morning

arNorm: وباليۡلۚ افلا تعۡقلون
en: and at night. then will you not use reason

arNorm: وان يونس لمن الۡمرۡسلين
en: and indeed, jonah was among the messengers

arNorm: اذۡ ابق الي الۡفلۡك الۡمشۡحون
en: [mention] when he ran away to the laden ship

arNorm: فساهم فكان من الۡمدۡحضين
en: and he drew lots and was among the losers

arNorm: فالۡتقمه الۡحوت وهو مليم
en: then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy

arNorm: فلوۡلا انهۥ كان من الۡمسبحين
en: and had he not been of those who exalt allah

arNorm: للبث في بطۡنهۦ الي يوۡم يبۡعثون
en: he would have remained inside its belly until the day they are resurrected

arNorm: ۞فنبذۡنه بالۡعراء وهو سقيم
en: but we threw him onto the open shore while he was ill

arNorm: وانۢبتۡنا عليۡه شجره من يقۡطين
en: and we caused to grow over him a gourd vine

arNorm: وارۡسلۡنه الي مائه الۡف اوۡ يزيدون
en: and we sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more

arNorm: فامنوا فمتعۡنهمۡ الي حين
en: and they believed, so we gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time

arNorm: فاسۡتفۡتهمۡ الربك الۡبنات ولهم الۡبنون
en: so inquire of them, [o muhammad], "does your lord have daughters while they have sons

arNorm: امۡ خلقۡنا الۡملئكه انثا وهمۡ شهدون
en: or did we create the angels as females while they were witnesses

arNorm: الا انهم منۡ افۡكهمۡ ليقولون
en: unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say

arNorm: ولد الله وانهمۡ لكذبون
en: allah has begotten," and indeed, they are liars

arNorm: اصۡطفي الۡبنات علي الۡبنين
en: has he chosen daughters over sons

arNorm: ما لكمۡ كيۡف تحۡكمون
en: what is [wrong] with you? how do you make judgement

arNorm: افلا تذكرون
en: then will you not be reminded

arNorm: امۡ لكمۡ سلۡطن مبين
en: or do you have a clear authority

arNorm: فاۡتوا بكتبكمۡ ان كنتمۡ صدقين
en: then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful

arNorm: وجعلوا بيۡنهۥ وبيۡن الۡجنه نسباۚ ولقدۡ علمت الۡجنه انهمۡ لمحۡضرون
en: and they have claimed between him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought to [punishment]

arNorm: سبۡحن الله عما يصفون
en: exalted is allah above what they describe

arNorm: الا عباد الله الۡمخۡلصين
en: except the chosen servants of allah [who do not share in that sin]

arNorm: فانكمۡ وما تعۡبدون
en: so indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship

arNorm: ما انتمۡ عليۡه بفتنين
en: you cannot tempt [anyone] away from him

arNorm: الا منۡ هو صال الۡجحيم
en: except he who is to [enter and] burn in the hellfire

arNorm: ومامنا الا لهۥ مقام معۡلوم
en: [the angels say], "there is not among us any except that he has a known position

arNorm: وانا لنحۡن الصافون
en: and indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer]

arNorm: وانا لنحۡن الۡمسبحون
en: and indeed, we are those who exalt allah

arNorm: وان كانوا ليقولون
en: and indeed, the disbelievers used to say

arNorm: لوۡ ان عندنا ذكۡرا من الۡاولين
en: if we had a message from [those of] the former peoples

arNorm: لكنا عباد الله الۡمخۡلصين
en: we would have been the chosen servants of allah

arNorm: فكفروا بهۦۖ فسوۡف يعۡلمون
en: but they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know

arNorm: ولقدۡ سبقتۡ كلمتنا لعبادنا الۡمرۡسلين
en: and our word has already preceded for our servants, the messengers

arNorm: انهمۡ لهم الۡمنصورون
en: [that] indeed, they would be those given victory

arNorm: وان جندنا لهم الۡغلبون
en: and [that] indeed, our soldiers will be those who overcome

arNorm: فتول عنۡهمۡ حتي حين
en: so, [o muhammad], leave them for a time

arNorm: وابۡصرۡهمۡ فسوۡف يبۡصرون
en: and see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see

arNorm: افبعذابنا يسۡتعۡجلون
en: then for our punishment are they impatient

arNorm: فاذا نزل بساحتهمۡ فساء صباح الۡمنذرين
en: but when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned

arNorm: وتول عنۡهمۡ حتي حين
en: and leave them for a time

arNorm: وابۡصرۡ فسوۡف يبۡصرون
en: and see, for they are going to see

arNorm: سبۡحن ربك رب الۡعزه عما يصفون
en: exalted is your lord, the lord of might, above what they describe

arNorm: وسلم علي الۡمرۡسلين
en: and peace upon the messengers

arNorm: والۡحمۡد لله رب الۡعلمين
en: and praise to allah, lord of the worlds

arNorm: صۚ والۡقرۡءان ذي الذكۡر
en: sad. by the qur'an containing reminder

arNorm: بل الذين كفروا في عزه وشقاق
en: but those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension

arNorm: كمۡ اهۡلكۡنا من قبۡلهم من قرۡن فنادوا ولات حين مناص
en: how many a generation have we destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape

arNorm: وعجبوا ان جاءهم منذر منۡهمۡۖ وقال الۡكفرون هذا سحر كذاب
en: and they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves. and the disbelievers say, "this is a magician and a liar

arNorm: اجعل الۡالهه الها وحداۖ ان هذا لشيۡء عجاب
en: has he made the gods [only] one god? indeed, this is a curious thing

arNorm: وانطلق الۡملا منۡهمۡ ان امۡشوا واصۡبروا علي ءالهتكمۡۖ ان هذا لشيۡء يراد
en: and the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. indeed, this is a thing intended

arNorm: ما سمعۡنا بهذا في الۡمله الۡاخره انۡ هذا الا اخۡتلق
en: we have not heard of this in the latest religion. this is not but a fabrication

arNorm: اءنزل عليۡه الذكۡر منۢ بيۡنناۚ بلۡ همۡ في شك من ذكۡريۚ بل لما يذوقوا عذاب
en: has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" rather, they are in doubt about my message. rather, they have not yet tasted my punishment

arNorm: امۡ عندهمۡ خزائن رحۡمه ربك الۡعزيز الۡوهاب
en: or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your lord, the exalted in might, the bestower

arNorm: امۡ لهم ملۡك السموت والۡارۡض وما بيۡنهماۖ فلۡيرۡتقوا في الۡاسۡبب
en: or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? then let them ascend through [any] ways of access

arNorm: جند ما هنالك مهۡزوم من الۡاحۡزاب
en: [they are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers]

arNorm: كذبتۡ قبۡلهمۡ قوۡم نوح وعاد وفرۡعوۡن ذو الۡاوۡتاد
en: the people of noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] 'aad and pharaoh, the owner of stakes

arNorm: وثمود وقوۡم لوط واصۡحب لۡيۡكهۚ اولئك الۡاحۡزاب
en: and [the tribe of] thamud and the people of lot and the companions of the thicket. those are the companies

arNorm: ان كل الا كذب الرسل فحق عقاب
en: each of them denied the messengers, so my penalty was justified

arNorm: وما ينظر هؤلاء الا صيۡحه وحده ما لها من فواق
en: and these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the horn]; for it there will be no delay

arNorm: وقالوا ربنا عجل لنا قطنا قبۡل يوۡم الۡحساب
en: and they say, "our lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the day of account

arNorm: اصۡبرۡ علي ما يقولون واذۡكرۡ عبۡدنا داوۥد ذا الۡايۡدۖ انهۥ اواب
en: be patient over what they say and remember our servant, david, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to allah]

arNorm: انا سخرۡنا الۡجبال معهۥ يسبحۡن بالۡعشي والۡاشۡراق
en: indeed, we subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [allah] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise

arNorm: والطيۡر محۡشورهۖ كل لهۥ اواب
en: and the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises]

arNorm: وشددۡنا ملۡكهۥ وءاتيۡنه الۡحكۡمه وفصۡل الۡخطاب
en: and we strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech

arNorm: ۞وهلۡ اتيك نبؤا الۡخصۡم اذۡ تسوروا الۡمحۡراب
en: and has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber

arNorm: اذۡ دخلوا علي داوۥد ففزع منۡهمۡۖ قالوا لا تخفۡۖ خصۡمان بغي بعۡضنا علي بعۡض فاحۡكم بيۡننا بالۡحق ولا تشۡططۡ واهۡدنا الي سواء الصرط
en: when they entered upon david and he was alarmed by them? they said, "fear not. [we are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path

arNorm: ان هذا اخي لهۥ تسۡع وتسۡعون نعۡجه ولي نعۡجه وحده فقال اكۡفلۡنيها وعزني في الۡخطاب
en: indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and i have one ewe; so he said, 'entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech

arNorm: قال لقدۡ ظلمك بسؤال نعۡجتك الي نعاجهۦۖ وان كثيرا من الۡخلطاء ليبۡغي بعۡضهمۡ علي بعۡض الا الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت وقليل ما همۡۗ وظن داوۥد انما فتنه فاسۡتغۡفر ربهۥ وخرۤ راكعاۤ واناب۩
en: [david] said, "he has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. and indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." and david became certain that we had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to allah]

arNorm: فغفرۡنا لهۥ ذلكۖ وان لهۥ عندنا لزلۡفي وحسۡن ماب
en: so we forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to us and a good place of return

arNorm: يداوۥد انا جعلۡنك خليفه في الۡارۡض فاحۡكم بيۡن الناس بالۡحق ولا تتبع الۡهوي فيضلك عن سبيل اللهۚ ان الذين يضلون عن سبيل الله لهمۡ عذاب شديدۢ بما نسوا يوۡم الۡحساب
en: [we said], "o david, indeed we have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of allah." indeed, those who go astray from the way of allah will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the day of account

arNorm: وما خلقۡنا السماء والۡارۡض وما بيۡنهما بطلاۚ ذلك ظن الذين كفرواۚ فويۡل للذين كفروا من النار
en: and we did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. that is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the fire

arNorm: امۡ نجۡعل الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت كالۡمفۡسدين في الۡارۡض امۡ نجۡعل الۡمتقين كالۡفجار
en: or should we treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? or should we treat those who fear allah like the wicked

arNorm: كتب انزلۡنه اليۡك مبرك ليدبروا ءايتهۦ وليتذكر اولوا الۡالۡبب
en: [this is] a blessed book which we have revealed to you, [o muhammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded

arNorm: ووهبۡنا لداوۥد سليۡمنۚ نعۡم الۡعبۡد انهۥ اواب
en: and to david we gave solomon. an excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to allah]

arNorm: اذۡ عرض عليۡه بالۡعشي الصفنت الۡجياد
en: [mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses

arNorm: فقال اني احۡببۡت حب الۡخيۡر عن ذكۡر ربي حتي توارتۡ بالۡحجاب
en: and he said, "indeed, i gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my lord until the sun disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]

arNorm: ردوها عليۖ فطفق مسۡحۢا بالسوق والۡاعۡناق
en: [he said], "return them to me," and set about striking [their] legs and necks

arNorm: ولقدۡ فتنا سليۡمن والۡقيۡنا علي كرۡسيهۦ جسدا ثم اناب
en: and we certainly tried solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned

arNorm: قال رب اغۡفرۡ لي وهبۡ لي ملۡكا لا ينۢبغي لاحد منۢ بعۡديۖ انك انت الۡوهاب
en: he said, "my lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. indeed, you are the bestower

arNorm: فسخرۡنا له الريح تجۡري بامۡرهۦ رخاء حيۡث اصاب
en: so we subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed

arNorm: والشيطين كل بناء وغواص
en: and [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver

arNorm: وءاخرين مقرنين في الۡاصۡفاد
en: and others bound together in shackles

arNorm: هذا عطاؤنا فامۡننۡ اوۡ امۡسكۡ بغيۡر حساب
en: [we said], "this is our gift, so grant or withhold without account

arNorm: وان لهۥ عندنا لزلۡفي وحسۡن ماب
en: and indeed, for him is nearness to us and a good place of return

arNorm: واذۡكرۡ عبۡدنا ايوب اذۡ نادي ربهۥ اني مسني الشيۡطن بنصۡب وعذاب
en: and remember our servant job, when he called to his lord, "indeed, satan has touched me with hardship and torment

arNorm: ارۡكضۡ برجۡلكۖ هذا مغۡتسلۢ بارد وشراب
en: [so he was told], "strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for] a cool bath and drink

arNorm: ووهبۡنا لهۥ اهۡلهۥ ومثۡلهم معهمۡ رحۡمه منا وذكۡري لاولي الۡالۡبب
en: and we granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from us and a reminder for those of understanding

arNorm: وخذۡ بيدك ضغۡثا فاضۡرب بهۦ ولا تحۡنثۡۗ انا وجدۡنه صابراۚ نعۡم الۡعبۡد انهۥ اواب
en: [we said], "and take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath." indeed, we found him patient, an excellent servant. indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to allah]

arNorm: واذۡكرۡ عبدنا ابۡرهيم واسۡحق ويعۡقوب اولي الۡايۡدي والۡابۡصر
en: and remember our servants, abraham, isaac and jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision

arNorm: انا اخۡلصۡنهم بخالصه ذكۡري الدار
en: indeed, we chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the hereafter]

arNorm: وانهمۡ عندنا لمن الۡمصۡطفيۡن الۡاخۡيار
en: and indeed they are, to us, among the chosen and outstanding

arNorm: واذۡكرۡ اسۡمعيل والۡيسع وذا الۡكفۡلۖ وكل من الۡاخۡيار
en: and remember ishmael, elisha and dhul-kifl, and all are among the outstanding

arNorm: هذا ذكۡرۚ وان للۡمتقين لحسۡن ماب
en: this is a reminder. and indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return

arNorm: جنت عدۡن مفتحه لهم الۡابۡوب
en: gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them

arNorm: متكين فيها يدۡعون فيها بفكهه كثيره وشراب
en: reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink

arNorm: ۞وعندهمۡ قصرت الطرۡف اتۡراب
en: and with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age

arNorm: هذا ما توعدون ليوۡم الۡحساب
en: this is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the day of account

arNorm: ان هذا لرزۡقنا ما لهۥ من نفاد
en: indeed, this is our provision; for it there is no depletion

arNorm: هذاۚ وان للطغين لشر ماب
en: this [is so]. but indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return

arNorm: جهنم يصۡلوۡنها فبئۡس الۡمهاد
en: hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place

arNorm: هذا فلۡيذوقوه حميم وغساق
en: this - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence

arNorm: وءاخر من شكۡلهۦ ازۡوج
en: and other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds

arNorm: هذا فوۡج مقۡتحم معكمۡ لا مرۡحبۢا بهمۡۚ انهمۡ صالوا النار
en: [its inhabitants will say], "this is a company bursting in with you. no welcome for them. indeed, they will burn in the fire

arNorm: قالوا بلۡ انتمۡ لا مرۡحبۢا بكمۡۖ انتمۡ قدمۡتموه لناۖ فبئۡس الۡقرار
en: they will say, "nor you! no welcome for you. you, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement

arNorm: قالوا ربنا من قدم لنا هذا فزدۡه عذابا ضعۡفا في النار
en: they will say, "our lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the fire

arNorm: وقالوا ما لنا لا نري رجالا كنا نعدهم من الۡاشۡرار
en: and they will say, "why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst

arNorm: اتخذۡنهمۡ سخۡريا امۡ زاغتۡ عنۡهم الۡابۡصر
en: is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them

arNorm: ان ذلك لحق تخاصم اهۡل النار
en: indeed, that is truth - the quarreling of the people of the fire

arNorm: قلۡ انما انا۠ منذرۖ وما منۡ اله الا الله الۡوحد الۡقهار
en: say, [o muhammad], "i am only a warner, and there is not any deity except allah, the one, the prevailing

arNorm: رب السموت والۡارۡض وما بيۡنهما الۡعزيز الۡغفر
en: lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the exalted in might, the perpetual forgiver

arNorm: قلۡ هو نبؤا عظيم
en: say, "it is great news

arNorm: انتمۡ عنۡه معۡرضون
en: from which you turn away

arNorm: ما كان لي منۡ علۡمۭ بالۡملا الۡاعۡلي اذۡ يخۡتصمون
en: i had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of adam]

arNorm: ان يوحي الي الا انما انا۠ نذير مبين
