en: and how many a city was insolent toward the command of its lord and his messengers, so we took it to severe account and punished it with a terrible punishment

arNorm: فذاقتۡ وبال امۡرها وكان عقبه امۡرها خسۡرا
en: and it tasted the bad consequence of its affair, and the outcome of its affair was loss

arNorm: اعد الله لهمۡ عذابا شديداۖ فاتقوا الله ياولي الۡالۡبب الذين ءامنواۚ قدۡ انزل الله اليۡكمۡ ذكۡرا
en: allah has prepared for them a severe punishment; so fear allah, o you of understanding who have believed. allah has sent down to you the qur'an

arNorm: رسولا يتۡلوا عليۡكمۡ ءايت الله مبينت ليخۡرج الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت من الظلمت الي النورۚ ومن يؤۡمنۢ بالله ويعۡملۡ صلحا يدۡخلۡه جنت تجۡري من تحۡتها الۡانۡهر خلدين فيها ابداۖ قدۡ احۡسن الله لهۥ رزۡقا
en: [he sent] a messenger [muhammad] reciting to you the distinct verses of allah that he may bring out those who believe and do righteous deeds from darknesses into the light. and whoever believes in allah and does righteousness - he will admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein forever. allah will have perfected for him a provision

arNorm: الله الذي خلق سبۡع سموت ومن الۡارۡض مثۡلهنۖ يتنزل الۡامۡر بيۡنهن لتعۡلموا ان الله علي كل شيۡء قدير وان الله قدۡ احاط بكل شيۡء علۡمۢا
en: it is allah who has created seven heavens and of the earth, the like of them. [his] command descends among them so you may know that allah is over all things competent and that allah has encompassed all things in knowledge

arNorm: يايها النبي لم تحرم ما احل الله لكۖ تبۡتغي مرۡضات ازۡوجكۚ والله غفور رحيم
en: o prophet, why do you prohibit [yourself from] what allah has made lawful for you, seeking the approval of your wives? and allah is forgiving and merciful

arNorm: قدۡ فرض الله لكمۡ تحله ايۡمنكمۡۚ والله موۡليكمۡۖ وهو الۡعليم الۡحكيم
en: allah has already ordained for you [muslims] the dissolution of your oaths. and allah is your protector, and he is the knowing, the wise

arNorm: واذۡ اسر النبي الي بعۡض ازۡوجهۦ حديثا فلما نباتۡ بهۦ واظۡهره الله عليۡه عرف بعۡضهۥ واعۡرض عنۢ بعۡضۖ فلما نباها بهۦ قالتۡ منۡ انۢباك هذاۖ قال نباني الۡعليم الۡخبير
en: and [remember] when the prophet confided to one of his wives a statement; and when she informed [another] of it and allah showed it to him, he made known part of it and ignored a part. and when he informed her about it, she said, "who told you this?" he said, "i was informed by the knowing, the acquainted

arNorm: ان تتوبا الي الله فقدۡ صغتۡ قلوبكماۖ وان تظهرا عليۡه فان الله هو موۡليه وجبۡريل وصلح الۡمؤۡمنينۖ والۡملئكه بعۡد ذلك ظهير
en: if you two [wives] repent to allah, [it is best], for your hearts have deviated. but if you cooperate against him - then indeed allah is his protector, and gabriel and the righteous of the believers and the angels, moreover, are [his] assistants

arNorm: عسي ربهۥ ان طلقكن ان يبۡدلهۥ ازۡوجا خيۡرا منكن مسۡلمت مؤۡمنت قنتت تئبت عبدت سئحت ثيبت وابۡكارا
en: perhaps his lord, if he divorced you [all], would substitute for him wives better than you - submitting [to allah], believing, devoutly obedient, repentant, worshipping, and traveling - [ones] previously married and virgins

arNorm: يايها الذين ءامنوا قوا انفسكمۡ واهۡليكمۡ نارا وقودها الناس والۡحجاره عليۡها ملئكه غلاظ شداد لا يعۡصون الله ما امرهمۡ ويفۡعلون ما يؤۡمرون
en: o you who have believed, protect yourselves and your families from a fire whose fuel is people and stones, over which are [appointed] angels, harsh and severe; they do not disobey allah in what he commands them but do what they are commanded

arNorm: يايها الذين كفروا لا تعۡتذروا الۡيوۡمۖ انما تجۡزوۡن ما كنتمۡ تعۡملون
en: o you who have disbelieved, make no excuses that day. you will only be recompensed for what you used to do

arNorm: يايها الذين ءامنوا توبوا الي الله توۡبه نصوحا عسي ربكمۡ ان يكفر عنكمۡ سياتكمۡ ويدۡخلكمۡ جنت تجۡري من تحۡتها الۡانۡهر يوۡم لا يخۡزي الله النبي والذين ءامنوا معهۥۖ نورهمۡ يسۡعي بيۡن ايۡديهمۡ وبايۡمنهمۡ يقولون ربنا اتۡممۡ لنا نورنا واغۡفرۡ لناۖ انك علي كل شيۡء قدير
en: o you who have believed, repent to allah with sincere repentance. perhaps your lord will remove from you your misdeeds and admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow [on] the day when allah will not disgrace the prophet and those who believed with him. their light will proceed before them and on their right; they will say, "our lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. indeed, you are over all things competent

arNorm: يايها النبي جهد الۡكفار والۡمنفقين واغۡلظۡ عليۡهمۡۚ وماۡويهمۡ جهنمۖ وبئۡس الۡمصير
en: o prophet, strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites and be harsh upon them. and their refuge is hell, and wretched is the destination

arNorm: ضرب الله مثلا للذين كفروا امۡرات نوح وامۡرات لوطۖ كانتا تحۡت عبۡديۡن منۡ عبادنا صلحيۡن فخانتاهما فلمۡ يغۡنيا عنۡهما من الله شيۡا وقيل ادۡخلا النار مع الدخلين
en: allah presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of noah and the wife of lot. they were under two of our righteous servants but betrayed them, so those prophets did not avail them from allah at all, and it was said, "enter the fire with those who enter

arNorm: وضرب الله مثلا للذين ءامنوا امۡرات فرۡعوۡن اذۡ قالتۡ رب ابۡن لي عندك بيۡتا في الۡجنه ونجني من فرۡعوۡن وعملهۦ ونجني من الۡقوۡم الظلمين
en: and allah presents an example of those who believed: the wife of pharaoh, when she said, "my lord, build for me near you a house in paradise and save me from pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people

arNorm: ومرۡيم ابۡنت عمۡرن التي احۡصنتۡ فرۡجها فنفخۡنا فيه من روحنا وصدقتۡ بكلمت ربها وكتبهۦ وكانتۡ من الۡقنتين
en: and [the example of] mary, the daughter of 'imran, who guarded her chastity, so we blew into [her garment] through our angel, and she believed in the words of her lord and his scriptures and was of the devoutly obedient

arNorm: تبرك الذي بيده الۡملۡك وهو علي كل شيۡء قدير
en: blessed is he in whose hand is dominion, and he is over all things competent

arNorm: الذي خلق الۡموۡت والۡحيوه ليبۡلوكمۡ ايكمۡ احۡسن عملاۚ وهو الۡعزيز الۡغفور
en: [he] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and he is the exalted in might, the forgiving

arNorm: الذي خلق سبۡع سموت طباقاۖ ما تري في خلۡق الرحۡمن من تفوتۖ فارۡجع الۡبصر هلۡ تري من فطور
en: [and] who created seven heavens in layers. you do not see in the creation of the most merciful any inconsistency. so return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks

arNorm: ثم ارۡجع الۡبصر كرتيۡن ينقلبۡ اليۡك الۡبصر خاسئا وهو حسير
en: then return [your] vision twice again. [your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued

arNorm: ولقدۡ زينا السماء الدنۡيا بمصبيح وجعلۡنها رجوما للشيطينۖ واعۡتدۡنا لهمۡ عذاب السعير
en: and we have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with stars and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the blaze

arNorm: وللذين كفروا بربهمۡ عذاب جهنمۖ وبئۡس الۡمصير
en: and for those who disbelieved in their lord is the punishment of hell, and wretched is the destination

arNorm: اذا الۡقوا فيها سمعوا لها شهيقا وهي تفور
en: when they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up

arNorm: تكاد تميز من الۡغيۡظۖ كلما الۡقي فيها فوۡج سالهمۡ خزنتها المۡ ياۡتكمۡ نذير
en: it almost bursts with rage. every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "did there not come to you a warner

arNorm: قالوا بلي قدۡ جاءنا نذير فكذبۡنا وقلۡنا ما نزل الله من شيۡء انۡ انتمۡ الا في ضلل كبير
en: they will say," yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'allah has not sent down anything. you are not but in great error

arNorm: وقالوا لوۡ كنا نسۡمع اوۡ نعۡقل ما كنا في اصۡحب السعير
en: and they will say, "if only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the blaze

arNorm: فاعۡترفوا بذنۢبهمۡ فسحۡقا لاصۡحب السعير
en: and they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the blaze

arNorm: ان الذين يخۡشوۡن ربهم بالۡغيۡب لهم مغۡفره واجۡر كبير
en: indeed, those who fear their lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward

arNorm: واسروا قوۡلكمۡ او اجۡهروا بهۦۖ انهۥ عليمۢ بذات الصدور
en: and conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, he is knowing of that within the breasts

arNorm: الا يعۡلم منۡ خلق وهو اللطيف الۡخبير
en: does he who created not know, while he is the subtle, the acquainted

arNorm: هو الذي جعل لكم الۡارۡض ذلولا فامۡشوا في مناكبها وكلوا من رزۡقهۦۖ واليۡه النشور
en: it is he who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of his provision - and to him is the resurrection

arNorm: ءامنتم من في السماء ان يخۡسف بكم الۡارۡض فاذا هي تمور
en: do you feel secure that he who [holds authority] in the heaven would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway

arNorm: امۡ امنتم من في السماء ان يرۡسل عليۡكمۡ حاصباۖ فستعۡلمون كيۡف نذير
en: or do you feel secure that he who [holds authority] in the heaven would not send against you a storm of stones? then you would know how [severe] was my warning

arNorm: ولقدۡ كذب الذين من قبۡلهمۡ فكيۡف كان نكير
en: and already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was my reproach

arNorm: اولمۡ يروۡا الي الطيۡر فوۡقهمۡ صفت ويقۡبضۡنۚ ما يمۡسكهن الا الرحۡمنۚ انهۥ بكل شيۡءۭ بصير
en: do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? none holds them [aloft] except the most merciful. indeed he is, of all things, seeing

arNorm: امنۡ هذا الذي هو جند لكمۡ ينصركم من دون الرحۡمنۚ ان الۡكفرون الا في غرور
en: or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the most merciful? the disbelievers are not but in delusion

arNorm: امنۡ هذا الذي يرۡزقكمۡ انۡ امۡسك رزۡقهۥۚ بل لجوا في عتو ونفور
en: or who is it that could provide for you if he withheld his provision? but they have persisted in insolence and aversion

arNorm: افمن يمۡشي مكبا علي وجۡههۦ اهۡدي امن يمۡشي سويا علي صرط مسۡتقيم
en: then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path

arNorm: قلۡ هو الذي انشاكمۡ وجعل لكم السمۡع والۡابۡصر والۡافۡدهۚ قليلا ما تشۡكرون
en: say, "it is he who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful

arNorm: قلۡ هو الذي ذراكمۡ في الۡارۡض واليۡه تحۡشرون
en: say, "it is he who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to him you will be gathered

arNorm: ويقولون متي هذا الۡوعۡد ان كنتمۡ صدقين
en: and they say, "when is this promise, if you should be truthful

arNorm: قلۡ انما الۡعلۡم عند الله وانما انا۠ نذير مبين
en: say, "the knowledge is only with allah, and i am only a clear warner

arNorm: فلما راوۡه زلۡفه سيتۡ وجوه الذين كفروا وقيل هذا الذي كنتم بهۦ تدعون
en: but when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "this is that for which you used to call

arNorm: قلۡ ارءيۡتمۡ انۡ اهۡلكني الله ومن معي اوۡ رحمنا فمن يجير الۡكفرين منۡ عذاب اليم
en: say, [o muhammad], "have you considered: whether allah should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment

arNorm: قلۡ هو الرحۡمن ءامنا بهۦ وعليۡه توكلۡناۖ فستعۡلمون منۡ هو في ضلل مبين
en: say, "he is the most merciful; we have believed in him, and upon him we have relied. and you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error

arNorm: قلۡ ارءيۡتمۡ انۡ اصۡبح ماؤكمۡ غوۡرا فمن ياۡتيكم بماء معينۭ
en: say, "have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water

arNorm: نۚ والۡقلم وما يسۡطرون
en: nun. by the pen and what they inscribe

arNorm: ما انت بنعۡمه ربك بمجۡنون
en: you are not, [o muhammad], by the favor of your lord, a madman

arNorm: وان لك لاجۡرا غيۡر ممۡنون
en: and indeed, for you is a reward uninterrupted

arNorm: وانك لعلي خلق عظيم
en: and indeed, you are of a great moral character

arNorm: فستبۡصر ويبۡصرون
en: so you will see and they will see

arNorm: باييكم الۡمفۡتون
en: which of you is the afflicted [by a devil]

arNorm: ان ربك هو اعۡلم بمن ضل عن سبيلهۦ وهو اعۡلم بالۡمهۡتدين
en: indeed, your lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from his way, and he is most knowing of the [rightly] guided

arNorm: فلا تطع الۡمكذبين
en: then do not obey the deniers

arNorm: ودوا لوۡ تدۡهن فيدۡهنون
en: they wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you]

arNorm: ولا تطعۡ كل حلاف مهين
en: and do not obey every worthless habitual swearer

arNorm: هماز مشاءۭ بنميم
en: [and] scorner, going about with malicious gossip

arNorm: مناع للۡخيۡر معۡتد اثيم
en: a preventer of good, transgressing and sinful

arNorm: عتلۭ بعۡد ذلك زنيم
en: cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender

arNorm: ان كان ذا مال وبنين
en: because he is a possessor of wealth and children

arNorm: اذا تتۡلي عليۡه ءايتنا قال اسطير الۡاولين
en: when our verses are recited to him, he says, "legends of the former peoples

arNorm: سنسمهۥ علي الۡخرۡطوم
en: we will brand him upon the snout

arNorm: انا بلوۡنهمۡ كما بلوۡنا اصۡحب الۡجنه اذۡ اقۡسموا ليصۡرمنها مصۡبحين
en: indeed, we have tried them as we tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning

arNorm: ولا يسۡتثۡنون
en: without making exception

arNorm: فطاف عليۡها طائف من ربك وهمۡ نائمون
en: so there came upon the garden an affliction from your lord while they were asleep

arNorm: فاصۡبحتۡ كالصريم
en: and it became as though reaped

arNorm: فتنادوۡا مصۡبحين
en: and they called one another at morning

arNorm: ان اغۡدوا علي حرۡثكمۡ ان كنتمۡ صرمين
en: [saying], "go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit

arNorm: فانطلقوا وهمۡ يتخفتون
en: so they set out, while lowering their voices

arNorm: ان لا يدۡخلنها الۡيوۡم عليۡكم مسۡكين
en: [saying], "there will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person

arNorm: وغدوۡا علي حرۡد قدرين
en: and they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able

arNorm: فلما راوۡها قالوا انا لضالون
en: but when they saw it, they said, "indeed, we are lost

arNorm: بلۡ نحۡن محۡرومون
en: rather, we have been deprived

arNorm: قال اوۡسطهمۡ المۡ اقل لكمۡ لوۡلا تسبحون
en: the most moderate of them said, "did i not say to you, 'why do you not exalt [allah]

arNorm: قالوا سبۡحن ربنا انا كنا ظلمين
en: they said, "exalted is our lord! indeed, we were wrongdoers

arNorm: فاقۡبل بعۡضهمۡ علي بعۡض يتلومون
en: then they approached one another, blaming each other

arNorm: قالوا يويۡلنا انا كنا طغين
en: they said, "o woe to us; indeed we were transgressors

arNorm: عسي ربنا ان يبۡدلنا خيۡرا منۡها انا الي ربنا رغبون
en: perhaps our lord will substitute for us [one] better than it. indeed, we are toward our lord desirous

arNorm: كذلك الۡعذابۖ ولعذاب الۡاخره اكۡبرۚ لوۡ كانوا يعۡلمون
en: such is the punishment [of this world]. and the punishment of the hereafter is greater, if they only knew

arNorm: ان للۡمتقين عند ربهمۡ جنت النعيم
en: indeed, for the righteous with their lord are the gardens of pleasure

arNorm: افنجۡعل الۡمسۡلمين كالۡمجۡرمين
en: then will we treat the muslims like the criminals

arNorm: ما لكمۡ كيۡف تحۡكمون
en: what is [the matter] with you? how do you judge

arNorm: امۡ لكمۡ كتب فيه تدۡرسون
en: or do you have a scripture in which you learn

arNorm: ان لكمۡ فيه لما تخيرون
en: that indeed for you is whatever you choose

arNorm: امۡ لكمۡ ايۡمن عليۡنا بلغه الي يوۡم الۡقيمه ان لكمۡ لما تحۡكمون
en: or do you have oaths [binding] upon us, extending until the day of resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge

arNorm: سلۡهمۡ ايهم بذلك زعيم
en: ask them which of them, for that [claim], is responsible

arNorm: امۡ لهمۡ شركاء فلۡياۡتوا بشركائهمۡ ان كانوا صدقين
en: or do they have partners? then let them bring their partners, if they should be truthful

arNorm: يوۡم يكۡشف عن ساق ويدۡعوۡن الي السجود فلا يسۡتطيعون
en: the day the shin will be uncovered and they are invited to prostration but the disbelievers will not be able

arNorm: خشعه ابۡصرهمۡ ترۡهقهمۡ ذلهۖ وقدۡ كانوا يدۡعوۡن الي السجود وهمۡ سلمون
en: their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. and they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound

arNorm: فذرۡني ومن يكذب بهذا الۡحديثۖ سنسۡتدۡرجهم منۡ حيۡث لا يعۡلمون
en: so leave me, [o muhammad], with [the matter of] whoever denies the qur'an. we will progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know

arNorm: وامۡلي لهمۡۚ ان كيۡدي متين
en: and i will give them time. indeed, my plan is firm

arNorm: امۡ تسۡلهمۡ اجۡرا فهم من مغۡرم مثۡقلون
en: or do you ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down

arNorm: امۡ عندهم الۡغيۡب فهمۡ يكۡتبون
en: or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down

arNorm: فاصۡبرۡ لحكۡم ربك ولا تكن كصاحب الۡحوت اذۡ نادي وهو مكۡظوم
en: then be patient for the decision of your lord, [o muhammad], and be not like the companion of the fish when he called out while he was distressed

arNorm: لوۡلا ان تدركهۥ نعۡمه من ربهۦ لنبذ بالۡعراء وهو مذۡموم
en: if not that a favor from his lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured

arNorm: فاجۡتبه ربهۥ فجعلهۥ من الصلحين
en: and his lord chose him and made him of the righteous

arNorm: وان يكاد الذين كفروا ليزۡلقونك بابۡصرهمۡ لما سمعوا الذكۡر ويقولون انهۥ لمجۡنون
en: and indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes when they hear the message, and they say, "indeed, he is mad

arNorm: وما هو الا ذكۡر للۡعلمين
en: but it is not except a reminder to the worlds

arNorm: الۡحاقه
en: the inevitable reality

arNorm: ما الۡحاقه
en: what is the inevitable reality

arNorm: وما ادۡريك ما الۡحاقه
en: and what can make you know what is the inevitable reality

arNorm: كذبتۡ ثمود وعادۢ بالۡقارعه
en: thamud and 'aad denied the striking calamity

arNorm: فاما ثمود فاهۡلكوا بالطاغيه
en: so as for thamud, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast]

arNorm: واما عاد فاهۡلكوا بريح صرۡصر عاتيه
en: and as for 'aad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind

arNorm: سخرها عليۡهمۡ سبۡع ليال وثمنيه ايام حسوماۖ فتري الۡقوۡم فيها صرۡعي كانهمۡ اعۡجاز نخۡل خاويه
en: which allah imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees

arNorm: فهلۡ تري لهم منۢ باقيه
en: then do you see of them any remains

arNorm: وجاء فرۡعوۡن ومن قبۡلهۥ والۡمؤۡتفكت بالۡخاطئه
en: and there came pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin

arNorm: فعصوۡا رسول ربهمۡ فاخذهمۡ اخۡذه رابيه
en: and they disobeyed the messenger of their lord, so he seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity]

arNorm: انا لما طغا الۡماء حملۡنكمۡ في الۡجاريه
en: indeed, when the water overflowed, we carried your ancestors in the sailing ship

arNorm: لنجۡعلها لكمۡ تذۡكره وتعيها اذن وعيه
en: that we might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it

arNorm: فاذا نفخ في الصور نفۡخه وحده
en: then when the horn is blown with one blast

arNorm: وحملت الۡارۡض والۡجبال فدكتا دكه وحده
en: and the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow

arNorm: فيوۡمئذ وقعت الۡواقعه
en: then on that day, the resurrection will occur

arNorm: وانشقت السماء فهي يوۡمئذ واهيه
en: and the heaven will split [open], for that day it is infirm

arNorm: والۡملك علي ارۡجائهاۚ ويحۡمل عرۡش ربك فوۡقهمۡ يوۡمئذ ثمنيه
en: and the angels are at its edges. and there will bear the throne of your lord above them, that day, eight [of them]

arNorm: يوۡمئذ تعۡرضون لا تخۡفي منكمۡ خافيه
en: that day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed

arNorm: فاما منۡ اوتي كتبهۥ بيمينهۦ فيقول هاؤم اقۡرءوا كتبيهۡ
en: so as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "here, read my record

arNorm: اني ظننت اني ملق حسابيهۡ
en: indeed, i was certain that i would be meeting my account

arNorm: فهو في عيشه راضيه
en: so he will be in a pleasant life

arNorm: في جنه عاليه
en: in an elevated garden

arNorm: قطوفها دانيه
en: its [fruit] to be picked hanging near

arNorm: كلوا واشۡربوا هنيۢا بما اسۡلفۡتمۡ في الۡايام الۡخاليه
en: [they will be told], "eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past

arNorm: واما منۡ اوتي كتبهۥ بشمالهۦ فيقول يليۡتني لمۡ اوت كتبيهۡ
en: but as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "oh, i wish i had not been given my record

arNorm: ولمۡ ادۡر ما حسابيهۡ
en: and had not known what is my account

arNorm: يليۡتها كانت الۡقاضيه
en: i wish my death had been the decisive one

arNorm: ما اغۡني عني ماليهۡۜ
en: my wealth has not availed me

arNorm: هلك عني سلۡطنيهۡ
en: gone from me is my authority

arNorm: خذوه فغلوه
en: [allah will say], "seize him and shackle him

arNorm: ثم الۡجحيم صلوه
en: then into hellfire drive him

arNorm: ثم في سلۡسله ذرۡعها سبۡعون ذراعا فاسۡلكوه
en: then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him

arNorm: انهۥ كان لا يؤۡمن بالله الۡعظيم
en: indeed, he did not used to believe in allah, the most great

arNorm: ولا يحض علي طعام الۡمسۡكين
en: nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor

arNorm: فليۡس له الۡيوۡم ههنا حميم
en: so there is not for him here this day any devoted friend

arNorm: ولا طعام الا منۡ غسۡلين
en: nor any food except from the discharge of wounds

arNorm: لا ياۡكلهۥ الا الۡخطون
en: none will eat it except the sinners

arNorm: فلا اقۡسم بما تبۡصرون
en: so i swear by what you see

arNorm: وما لا تبۡصرون
en: and what you do not see

arNorm: انهۥ لقوۡل رسول كريم
en: [that] indeed, the qur'an is the word of a noble messenger

arNorm: وما هو بقوۡل شاعرۚ قليلا ما تؤۡمنون
en: and it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe

arNorm: ولا بقوۡل كاهنۚ قليلا ما تذكرون
en: nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember

arNorm: تنزيل من رب الۡعلمين
en: [it is] a revelation from the lord of the worlds

arNorm: ولوۡ تقول عليۡنا بعۡض الۡاقاويل
en: and if muhammad had made up about us some [false] sayings

arNorm: لاخذۡنا منۡه بالۡيمين
en: we would have seized him by the right hand

arNorm: ثم لقطعۡنا منۡه الۡوتين
en: then we would have cut from him the aorta

arNorm: فما منكم منۡ احد عنۡه حجزين
en: and there is no one of you who could prevent [us] from him

arNorm: وانهۥ لتذۡكره للۡمتقين
en: and indeed, the qur'an is a reminder for the righteous

arNorm: وانا لنعۡلم ان منكم مكذبين
en: and indeed, we know that among you are deniers

arNorm: وانهۥ لحسۡره علي الۡكفرين
en: and indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers

arNorm: وانهۥ لحق الۡيقين
en: and indeed, it is the truth of certainty

arNorm: فسبحۡ باسۡم ربك الۡعظيم
en: so exalt the name of your lord, the most great

arNorm: سال سائلۢ بعذاب واقع
en: a supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen

arNorm: للۡكفرين ليۡس لهۥ دافع
en: to the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer

arNorm: من الله ذي الۡمعارج
en: [it is] from allah, owner of the ways of ascent

arNorm: تعۡرج الۡملئكه والروح اليۡه في يوۡم كان مقۡدارهۥ خمۡسين الۡف سنه
en: the angels and the spirit will ascend to him during a day the extent of which is fifty thousand years

arNorm: فاصۡبرۡ صبۡرا جميلا
en: so be patient with gracious patience

arNorm: انهمۡ يروۡنهۥ بعيدا
en: indeed, they see it [as] distant

arNorm: ونريه قريبا
en: but we see it [as] near

arNorm: يوۡم تكون السماء كالۡمهۡل
en: on the day the sky will be like murky oil

arNorm: وتكون الۡجبال كالۡعهۡن
en: and the mountains will be like wool

arNorm: ولا يسۡل حميم حميما
en: and no friend will ask [anything of] a friend

arNorm: يبصرونهمۡۚ يود الۡمجۡرم لوۡ يفۡتدي منۡ عذاب يوۡمئذۭ ببنيه
en: they will be shown each other. the criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that day by his children

arNorm: وصحبتهۦ واخيه
en: and his wife and his brother

arNorm: وفصيلته التي تۡويه
en: and his nearest kindred who shelter him

arNorm: ومن في الۡارۡض جميعا ثم ينجيه
en: and whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him

arNorm: كلاۖ انها لظي
en: no! indeed, it is the flame [of hell]

arNorm: نزاعه للشوي
en: a remover of exteriors

arNorm: تدۡعوا منۡ ادۡبر وتولي
en: it invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]

arNorm: وجمع فاوۡعي
en: and collected [wealth] and hoarded

arNorm: ۞ان الۡانسن خلق هلوعا
en: indeed, mankind was created anxious

arNorm: اذا مسه الشر جزوعا
en: when evil touches him, impatient

arNorm: واذا مسه الۡخيۡر منوعا
en: and when good touches him, withholding [of it]

arNorm: الا الۡمصلين
en: except the observers of prayer

arNorm: الذين همۡ علي صلاتهمۡ دائمون
en: those who are constant in their prayer

arNorm: والذين في امۡولهمۡ حق معۡلوم
en: and those within whose wealth is a known right

arNorm: للسائل والۡمحۡروم
en: for the petitioner and the deprived

arNorm: والذين يصدقون بيوۡم الدين
en: and those who believe in the day of recompense

arNorm: والذين هم منۡ عذاب ربهم مشۡفقون
en: and those who are fearful of the punishment of their lord

arNorm: ان عذاب ربهمۡ غيۡر ماۡمون
en: indeed, the punishment of their lord is not that from which one is safe

arNorm: والذين همۡ لفروجهمۡ حفظون
en: and those who guard their private parts

arNorm: الا علي ازۡوجهمۡ اوۡ ما ملكتۡ ايۡمنهمۡ فانهمۡ غيۡر ملومين
en: except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they are not to be blamed

arNorm: فمن ابۡتغي وراء ذلك فاولئك هم الۡعادون
en: but whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors

arNorm: والذين همۡ لامنتهمۡ وعهۡدهمۡ رعون
en: and those who are to their trusts and promises attentive

arNorm: والذين هم بشهدتهمۡ قائمون
en: and those who are in their testimonies upright

arNorm: والذين همۡ علي صلاتهمۡ يحافظون
en: and those who [carefully] maintain their prayer

arNorm: اولئك في جنت مكۡرمون
en: they will be in gardens, honored

arNorm: فمال الذين كفروا قبلك مهۡطعين
en: so what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [o muhammad]

arNorm: عن الۡيمين وعن الشمال عزين
en: [to sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups

arNorm: ايطۡمع كل امۡري منۡهمۡ ان يدۡخل جنه نعيم
en: does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure

arNorm: كلاۖ انا خلقۡنهم مما يعۡلمون
en: no! indeed, we have created them from that which they know

arNorm: فلا اقۡسم برب الۡمشرق والۡمغرب انا لقدرون
en: so i swear by the lord of [all] risings and settings that indeed we are able

arNorm: علي ان نبدل خيۡرا منۡهمۡ وما نحۡن بمسۡبوقين
en: to replace them with better than them; and we are not to be outdone

arNorm: فذرۡهمۡ يخوضوا ويلۡعبوا حتي يلقوا يوۡمهم الذي يوعدون
en: so leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their day which they are promised

arNorm: يوۡم يخۡرجون من الۡاجۡداث سراعا كانهمۡ الي نصب يوفضون
en: the day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening

arNorm: خشعه ابۡصرهمۡ ترۡهقهمۡ ذلهۚ ذلك الۡيوۡم الذي كانوا يوعدون
en: their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. that is the day which they had been promised

arNorm: انا ارۡسلۡنا نوحا الي قوۡمهۦ انۡ انذرۡ قوۡمك من قبۡل ان ياۡتيهمۡ عذاب اليم
en: indeed, we sent noah to his people, [saying], "warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment

arNorm: قال يقوۡم اني لكمۡ نذير مبين
en: he said, "o my people, indeed i am to you a clear warner

arNorm: ان اعۡبدوا الله واتقوه واطيعون
en: [saying], 'worship allah, fear him and obey me

arNorm: يغۡفرۡ لكم من ذنوبكمۡ ويؤخرۡكمۡ الي اجل مسميۚ ان اجل الله اذا جاء لا يؤخرۚ لوۡ كنتمۡ تعۡلمون
en: allah will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. indeed, the time [set by] allah, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew

arNorm: قال رب اني دعوۡت قوۡمي ليۡلا ونهارا
en: he said, "my lord, indeed i invited my people [to truth] night and day

arNorm: فلمۡ يزدۡهمۡ دعاءي الا فرارا
en: but my invitation increased them not except in flight

arNorm: واني كلما دعوۡتهمۡ لتغۡفر لهمۡ جعلوا اصبعهمۡ في ءاذانهمۡ واسۡتغۡشوۡا ثيابهمۡ واصروا واسۡتكۡبروا اسۡتكۡبارا
en: and indeed, every time i invited them that you may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance

arNorm: ثم اني دعوۡتهمۡ جهارا
en: then i invited them publicly

arNorm: ثم اني اعۡلنت لهمۡ واسۡررۡت لهمۡ اسۡرارا
en: then i announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly

arNorm: فقلۡت اسۡتغۡفروا ربكمۡ انهۥ كان غفارا
en: and said, 'ask forgiveness of your lord. indeed, he is ever a perpetual forgiver

arNorm: يرۡسل السماء عليۡكم مدۡرارا
en: he will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers

arNorm: ويمۡددۡكم بامۡول وبنين ويجۡعل لكمۡ جنت ويجۡعل لكمۡ انۡهرا
en: and give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers

arNorm: ما لكمۡ لا ترۡجون لله وقارا
en: what is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to allah [due] grandeur

arNorm: وقدۡ خلقكمۡ اطۡوارا
en: while he has created you in stages

arNorm: المۡ تروۡا كيۡف خلق الله سبۡع سموت طباقا
en: do you not consider how allah has created seven heavens in layers

arNorm: وجعل الۡقمر فيهن نورا وجعل الشمۡس سراجا
en: and made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp

arNorm: والله انۢبتكم من الۡارۡض نباتا
en: and allah has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth

arNorm: ثم يعيدكمۡ فيها ويخۡرجكمۡ اخۡراجا
en: then he will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction

arNorm: والله جعل لكم الۡارۡض بساطا
en: and allah has made for you the earth an expanse

arNorm: لتسۡلكوا منۡها سبلا فجاجا
en: that you may follow therein roads of passage

arNorm: قال نوح رب انهمۡ عصوۡني واتبعوا من لمۡ يزدۡه مالهۥ وولدهۥ الا خسارا
en: noah said, "my lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss

arNorm: ومكروا مكۡرا كبارا
en: and they conspired an immense conspiracy

arNorm: وقالوا لا تذرن ءالهتكمۡ ولا تذرن ودا ولا سواعا ولا يغوث ويعوق ونسۡرا
en: and said, 'never leave your gods and never leave wadd or suwa' or yaghuth and ya'uq and nasr

arNorm: وقدۡ اضلوا كثيراۖ ولا تزد الظلمين الا ضللا
en: and already they have misled many. and, [my lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error

arNorm: مما خطيتهمۡ اغۡرقوا فادۡخلوا نارا فلمۡ يجدوا لهم من دون الله انصارا
en: because of their sins they were drowned and put into the fire, and they found not for themselves besides allah [any] helpers

arNorm: وقال نوح رب لا تذرۡ علي الۡارۡض من الۡكفرين ديارا
en: and noah said, "my lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant

arNorm: انك ان تذرۡهمۡ يضلوا عبادك ولا يلدوا الا فاجرا كفارا
en: indeed, if you leave them, they will mislead your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever

arNorm: رب اغۡفرۡ لي ولولدي ولمن دخل بيۡتي مؤۡمنا وللۡمؤۡمنين والۡمؤۡمنتۖ ولا تزد الظلمين الا تبارۢا
en: my lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. and do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction

arNorm: قلۡ اوحي الي انه اسۡتمع نفر من الۡجن فقالوا انا سمعۡنا قرۡءانا عجبا
en: say, [o muhammad], "it has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'indeed, we have heard an amazing qur'an

arNorm: يهۡدي الي الرشۡد فامنا بهۦۖ ولن نشۡرك بربنا احدا
en: it guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. and we will never associate with our lord anyone

arNorm: وانهۥ تعلي جد ربنا ما اتخذ صحبه ولا ولدا
en: and [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our lord; he has not taken a wife or a son

arNorm: وانهۥ كان يقول سفيهنا علي الله شططا
en: and that our foolish one has been saying about allah an excessive transgression

arNorm: وانا ظننا ان لن تقول الۡانس والۡجن علي الله كذبا
en: and we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about allah a lie

arNorm: وانهۥ كان رجال من الۡانس يعوذون برجال من الۡجن فزادوهمۡ رهقا
en: and there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden

arNorm: وانهمۡ ظنوا كما ظننتمۡ ان لن يبۡعث الله احدا
en: and they had thought, as you thought, that allah would never send anyone [as a messenger]

arNorm: وانا لمسۡنا السماء فوجدۡنها ملئتۡ حرسا شديدا وشهبا
en: and we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames

arNorm: وانا كنا نقۡعد منۡها مقعد للسمۡعۖ فمن يسۡتمع الۡان يجدۡ لهۥ شهابا رصدا
en: and we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him

arNorm: وانا لا ندۡري اشر اريد بمن في الۡارۡض امۡ اراد بهمۡ ربهمۡ رشدا
en: and we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their lord intends for them a right course

arNorm: وانا منا الصلحون ومنا دون ذلكۖ كنا طرائق قددا
en: and among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways

arNorm: وانا ظننا ان لن نعۡجز الله في الۡارۡض ولن نعۡجزهۥ هربا
en: and we have become certain that we will never cause failure to allah upon earth, nor can we escape him by flight

arNorm: وانا لما سمعۡنا الۡهدي ءامنا بهۦۖ فمن يؤۡمنۢ بربهۦ فلا يخاف بخۡسا ولا رهقا
en: and when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. and whoever believes in his lord will not fear deprivation or burden

arNorm: وانا منا الۡمسۡلمون ومنا الۡقسطونۖ فمنۡ اسۡلم فاولئك تحروۡا رشدا
en: and among us are muslims [in submission to allah], and among us are the unjust. and whoever has become muslim - those have sought out the right course

arNorm: واما الۡقسطون فكانوا لجهنم حطبا
en: but as for the unjust, they will be, for hell, firewood

arNorm: والو اسۡتقموا علي الطريقه لاسۡقيۡنهم ماء غدقا
en: and [allah revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, we would have given them abundant provision

arNorm: لنفۡتنهمۡ فيهۚ ومن يعۡرضۡ عن ذكۡر ربهۦ يسۡلكۡه عذابا صعدا
en: so we might test them therein. and whoever turns away from the remembrance of his lord he will put into arduous punishment

arNorm: وان الۡمسجد لله فلا تدۡعوا مع الله احدا
en: and [he revealed] that the masjids are for allah, so do not invoke with allah anyone

arNorm: وانهۥ لما قام عبۡد الله يدۡعوه كادوا يكونون عليۡه لبدا
en: and that when the servant of allah stood up supplicating him, they almost became about him a compacted mass

arNorm: قلۡ انما ادۡعوا ربي ولا اشۡرك بهۦ احدا
en: say, [o muhammad], "i only invoke my lord and do not associate with him anyone

arNorm: قلۡ اني لا امۡلك لكمۡ ضرا ولا رشدا
en: say, "indeed, i do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction

arNorm: قلۡ اني لن يجيرني من الله احد ولنۡ اجد من دونهۦ ملۡتحدا
en: say, "indeed, there will never protect me from allah anyone [if i should disobey], nor will i find in other than him a refuge

arNorm: الا بلغا من الله ورسلتهۦۚ ومن يعۡص الله ورسولهۥ فان لهۥ نار جهنم خلدين فيها ابدا
en: but [i have for you] only notification from allah, and his messages." and whoever disobeys allah and his messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of hell; they will abide therein forever

arNorm: حتي اذا راوۡا ما يوعدون فسيعۡلمون منۡ اضۡعف ناصرا واقل عددا
en: [the disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number

arNorm: قلۡ انۡ ادۡري اقريب ما توعدون امۡ يجۡعل لهۥ ربي امدا
en: say, "i do not know if what you are promised is near or if my lord will grant for it a [long] period

arNorm: علم الۡغيۡب فلا يظۡهر علي غيۡبهۦ احدا
en: [he is] knower of the unseen, and he does not disclose his [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone

arNorm: الا من ارۡتضي من رسول فانهۥ يسۡلك منۢ بيۡن يديۡه ومنۡ خلۡفهۦ رصدا
en: except whom he has approved of messengers, and indeed, he sends before each messenger and behind him observers

arNorm: ليعۡلم ان قدۡ ابۡلغوا رسلت ربهمۡ واحاط بما لديۡهمۡ واحۡصي كل شيۡء عددۢا
en: that he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their lord; and he has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number

arNorm: يايها الۡمزمل
en: o you who wraps himself [in clothing]

arNorm: قم اليۡل الا قليلا
en: arise [to pray] the night, except for a little

arNorm: نصۡفهۥ او انقصۡ منۡه قليلا
en: half of it - or subtract from it a little

arNorm: اوۡ زدۡ عليۡه ورتل الۡقرۡءان ترۡتيلا
en: or add to it, and recite the qur'an with measured recitation

arNorm: انا سنلۡقي عليۡك قوۡلا ثقيلا
en: indeed, we will cast upon you a heavy word

arNorm: ان ناشئه اليۡل هي اشد وطۡا واقۡوم قيلا
en: indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words

arNorm: ان لك في النهار سبۡحا طويلا
en: indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation

arNorm: واذۡكر اسۡم ربك وتبتلۡ اليۡه تبۡتيلا
en: and remember the name of your lord and devote yourself to him with [complete] devotion

arNorm: رب الۡمشۡرق والۡمغۡرب لا اله الا هو فاتخذۡه وكيلا
en: [he is] the lord of the east and the west; there is no deity except him, so take him as disposer of [your] affairs

arNorm: واصۡبرۡ علي ما يقولون واهۡجرۡهمۡ هجۡرا جميلا
en: and be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance

arNorm: وذرۡني والۡمكذبين اولي النعۡمه ومهلۡهمۡ قليلا
en: and leave me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little

arNorm: ان لديۡنا انكالا وجحيما
en: indeed, with us [for them] are shackles and burning fire

arNorm: وطعاما ذا غصه وعذابا اليما
en: and food that chokes and a painful punishment

arNorm: يوۡم ترۡجف الۡارۡض والۡجبال وكانت الۡجبال كثيبا مهيلا
en: on the day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down

arNorm: انا ارۡسلۡنا اليۡكمۡ رسولا شهدا عليۡكمۡ كما ارۡسلۡنا الي فرۡعوۡن رسولا
en: indeed, we have sent to you a messenger as a witness upon you just as we sent to pharaoh a messenger

arNorm: فعصي فرۡعوۡن الرسول فاخذۡنه اخۡذا وبيلا
en: but pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so we seized him with a ruinous seizure

arNorm: فكيۡف تتقون ان كفرۡتمۡ يوۡما يجۡعل الۡولۡدن شيبا
en: then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a day that will make the children white- haired

arNorm: السماء منفطرۢ بهۦۚ كان وعۡدهۥ مفۡعولا
en: the heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is his promise fulfilled

arNorm: ان هذهۦ تذۡكرهۖ فمن شاء اتخذ الي ربهۦ سبيلا
en: indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his lord a way

arNorm: ۞ان ربك يعۡلم انك تقوم ادۡني من ثلثي اليۡل ونصۡفهۥ وثلثهۥ وطائفه من الذين معكۚ والله يقدر اليۡل والنهارۚ علم ان لن تحۡصوه فتاب عليۡكمۡۖ فاقۡرءوا ما تيسر من الۡقرۡءانۚ علم ان سيكون منكم مرۡضي وءاخرون يضۡربون في الۡارۡض يبۡتغون من فضۡل الله وءاخرون يقتلون في سبيل اللهۖ فاقۡرءوا ما تيسر منۡهۚ واقيموا الصلوه وءاتوا الزكوه واقۡرضوا الله قرۡضا حسناۚ وما تقدموا لانفسكم منۡ خيۡر تجدوه عند الله هو خيۡرا واعۡظم اجۡراۚ واسۡتغۡفروا اللهۖ ان الله غفور رحيمۢ
en: indeed, your lord knows, [o muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. and allah determines [the extent of] the night and the day. he has known that you [muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the qur'an. he has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of allah and others fighting for the cause of allah. so recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan allah a goodly loan. and whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with allah. it is better and greater in reward. and seek forgiveness of allah. indeed, allah is forgiving and merciful

arNorm: يايها الۡمدثر
en: o you who covers himself [with a garment]

arNorm: قمۡ فانذرۡ
en: arise and warn

arNorm: وربك فكبرۡ
en: and your lord glorify

arNorm: وثيابك فطهرۡ
en: and your clothing purify

arNorm: والرجۡز فاهۡجرۡ
en: and uncleanliness avoid

arNorm: ولا تمۡنن تسۡتكۡثر
en: and do not confer favor to acquire more

arNorm: ولربك فاصۡبرۡ
en: but for your lord be patient

arNorm: فاذا نقر في الناقور
en: and when the trumpet is blown

arNorm: فذلك يوۡمئذ يوۡم عسير
en: that day will be a difficult day

arNorm: علي الۡكفرين غيۡر يسير
en: for the disbelievers - not easy

arNorm: ذرۡني ومنۡ خلقۡت وحيدا
en: leave me with the one i created alone

arNorm: وجعلۡت لهۥ مالا ممۡدودا
en: and to whom i granted extensive wealth

arNorm: وبنين شهودا
en: and children present [with him]

arNorm: ومهدت لهۥ تمۡهيدا
en: and spread [everything] before him, easing [his life]

arNorm: ثم يطۡمع انۡ ازيد
en: then he desires that i should add more

arNorm: كلاۖ انهۥ كان لايتنا عنيدا
en: no! indeed, he has been toward our verses obstinate

arNorm: سارۡهقهۥ صعودا
en: i will cover him with arduous torment

arNorm: انهۥ فكر وقدر
en: indeed, he thought and deliberated

arNorm: فقتل كيۡف قدر
en: so may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated

arNorm: ثم قتل كيۡف قدر
en: then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated

arNorm: ثم نظر
en: then he considered [again]

arNorm: ثم عبس وبسر
en: then he frowned and scowled

arNorm: ثم ادۡبر واسۡتكۡبر
en: then he turned back and was arrogant

arNorm: فقال انۡ هذا الا سحۡر يؤۡثر
en: and said, "this is not but magic imitated [from others]

arNorm: انۡ هذا الا قوۡل الۡبشر
en: this is not but the word of a human being

arNorm: ساصۡليه سقر
en: i will drive him into saqar

arNorm: وما ادۡريك ما سقر
en: and what can make you know what is saqar

arNorm: لا تبۡقي ولا تذر
en: it lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned]

arNorm: لواحه للۡبشر
en: blackening the skins

arNorm: عليۡها تسۡعه عشر
en: over it are nineteen [angels]

arNorm: وما جعلۡنا اصۡحب النار الا ملئكهۖ وما جعلۡنا عدتهمۡ الا فتۡنه للذين كفروا ليسۡتيۡقن الذين اوتوا الۡكتب ويزۡداد الذين ءامنوا ايمنا ولا يرۡتاب الذين اوتوا الۡكتب والۡمؤۡمنون وليقول الذين في قلوبهم مرض والۡكفرون ماذا اراد الله بهذا مثلاۚ كذلك يضل الله من يشاء ويهۡدي من يشاءۚ وما يعۡلم جنود ربك الا هوۚ وما هي الا ذكۡري للۡبشر
en: and we have not made the keepers of the fire except angels. and we have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is hypocrisy and the disbelievers will say, "what does allah intend by this as an example?" thus does allah leave astray whom he wills and guides whom he wills. and none knows the soldiers of your lord except him. and mention of the fire is not but a reminder to humanity

arNorm: كلا والۡقمر
en: no! by the moon

arNorm: واليۡل اذۡ ادۡبر
en: and [by] the night when it departs

arNorm: والصبۡح اذا اسۡفر
en: and [by] the morning when it brightens

arNorm: انها لاحۡدي الۡكبر
en: indeed, the fire is of the greatest [afflictions]

arNorm: نذيرا للۡبشر
en: as a warning to humanity

arNorm: لمن شاء منكمۡ ان يتقدم اوۡ يتاخر
en: to whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind

arNorm: كل نفۡسۭ بما كسبتۡ رهينه
en: every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained

arNorm: الا اصۡحب الۡيمين
en: except the companions of the right

arNorm: في جنت يتساءلون
en: [who will be] in gardens, questioning each other

arNorm: عن الۡمجۡرمين
en: about the criminals

arNorm: ما سلككمۡ في سقر
en: [and asking them], "what put you into saqar

arNorm: قالوا لمۡ نك من الۡمصلين
en: they will say, "we were not of those who prayed

arNorm: ولمۡ نك نطۡعم الۡمسۡكين
en: nor did we used to feed the poor

arNorm: وكنا نخوض مع الۡخائضين
en: and we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it]

arNorm: وكنا نكذب بيوۡم الدين
en: and we used to deny the day of recompense

arNorm: حتي اتينا الۡيقين
en: until there came to us the certainty

arNorm: فما تنفعهمۡ شفعه الشفعين
en: so there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors

arNorm: فما لهمۡ عن التذۡكره معۡرضين
en: then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away

arNorm: كانهمۡ حمر مسۡتنفره
en: as if they were alarmed donkeys

arNorm: فرتۡ من قسۡورهۭ
en: fleeing from a lion

arNorm: بلۡ يريد كل امۡري منۡهمۡ ان يؤۡتي صحفا منشره
en: rather, every person among them desires that he would be given scriptures spread about

arNorm: كلاۖ بل لا يخافون الۡاخره
en: no! but they do not fear the hereafter

arNorm: كلا انهۥ تذۡكره
en: no! indeed, the qur'an is a reminder

arNorm: فمن شاء ذكرهۥ
en: then whoever wills will remember it

arNorm: وما يذۡكرون الا ان يشاء اللهۚ هو اهۡل التقۡوي واهۡل الۡمغۡفره
en: and they will not remember except that allah wills. he is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness

arNorm: لا اقۡسم بيوۡم الۡقيمه
en: i swear by the day of resurrection

arNorm: ولا اقۡسم بالنفۡس اللوامه
en: and i swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection]

arNorm: ايحۡسب الۡانسن الن نجۡمع عظامهۥ
en: does man think that we will not assemble his bones

arNorm: بلي قدرين علي ان نسوي بنانهۥ
en: yes. [we are] able [even] to proportion his fingertips

arNorm: بلۡ يريد الۡانسن ليفۡجر امامهۥ
en: but man desires to continue in sin

arNorm: يسۡل ايان يوۡم الۡقيمه
en: he asks, "when is the day of resurrection

arNorm: فاذا برق الۡبصر
en: so when vision is dazzled

arNorm: وخسف الۡقمر
en: and the moon darkens

arNorm: وجمع الشمۡس والۡقمر
en: and the sun and the moon are joined

arNorm: يقول الۡانسن يوۡمئذ ايۡن الۡمفر
en: man will say on that day, "where is the [place of] escape

arNorm: كلا لا وزر
en: no! there is no refuge

arNorm: الي ربك يوۡمئذ الۡمسۡتقر
en: to your lord, that day, is the [place of] permanence

arNorm: ينبؤا الۡانسن يوۡمئذۭ بما قدم واخر
en: man will be informed that day of what he sent ahead and kept back

arNorm: بل الۡانسن علي نفۡسهۦ بصيره
en: rather, man, against himself, will be a witness

arNorm: ولوۡ الۡقي معاذيرهۥ
en: even if he presents his excuses

arNorm: لا تحركۡ بهۦ لسانك لتعۡجل بهۦ
en: move not your tongue with it, [o muhammad], to hasten with recitation of the qur'an

arNorm: ان عليۡنا جمۡعهۥ وقرۡءانهۥ
en: indeed, upon us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation

arNorm: فاذا قراۡنه فاتبعۡ قرۡءانهۥ
en: so when we have recited it [through gabriel], then follow its recitation

arNorm: ثم ان عليۡنا بيانهۥ
en: then upon us is its clarification [to you]

arNorm: كلا بلۡ تحبون الۡعاجله
en: no! but you love the immediate

arNorm: وتذرون الۡاخره
en: and leave the hereafter

arNorm: وجوه يوۡمئذ ناضره
en: [some] faces, that day, will be radiant

arNorm: الي ربها ناظره
en: looking at their lord

arNorm: ووجوه يوۡمئذۭ باسره
en: and [some] faces, that day, will be contorted

arNorm: تظن ان يفۡعل بها فاقره
en: expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking

arNorm: كلا اذا بلغت التراقي
en: no! when the soul has reached the collar bones

arNorm: وقيل منۡۜ راق
en: and it is said, "who will cure [him]

arNorm: وظن انه الۡفراق
en: and the dying one is certain that it is the [time of] separation

arNorm: والۡتفت الساق بالساق
en: and the leg is wound about the leg

arNorm: الي ربك يوۡمئذ الۡمساق
en: to your lord, that day, will be the procession

arNorm: فلا صدق ولا صلي
en: and the disbeliever had not believed, nor had he prayed

arNorm: ولكن كذب وتولي
en: but [instead], he denied and turned away

arNorm: ثم ذهب الي اهۡلهۦ يتمطي
en: and then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride]

arNorm: اوۡلي لك فاوۡلي
en: woe to you, and woe

arNorm: ثم اوۡلي لك فاوۡلي
en: then woe to you, and woe

arNorm: ايحۡسب الۡانسن ان يتۡرك سدي
en: does man think that he will be left neglected

arNorm: المۡ يك نطۡفه من مني يمۡني
en: had he not been a sperm from semen emitted

arNorm: ثم كان علقه فخلق فسوي
en: then he was a clinging clot, and [allah] created [his form] and proportioned [him]

arNorm: فجعل منۡه الزوۡجيۡن الذكر والۡانثي
en: and made of him two mates, the male and the female

arNorm: اليۡس ذلك بقدر علي ان يحۡۧي الۡموۡتي
en: is not that [creator] able to give life to the dead

arNorm: هلۡ اتي علي الۡانسن حين من الدهۡر لمۡ يكن شيۡا مذۡكورا
en: has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned

arNorm: انا خلقۡنا الۡانسن من نطۡفه امۡشاج نبۡتليه فجعلۡنه سميعۢا بصيرا
en: indeed, we created man from a sperm-drop mixture that we may try him; and we made him hearing and seeing

arNorm: انا هديۡنه السبيل اما شاكرا واما كفورا
en: indeed, we guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful

arNorm: انا اعۡتدۡنا للۡكفرين سلسلا واغۡللا وسعيرا
en: indeed, we have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze

arNorm: ان الۡابۡرار يشۡربون من كاۡس كان مزاجها كافورا
en: indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of kafur

arNorm: عيۡنا يشۡرب بها عباد الله يفجرونها تفۡجيرا
en: a spring of which the [righteous] servants of allah will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance]

arNorm: يوفون بالنذۡر ويخافون يوۡما كان شرهۥ مسۡتطيرا
en: they [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a day whose evil will be widespread

arNorm: ويطۡعمون الطعام علي حبهۦ مسۡكينا ويتيما واسيرا
en: and they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive

arNorm: انما نطۡعمكمۡ لوجۡه الله لا نريد منكمۡ جزاء ولا شكورا
en: [saying], "we feed you only for the countenance of allah. we wish not from you reward or gratitude

arNorm: انا نخاف من ربنا يوۡما عبوسا قمۡطريرا
en: indeed, we fear from our lord a day austere and distressful

arNorm: فوقيهم الله شر ذلك الۡيوۡم ولقيهمۡ نضۡره وسرورا
en: so allah will protect them from the evil of that day and give them radiance and happiness

arNorm: وجزيهم بما صبروا جنه وحريرا
en: and will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in paradise] and silk [garments]

arNorm: متكين فيها علي الۡارائكۖ لا يروۡن فيها شمۡسا ولا زمۡهريرا
en: [they will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. they will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold

arNorm: ودانيه عليۡهمۡ ظللها وذللتۡ قطوفها تذۡليلا
en: and near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance

arNorm: ويطاف عليۡهم بانيه من فضه واكۡواب كانتۡ قواريرا۠
en: and there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass]

arNorm: قواريرا من فضه قدروها تقۡديرا
en: clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure

arNorm: ويسۡقوۡن فيها كاۡسا كان مزاجها زنجبيلا
en: and they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger

arNorm: عيۡنا فيها تسمي سلۡسبيلا
en: [from] a fountain within paradise named salsabeel

arNorm: ۞ويطوف عليۡهمۡ ولۡدن مخلدون اذا رايۡتهمۡ حسبۡتهمۡ لؤۡلؤا منثورا
en: there will circulate among them young boys made eternal. when you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls

arNorm: واذا رايۡت ثم رايۡت نعيما وملۡكا كبيرا
en: and when you look there [in paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion

arNorm: عليهمۡ ثياب سندس خضۡر واسۡتبۡرقۖ وحلوا اساور من فضه وسقيهمۡ ربهمۡ شرابا طهورا
en: upon the inhabitants will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. and they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their lord will give them a purifying drink

arNorm: ان هذا كان لكمۡ جزاء وكان سعۡيكم مشۡكورا
en: [and it will be said], "indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated

arNorm: انا نحۡن نزلۡنا عليۡك الۡقرۡءان تنزيلا
en: indeed, it is we who have sent down to you, [o muhammad], the qur'an progressively

arNorm: فاصۡبرۡ لحكۡم ربك ولا تطعۡ منۡهمۡ ءاثما اوۡ كفورا
en: so be patient for the decision of your lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever]

arNorm: واذۡكر اسۡم ربك بكۡره واصيلا
en: and mention the name of your lord [in prayer] morning and evening

arNorm: ومن اليۡل فاسۡجدۡ لهۥ وسبحۡه ليۡلا طويلا
en: and during the night prostrate to him and exalt him a long [part of the] night

arNorm: ان هؤلاء يحبون الۡعاجله ويذرون وراءهمۡ يوۡما ثقيلا
en: indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave day

arNorm: نحۡن خلقۡنهمۡ وشددۡنا اسۡرهمۡۖ واذا شئۡنا بدلۡنا امۡثلهمۡ تبۡديلا
en: we have created them and strengthened their forms, and when we will, we can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration

arNorm: ان هذهۦ تذۡكرهۖ فمن شاء اتخذ الي ربهۦ سبيلا
en: indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his lord a way

arNorm: وما تشاءون الا ان يشاء اللهۚ ان الله كان عليما حكيما
en: and you do not will except that allah wills. indeed, allah is ever knowing and wise

arNorm: يدۡخل من يشاء في رحۡمتهۦۚ والظلمين اعد لهمۡ عذابا اليمۢا
en: he admits whom he wills into his mercy; but the wrongdoers - he has prepared for them a painful punishment

arNorm: والۡمرۡسلت عرۡفا
en: by those [winds] sent forth in gusts

arNorm: فالۡعصفت عصۡفا
en: and the winds that blow violently

arNorm: والنشرت نشۡرا
en: and [by] the winds that spread [clouds]

arNorm: فالۡفرقت فرۡقا
en: and those [angels] who bring criterion

arNorm: فالۡملۡقيت ذكۡرا
en: and those [angels] who deliver a message

arNorm: عذۡرا اوۡ نذۡرا
en: as justification or warning

arNorm: انما توعدون لوقع
en: indeed, what you are promised is to occur

arNorm: فاذا النجوم طمستۡ
en: so when the stars are obliterated

arNorm: واذا السماء فرجتۡ
en: and when the heaven is opened

arNorm: واذا الۡجبال نسفتۡ
en: and when the mountains are blown away

arNorm: واذا الرسل اقتتۡ
en: and when the messengers' time has come

arNorm: لاي يوۡم اجلتۡ
en: for what day was it postponed

arNorm: ليوۡم الۡفصۡل
en: for the day of judgement

arNorm: وما ادۡريك ما يوۡم الۡفصۡل
en: and what can make you know what is the day of judgement

arNorm: ويۡل يوۡمئذ للۡمكذبين
en: woe, that day, to the deniers

arNorm: المۡ نهۡلك الۡاولين
en: did we not destroy the former peoples

arNorm: ثم نتۡبعهم الۡاخرين
en: then we will follow them with the later ones

arNorm: كذلك نفۡعل بالۡمجۡرمين
en: thus do we deal with the criminals

arNorm: ويۡل يوۡمئذ للۡمكذبين
en: woe, that day, to the deniers

arNorm: المۡ نخۡلقكم من ماء مهين
en: did we not create you from a liquid disdained

arNorm: فجعلۡنه في قرار مكين
en: and we placed it in a firm lodging

arNorm: الي قدر معۡلوم
en: for a known extent

arNorm: فقدرۡنا فنعۡم الۡقدرون
en: and we determined [it], and excellent [are we] to determine

arNorm: ويۡل يوۡمئذ للۡمكذبين
en: woe, that day, to the deniers

arNorm: المۡ نجۡعل الۡارۡض كفاتا
en: have we not made the earth a container

arNorm: احۡياء وامۡوتا
en: of the living and the dead

arNorm: وجعلۡنا فيها روسي شمخت واسۡقيۡنكم ماء فراتا
en: and we placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water

arNorm: ويۡل يوۡمئذ للۡمكذبين
en: woe, that day, to the deniers

arNorm: انطلقوا الي ما كنتم بهۦ تكذبون
en: [they will be told], "proceed to that which you used to deny

arNorm: انطلقوا الي ظل ذي ثلث شعب
en: proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns

arNorm: لا ظليل ولا يغۡني من اللهب
en: [but having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame

arNorm: انها ترۡمي بشرر كالۡقصۡر
en: indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress

arNorm: كانهۥ جملت صفۡر
en: as if they were yellowish [black] camels

arNorm: ويۡل يوۡمئذ للۡمكذبين
en: woe, that day, to the deniers

arNorm: هذا يوۡم لا ينطقون
en: this is a day they will not speak

arNorm: ولا يؤۡذن لهمۡ فيعۡتذرون
en: nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse

arNorm: ويۡل يوۡمئذ للۡمكذبين
en: woe, that day, to the deniers

arNorm: هذا يوۡم الۡفصۡلۖ جمعۡنكمۡ والۡاولين
en: this is the day of judgement; we will have assembled you and the former peoples

arNorm: فان كان لكمۡ كيۡد فكيدون
en: so if you have a plan, then plan against me

arNorm: ويۡل يوۡمئذ للۡمكذبين
en: woe, that day, to the deniers

arNorm: ان الۡمتقين في ظلل وعيون
en: indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs

arNorm: وفوكه مما يشۡتهون
en: and fruits from whatever they desire

arNorm: كلوا واشۡربوا هنيۢا بما كنتمۡ تعۡملون
en: [being told], "eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do

arNorm: انا كذلك نجۡزي الۡمحۡسنين
en: indeed, we thus reward the doers of good

arNorm: ويۡل يوۡمئذ للۡمكذبين
en: woe, that day, to the deniers

arNorm: كلوا وتمتعوا قليلا انكم مجۡرمون
en: [o disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals

arNorm: ويۡل يوۡمئذ للۡمكذبين
en: woe, that day, to the deniers

arNorm: واذا قيل لهم ارۡكعوا لا يرۡكعون
en: and when it is said to them, "bow [in prayer]," they do not bow

arNorm: ويۡل يوۡمئذ للۡمكذبين
en: woe, that day, to the deniers

arNorm: فباي حديثۭ بعۡدهۥ يؤۡمنون
en: then in what statement after the qur'an will they believe

arNorm: عم يتساءلون
en: about what are they asking one another

arNorm: عن النبا الۡعظيم
en: about the great news

arNorm: الذي همۡ فيه مخۡتلفون
en: that over which they are in disagreement

arNorm: كلا سيعۡلمون
en: no! they are going to know

arNorm: ثم كلا سيعۡلمون
en: then, no! they are going to know

arNorm: المۡ نجۡعل الۡارۡض مهدا
en: have we not made the earth a resting place

arNorm: والۡجبال اوۡتادا
en: and the mountains as stakes

arNorm: وخلقۡنكمۡ ازۡوجا
en: and we created you in pairs

arNorm: وجعلۡنا نوۡمكمۡ سباتا
en: and made your sleep [a means for] rest

arNorm: وجعلۡنا اليۡل لباسا
en: and made the night as clothing

arNorm: وجعلۡنا النهار معاشا
en: and made the day for livelihood

arNorm: وبنيۡنا فوۡقكمۡ سبۡعا شدادا
en: and constructed above you seven strong [heavens]

arNorm: وجعلۡنا سراجا وهاجا
en: and made [therein] a burning lamp

arNorm: وانزلۡنا من الۡمعۡصرت ماء ثجاجا
en: and sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water

arNorm: لنخۡرج بهۦ حبا ونباتا
en: that we may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation

arNorm: وجنت الۡفافا
en: and gardens of entwined growth

arNorm: ان يوۡم الۡفصۡل كان ميقتا
en: indeed, the day of judgement is an appointed time

arNorm: يوۡم ينفخ في الصور فتاۡتون افۡواجا
en: the day the horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes

arNorm: وفتحت السماء فكانتۡ ابۡوبا
en: and the heaven is opened and will become gateways

arNorm: وسيرت الۡجبال فكانتۡ سرابا
en: and the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage

arNorm: ان جهنم كانتۡ مرۡصادا
en: indeed, hell has been lying in wait

arNorm: للطغين مابا
en: for the transgressors, a place of return

arNorm: لبثين فيها احۡقابا
en: in which they will remain for ages [unending]

arNorm: لا يذوقون فيها برۡدا ولا شرابا
en: they will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink

arNorm: الا حميما وغساقا
en: except scalding water and [foul] purulence

arNorm: جزاء وفاقا
en: an appropriate recompense

arNorm: انهمۡ كانوا لا يرۡجون حسابا
en: indeed, they were not expecting an account

arNorm: وكذبوا بايتنا كذابا
en: and denied our verses with [emphatic] denial

arNorm: وكل شيۡء احۡصيۡنه كتبا
en: but all things we have enumerated in writing

arNorm: فذوقوا فلن نزيدكمۡ الا عذابا
en: so taste [the penalty], and never will we increase you except in torment

arNorm: ان للۡمتقين مفازا
en: indeed, for the righteous is attainment

arNorm: حدائق واعۡنبا
en: gardens and grapevines

arNorm: وكواعب اتۡرابا
en: and full-breasted [companions] of equal age

arNorm: وكاۡسا دهاقا
en: and a full cup

arNorm: لا يسۡمعون فيها لغۡوا ولا كذبا
en: no ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood

arNorm: جزاء من ربك عطاء حسابا
en: [as] reward from your lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account

arNorm: رب السموت والۡارۡض وما بيۡنهما الرحۡمنۖ لا يمۡلكون منۡه خطابا
en: [from] the lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the most merciful. they possess not from him [authority for] speech

arNorm: يوۡم يقوم الروح والۡملئكه صفاۖ لا يتكلمون الا منۡ اذن له الرحۡمن وقال صوابا
en: the day that the spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the most merciful permits, and he will say what is correct

arNorm: ذلك الۡيوۡم الۡحقۖ فمن شاء اتخذ الي ربهۦ مابا
en: that is the true day; so he who wills may take to his lord a [way of] return

arNorm: انا انذرۡنكمۡ عذابا قريبا يوۡم ينظر الۡمرۡء ما قدمتۡ يداه ويقول الۡكافر يليۡتني كنت تربۢا
en: indeed, we have warned you of a near punishment on the day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "oh, i wish that i were dust

arNorm: والنزعت غرۡقا
en: by those [angels] who extract with violence

arNorm: والنشطت نشۡطا
en: and [by] those who remove with ease

arNorm: والسبحت سبۡحا
en: and [by] those who glide [as if] swimming

arNorm: فالسبقت سبۡقا
en: and those who race each other in a race

arNorm: فالۡمدبرت امۡرا
en: and those who arrange [each] matter

arNorm: يوۡم ترۡجف الراجفه
en: on the day the blast [of the horn] will convulse [creation]

arNorm: تتۡبعها الرادفه
en: there will follow it the subsequent [one]

arNorm: قلوب يوۡمئذ واجفه
en: hearts, that day, will tremble

arNorm: ابۡصرها خشعه
en: their eyes humbled

arNorm: يقولون اءنا لمرۡدودون في الۡحافره
en: they are [presently] saying, "will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]

arNorm: اءذا كنا عظما نخره
en: even if we should be decayed bones

arNorm: قالوا تلۡك اذا كره خاسره
en: they say, "that, then, would be a losing return

arNorm: فانما هي زجۡره وحده
en: indeed, it will be but one shout

arNorm: فاذا هم بالساهره
en: and suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface

arNorm: هلۡ اتيك حديث موسي
en: has there reached you the story of moses

arNorm: اذۡ ناديه ربهۥ بالۡواد الۡمقدس طوي
en: when his lord called to him in the sacred valley of tuwa

arNorm: اذۡهبۡ الي فرۡعوۡن انهۥ طغي
en: go to pharaoh. indeed, he has transgressed

arNorm: فقلۡ هل لك الي ان تزكي
en: and say to him, 'would you [be willing to] purify yourself

arNorm: واهۡديك الي ربك فتخۡشي
en: and let me guide you to your lord so you would fear [him]

arNorm: فاريه الۡايه الۡكبۡري
en: and he showed him the greatest sign

arNorm: فكذب وعصي
en: but pharaoh denied and disobeyed

arNorm: ثم ادۡبر يسۡعي
en: then he turned his back, striving

arNorm: فحشر فنادي
en: and he gathered [his people] and called out

arNorm: فقال انا۠ ربكم الۡاعۡلي
en: and said, "i am your most exalted lord

arNorm: فاخذه الله نكال الۡاخره والۡاولي
en: so allah seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression]

arNorm: ان في ذلك لعبۡره لمن يخۡشي
en: indeed in that is a warning for whoever would fear [allah]

arNorm: ءانتمۡ اشد خلۡقا ام السماءۚ بنيها
en: are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? allah constructed it

arNorm: رفع سمۡكها فسويها
en: he raised its ceiling and proportioned it

arNorm: واغۡطش ليۡلها واخۡرج ضحيها
en: and he darkened its night and extracted its brightness

arNorm: والۡارۡض بعۡد ذلك دحيها
en: and after that he spread the earth

arNorm: اخۡرج منۡها ماءها ومرۡعيها
en: he extracted from it its water and its pasture

arNorm: والۡجبال ارۡسيها
en: and the mountains he set firmly

arNorm: متعا لكمۡ ولانۡعمكمۡ
en: as provision for you and your grazing livestock

arNorm: فاذا جاءت الطامه الۡكبۡري
en: but when there comes the greatest overwhelming calamity

arNorm: يوۡم يتذكر الۡانسن ما سعي
en: the day when man will remember that for which he strove

arNorm: وبرزت الۡجحيم لمن يري
en: and hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see

arNorm: فاما من طغي
en: so as for he who transgressed

arNorm: وءاثر الۡحيوه الدنۡيا
en: and preferred the life of the world

arNorm: فان الۡجحيم هي الۡماۡوي
en: then indeed, hellfire will be [his] refuge

arNorm: واما منۡ خاف مقام ربهۦ ونهي النفۡس عن الۡهوي
en: but as for he who feared the position of his lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination

arNorm: فان الۡجنه هي الۡماۡوي
en: then indeed, paradise will be [his] refuge

arNorm: يسۡلونك عن الساعه ايان مرۡسيها
en: they ask you, [o muhammad], about the hour: when is its arrival

arNorm: فيم انت من ذكۡريها
en: in what [position] are you that you should mention it

arNorm: الي ربك منتهيها
en: to your lord is its finality

arNorm: انما انت منذر من يخۡشيها
en: you are only a warner for those who fear it

arNorm: كانهمۡ يوۡم يروۡنها لمۡ يلۡبثوا الا عشيه اوۡ ضحيها
en: it will be, on the day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof

arNorm: عبس وتولي
en: the prophet frowned and turned away

arNorm: ان جاءه الۡاعۡمي
en: because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting]

arNorm: وما يدۡريك لعلهۥ يزكي
en: but what would make you perceive, [o muhammad], that perhaps he might be purified

arNorm: اوۡ يذكر فتنفعه الذكۡري
en: or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him

arNorm: اما من اسۡتغۡني
en: as for he who thinks himself without need

arNorm: فانت لهۥ تصدي
en: to him you give attention

arNorm: وما عليۡك الا يزكي
en: and not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified

arNorm: واما من جاءك يسۡعي
en: but as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]

arNorm: وهو يخۡشي
en: while he fears [allah]

arNorm: فانت عنۡه تلهي
en: from him you are distracted

arNorm: كلا انها تذۡكره
en: no! indeed, these verses are a reminder

arNorm: فمن شاء ذكرهۥ
en: so whoever wills may remember it

arNorm: في صحف مكرمه
en: [it is recorded] in honored sheets

arNorm: مرۡفوعه مطهرهۭ
en: exalted and purified

arNorm: بايۡدي سفره
en: [carried] by the hands of messenger-angels

arNorm: كرامۭ برره
en: noble and dutiful

arNorm: قتل الۡانسن ما اكۡفرهۥ
en: cursed is man; how disbelieving is he

arNorm: منۡ اي شيۡء خلقهۥ
en: from what substance did he create him

arNorm: من نطۡفه خلقهۥ فقدرهۥ
en: from a sperm-drop he created him and destined for him

arNorm: ثم السبيل يسرهۥ
en: then he eased the way for him

arNorm: ثم اماتهۥ فاقۡبرهۥ
en: then he causes his death and provides a grave for him

arNorm: ثم اذا شاء انشرهۥ
en: then when he wills, he will resurrect him

arNorm: كلا لما يقۡض ما امرهۥ
en: no! man has not yet accomplished what he commanded him

arNorm: فلۡينظر الۡانسن الي طعامهۦ
en: then let mankind look at his food

arNorm: انا صببۡنا الۡماء صبا
en: how we poured down water in torrents

arNorm: ثم شققۡنا الۡارۡض شقا
en: then we broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts]

arNorm: فانۢبتۡنا فيها حبا
en: and caused to grow within it grain

arNorm: وعنبا وقضۡبا
en: and grapes and herbage

arNorm: وزيۡتونا ونخۡلا
en: and olive and palm trees

arNorm: وحدائق غلۡبا
en: and gardens of dense shrubbery

arNorm: وفكهه وابا
en: and fruit and grass

arNorm: متعا لكمۡ ولانۡعمكمۡ
en: [as] enjoyment for you and your grazing livestock

arNorm: فاذا جاءت الصاخه
en: but when there comes the deafening blast

arNorm: يوۡم يفر الۡمرۡء منۡ اخيه
en: on the day a man will flee from his brother

arNorm: وامهۦ وابيه
en: and his mother and his father

arNorm: وصحبتهۦ وبنيه
en: and his wife and his children

arNorm: لكل امۡري منۡهمۡ يوۡمئذ شاۡن يغۡنيه
en: for every man, that day, will be a matter adequate for him

arNorm: وجوه يوۡمئذ مسۡفره
en: [some] faces, that day, will be bright

arNorm: ضاحكه مسۡتبۡشره
en: laughing, rejoicing at good news

arNorm: ووجوه يوۡمئذ عليۡها غبره
en: and [other] faces, that day, will have upon them dust

arNorm: ترۡهقها قتره
en: blackness will cover them

arNorm: اولئك هم الۡكفره الۡفجره
en: those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones

arNorm: اذا الشمۡس كورتۡ
en: when the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]

arNorm: واذا النجوم انكدرتۡ
en: and when the stars fall, dispersing

arNorm: واذا الۡجبال سيرتۡ
en: and when the mountains are removed

arNorm: واذا الۡعشار عطلتۡ
en: and when full-term she-camels are neglected

arNorm: واذا الۡوحوش حشرتۡ
en: and when the wild beasts are gathered

arNorm: واذا الۡبحار سجرتۡ
en: and when the seas are filled with flame

arNorm: واذا النفوس زوجتۡ
en: and when the souls are paired

arNorm: واذا الۡموۡءۥده سئلتۡ
en: and when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked

arNorm: باي ذنۢب قتلتۡ
en: for what sin she was killed

arNorm: واذا الصحف نشرتۡ
en: and when the pages are made public

arNorm: واذا السماء كشطتۡ
en: and when the sky is stripped away

arNorm: واذا الۡجحيم سعرتۡ
en: and when hellfire is set ablaze

arNorm: واذا الۡجنه ازۡلفتۡ
en: and when paradise is brought near

arNorm: علمتۡ نفۡس ما احۡضرتۡ
en: a soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it]

arNorm: فلا اقۡسم بالۡخنس
en: so i swear by the retreating stars

arNorm: الۡجوار الۡكنس
en: those that run [their courses] and disappear

arNorm: واليۡل اذا عسۡعس
en: and by the night as it closes in

arNorm: والصبۡح اذا تنفس
en: and by the dawn when it breathes

arNorm: انهۥ لقوۡل رسول كريم
en: [that] indeed, the qur'an is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger

arNorm: ذي قوه عند ذي الۡعرۡش مكين
en: [who is] possessed of power and with the owner of the throne, secure [in position]

arNorm: مطاع ثم امين
en: obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy

arNorm: وما صاحبكم بمجۡنون
en: and your companion is not [at all] mad

arNorm: ولقدۡ رءاه بالۡافق الۡمبين
en: and he has already seen gabriel in the clear horizon

arNorm: وما هو علي الۡغيۡب بضنين
en: and muhammad is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen

arNorm: وما هو بقوۡل شيۡطن رجيم
en: and the qur'an is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens]

arNorm: فايۡن تذۡهبون
en: so where are you going

arNorm: انۡ هو الا ذكۡر للۡعلمين
en: it is not except a reminder to the worlds

arNorm: لمن شاء منكمۡ ان يسۡتقيم
en: for whoever wills among you to take a right course

arNorm: وما تشاءون الا ان يشاء الله رب الۡعلمين
en: and you do not will except that allah wills - lord of the worlds

arNorm: اذا السماء انفطرتۡ
en: when the sky breaks apart

arNorm: واذا الۡكواكب انتثرتۡ
en: and when the stars fall, scattering

arNorm: واذا الۡبحار فجرتۡ
en: and when the seas are erupted

arNorm: واذا الۡقبور بعۡثرتۡ
en: and when the [contents of] graves are scattered

arNorm: علمتۡ نفۡس ما قدمتۡ واخرتۡ
en: a soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back

arNorm: يايها الۡانسن ما غرك بربك الۡكريم
en: o mankind, what has deceived you concerning your lord, the generous

arNorm: الذي خلقك فسويك فعدلك
en: who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you

arNorm: في اي صوره ما شاء ركبك
en: in whatever form he willed has he assembled you

arNorm: كلا بلۡ تكذبون بالدين
en: no! but you deny the recompense

arNorm: وان عليۡكمۡ لحفظين
en: and indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers

arNorm: كراما كتبين
en: noble and recording

arNorm: يعۡلمون ما تفۡعلون
en: they know whatever you do

arNorm: ان الۡابۡرار لفي نعيم
en: indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure

arNorm: وان الۡفجار لفي جحيم
en: and indeed, the wicked will be in hellfire

arNorm: يصۡلوۡنها يوۡم الدين
en: they will [enter to] burn therein on the day of recompense

arNorm: وما همۡ عنۡها بغائبين
en: and never therefrom will they be absent

arNorm: وما ادۡريك ما يوۡم الدين
en: and what can make you know what is the day of recompense

arNorm: ثم ما ادۡريك ما يوۡم الدين
en: then, what can make you know what is the day of recompense

arNorm: يوۡم لا تمۡلك نفۡس لنفۡس شيۡاۖ والۡامۡر يوۡمئذ لله
en: it is the day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that day, is [entirely] with allah

arNorm: ويۡل للۡمطففين
en: woe to those who give less [than due]

arNorm: الذين اذا اكۡتالوا علي الناس يسۡتوۡفون
en: who, when they take a measure from people, take in full

arNorm: واذا كالوهمۡ او وزنوهمۡ يخۡسرون
en: but if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss

arNorm: الا يظن اولئك انهم مبۡعوثون
en: do they not think that they will be resurrected

arNorm: ليوۡم عظيم
en: for a tremendous day

arNorm: يوۡم يقوم الناس لرب الۡعلمين
en: the day when mankind will stand before the lord of the worlds

arNorm: كلا ان كتب الۡفجار لفي سجين
en: no! indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen

arNorm: وما ادۡريك ما سجين
en: and what can make you know what is sijjeen

arNorm: كتب مرۡقوم
en: it is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed

arNorm: ويۡل يوۡمئذ للۡمكذبين
en: woe, that day, to the deniers

arNorm: الذين يكذبون بيوۡم الدين
en: who deny the day of recompense

arNorm: وما يكذب بهۦ الا كل معۡتد اثيم
en: and none deny it except every sinful transgressor

arNorm: اذا تتۡلي عليۡه ءايتنا قال اسطير الۡاولين
en: when our verses are recited to him, he says, "legends of the former peoples

arNorm: كلاۖ بلۡۜ ران علي قلوبهم ما كانوا يكۡسبون
en: no! rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning

arNorm: كلا انهمۡ عن ربهمۡ يوۡمئذ لمحۡجوبون
en: no! indeed, from their lord, that day, they will be partitioned

arNorm: ثم انهمۡ لصالوا الۡجحيم
en: then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in hellfire

arNorm: ثم يقال هذا الذي كنتم بهۦ تكذبون
en: then it will be said [to them], "this is what you used to deny

arNorm: كلا ان كتب الۡابۡرار لفي عليين
en: no! indeed, the record of the righteous is in 'illiyyun

arNorm: وما ادۡريك ما عليون
en: and what can make you know what is 'illiyyun

arNorm: كتب مرۡقوم
en: it is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed

arNorm: يشۡهده الۡمقربون
en: which is witnessed by those brought near [to allah]

arNorm: ان الۡابۡرار لفي نعيم
en: indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure

arNorm: علي الۡارائك ينظرون
en: on adorned couches, observing

arNorm: تعۡرف في وجوههمۡ نضۡره النعيم
en: you will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure

arNorm: يسۡقوۡن من رحيق مخۡتوم
en: they will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed

arNorm: ختمهۥ مسۡكۚ وفي ذلك فلۡيتنافس الۡمتنفسون
en: the last of it is musk. so for this let the competitors compete

arNorm: ومزاجهۥ من تسۡنيم
en: and its mixture is of tasneem

arNorm: عيۡنا يشۡرب بها الۡمقربون
en: a spring from which those near [to allah] drink

arNorm: ان الذين اجۡرموا كانوا من الذين ءامنوا يضۡحكون
en: indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed

arNorm: واذا مروا بهمۡ يتغامزون
en: and when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances

arNorm: واذا انقلبوا الي اهۡلهم انقلبوا فكهين
en: and when they returned to their people, they would return jesting

arNorm: واذا راوۡهمۡ قالوا ان هؤلاء لضالون
en: and when they saw them, they would say, "indeed, those are truly lost

arNorm: وما ارۡسلوا عليۡهمۡ حفظين
en: but they had not been sent as guardians over them

arNorm: فالۡيوۡم الذين ءامنوا من الۡكفار يضۡحكون
en: so today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers

arNorm: علي الۡارائك ينظرون
en: on adorned couches, observing

arNorm: هلۡ ثوب الۡكفار ما كانوا يفۡعلون
en: have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this day] for what they used to do

arNorm: اذا السماء انشقتۡ
en: when the sky has split [open]

arNorm: واذنتۡ لربها وحقتۡ
en: and has responded to its lord and was obligated [to do so]

arNorm: واذا الۡارۡض مدتۡ
en: and when the earth has been extended

arNorm: والۡقتۡ ما فيها وتخلتۡ
en: and has cast out that within it and relinquished [it]

arNorm: واذنتۡ لربها وحقتۡ
en: and has responded to its lord and was obligated [to do so]

arNorm: يايها الۡانسن انك كادح الي ربك كدۡحا فملقيه
en: o mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your lord with [great] exertion and will meet it

arNorm: فاما منۡ اوتي كتبهۥ بيمينهۦ
en: then as for he who is given his record in his right hand

arNorm: فسوۡف يحاسب حسابا يسيرا
en: he will be judged with an easy account

arNorm: وينقلب الي اهۡلهۦ مسۡرورا
en: and return to his people in happiness

arNorm: واما منۡ اوتي كتبهۥ وراء ظهۡرهۦ
en: but as for he who is given his record behind his back

arNorm: فسوۡف يدۡعوا ثبورا
en: he will cry out for destruction

arNorm: ويصۡلي سعيرا
en: and [enter to] burn in a blaze

arNorm: انهۥ كان في اهۡلهۦ مسۡرورا
en: indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness

arNorm: انهۥ ظن ان لن يحور
en: indeed, he had thought he would never return [to allah]

arNorm: بليۚ ان ربهۥ كان بهۦ بصيرا
en: but yes! indeed, his lord was ever of him, seeing

arNorm: فلا اقۡسم بالشفق
en: so i swear by the twilight glow

arNorm: واليۡل وما وسق
en: and [by] the night and what it envelops

arNorm: والۡقمر اذا اتسق
en: and [by] the moon when it becomes full

arNorm: لترۡكبن طبقا عن طبق
en: [that] you will surely experience state after state

arNorm: فما لهمۡ لا يؤۡمنون
en: so what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe

arNorm: واذا قرئ عليۡهم الۡقرۡءان لا يسۡجدونۤ۩
en: and when the qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to allah]

arNorm: بل الذين كفروا يكذبون
en: but those who have disbelieved deny

arNorm: والله اعۡلم بما يوعون
en: and allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves

arNorm: فبشرۡهم بعذاب اليم
en: so give them tidings of a painful punishment

arNorm: الا الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت لهمۡ اجۡر غيۡر ممۡنونۭ
en: except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. for them is a reward uninterrupted

arNorm: والسماء ذات الۡبروج
en: by the sky containing great stars

arNorm: والۡيوۡم الۡموۡعود
en: and [by] the promised day

arNorm: وشاهد ومشۡهود
en: and [by] the witness and what is witnessed

arNorm: قتل اصۡحب الۡاخۡدود
en: cursed were the companions of the trench

arNorm: النار ذات الۡوقود
en: [containing] the fire full of fuel

arNorm: اذۡ همۡ عليۡها قعود
en: when they were sitting near it

arNorm: وهمۡ علي ما يفۡعلون بالۡمؤۡمنين شهود
en: and they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses

arNorm: وما نقموا منۡهمۡ الا ان يؤۡمنوا بالله الۡعزيز الۡحميد
en: and they resented them not except because they believed in allah, the exalted in might, the praiseworthy

arNorm: الذي لهۥ ملۡك السموت والۡارۡضۚ والله علي كل شيۡء شهيد
en: to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. and allah, over all things, is witness

arNorm: ان الذين فتنوا الۡمؤۡمنين والۡمؤۡمنت ثم لمۡ يتوبوا فلهمۡ عذاب جهنم ولهمۡ عذاب الۡحريق
en: indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of hell, and they will have the punishment of the burning fire

arNorm: ان الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت لهمۡ جنت تجۡري من تحۡتها الۡانۡهرۚ ذلك الۡفوۡز الۡكبير
en: indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. that is the great attainment

arNorm: ان بطۡش ربك لشديد
en: indeed, the vengeance of your lord is severe

arNorm: انهۥ هو يبۡدئ ويعيد
en: indeed, it is he who originates [creation] and repeats

arNorm: وهو الۡغفور الۡودود
en: and he is the forgiving, the affectionate

arNorm: ذو الۡعرۡش الۡمجيد
en: honorable owner of the throne

arNorm: فعال لما يريد
en: effecter of what he intends

arNorm: هلۡ اتيك حديث الۡجنود
en: has there reached you the story of the soldiers

arNorm: فرۡعوۡن وثمود
en: [those of] pharaoh and thamud

arNorm: بل الذين كفروا في تكۡذيب
en: but they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial

arNorm: والله من ورائهم محيطۢ
en: while allah encompasses them from behind

arNorm: بلۡ هو قرۡءان مجيد
en: but this is an honored qur'an

arNorm: في لوۡح محۡفوظۭ
en: [inscribed] in a preserved slate

arNorm: والسماء والطارق
en: by the sky and the night comer

arNorm: وما ادۡريك ما الطارق
en: and what can make you know what is the night comer

arNorm: النجۡم الثاقب
en: it is the piercing star

arNorm: ان كل نفۡس لما عليۡها حافظ
en: there is no soul but that it has over it a protector

arNorm: فلۡينظر الۡانسن مم خلق
en: so let man observe from what he was created

arNorm: خلق من ماء دافق
en: he was created from a fluid, ejected

arNorm: يخۡرج منۢ بيۡن الصلۡب والترائب
en: emerging from between the backbone and the ribs

arNorm: انهۥ علي رجۡعهۦ لقادر
en: indeed, allah, to return him [to life], is able

arNorm: يوۡم تبۡلي السرائر
en: the day when secrets will be put on trial

arNorm: فما لهۥ من قوه ولا ناصر
en: then man will have no power or any helper

arNorm: والسماء ذات الرجۡع
en: by the sky which returns [rain]

arNorm: والۡارۡض ذات الصدۡع
en: and [by] the earth which cracks open

arNorm: انهۥ لقوۡل فصۡل
en: indeed, the qur'an is a decisive statement

arNorm: وما هو بالۡهزۡل
en: and it is not amusement

arNorm: انهمۡ يكيدون كيۡدا
en: indeed, they are planning a plan

arNorm: واكيد كيۡدا
en: but i am planning a plan

arNorm: فمهل الۡكفرين امۡهلۡهمۡ رويۡدۢا
en: so allow time for the disbelievers. leave them awhile

arNorm: سبح اسۡم ربك الۡاعۡلي
en: exalt the name of your lord, the most high

arNorm: الذي خلق فسوي
en: who created and proportioned
