arNorm: والذي قدر فهدي
en: and who destined and [then] guided

arNorm: والذي اخۡرج الۡمرۡعي
en: and who brings out the pasture

arNorm: فجعلهۥ غثاء احۡوي
en: and [then] makes it black stubble

arNorm: سنقۡرئك فلا تنسي
en: we will make you recite, [o muhammad], and you will not forget

arNorm: الا ما شاء اللهۚ انهۥ يعۡلم الۡجهۡر وما يخۡفي
en: except what allah should will. indeed, he knows what is declared and what is hidden

arNorm: ونيسرك للۡيسۡري
en: and we will ease you toward ease

arNorm: فذكرۡ ان نفعت الذكۡري
en: so remind, if the reminder should benefit

arNorm: سيذكر من يخۡشي
en: he who fears [allah] will be reminded

arNorm: ويتجنبها الۡاشۡقي
en: but the wretched one will avoid it

arNorm: الذي يصۡلي النار الۡكبۡري
en: [he] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest fire

arNorm: ثم لا يموت فيها ولا يحۡيي
en: neither dying therein nor living

arNorm: قدۡ افۡلح من تزكي
en: he has certainly succeeded who purifies himself

arNorm: وذكر اسۡم ربهۦ فصلي
en: and mentions the name of his lord and prays

arNorm: بلۡ تؤۡثرون الۡحيوه الدنۡيا
en: but you prefer the worldly life

arNorm: والۡاخره خيۡر وابۡقي
en: while the hereafter is better and more enduring

arNorm: ان هذا لفي الصحف الۡاولي
en: indeed, this is in the former scriptures

arNorm: صحف ابۡرهيم وموسي
en: the scriptures of abraham and moses

arNorm: هلۡ اتيك حديث الۡغشيه
en: has there reached you the report of the overwhelming [event]

arNorm: وجوه يوۡمئذ خشعه
en: [some] faces, that day, will be humbled

arNorm: عامله ناصبه
en: working [hard] and exhausted

arNorm: تصۡلي نارا حاميه
en: they will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot fire

arNorm: تسۡقي منۡ عيۡن ءانيه
en: they will be given drink from a boiling spring

arNorm: ليۡس لهمۡ طعام الا من ضريع
en: for them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant

arNorm: لا يسۡمن ولا يغۡني من جوع
en: which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger

arNorm: وجوه يوۡمئذ ناعمه
en: [other] faces, that day, will show pleasure

arNorm: لسعۡيها راضيه
en: with their effort [they are] satisfied

arNorm: في جنه عاليه
en: in an elevated garden

arNorm: لا تسۡمع فيها لغيه
en: wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech

arNorm: فيها عيۡن جاريه
en: within it is a flowing spring

arNorm: فيها سرر مرۡفوعه
en: within it are couches raised high

arNorm: واكۡواب موۡضوعه
en: and cups put in place

arNorm: ونمارق مصۡفوفه
en: and cushions lined up

arNorm: وزرابي مبۡثوثه
en: and carpets spread around

arNorm: افلا ينظرون الي الۡابل كيۡف خلقتۡ
en: then do they not look at the camels - how they are created

arNorm: والي السماء كيۡف رفعتۡ
en: and at the sky - how it is raised

arNorm: والي الۡجبال كيۡف نصبتۡ
en: and at the mountains - how they are erected

arNorm: والي الۡارۡض كيۡف سطحتۡ
en: and at the earth - how it is spread out

arNorm: فذكرۡ انما انت مذكر
en: so remind, [o muhammad]; you are only a reminder

arNorm: لسۡت عليۡهم بمصيۡطر
en: you are not over them a controller

arNorm: الا من تولي وكفر
en: however, he who turns away and disbelieves

arNorm: فيعذبه الله الۡعذاب الۡاكۡبر
en: then allah will punish him with the greatest punishment

arNorm: ان اليۡنا ايابهمۡ
en: indeed, to us is their return

arNorm: ثم ان عليۡنا حسابهم
en: then indeed, upon us is their account

arNorm: والۡفجۡر
en: by the dawn

arNorm: وليال عشۡر
en: and [by] ten nights

arNorm: والشفۡع والۡوتۡر
en: and [by] the even [number] and the odd

arNorm: واليۡل اذا يسۡر
en: and [by] the night when it passes

arNorm: هلۡ في ذلك قسم لذي حجۡر
en: is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception

arNorm: المۡ تر كيۡف فعل ربك بعاد
en: have you not considered how your lord dealt with 'aad

arNorm: ارم ذات الۡعماد
en: [with] iram - who had lofty pillars

arNorm: التي لمۡ يخۡلقۡ مثۡلها في الۡبلد
en: the likes of whom had never been created in the land

arNorm: وثمود الذين جابوا الصخۡر بالۡواد
en: and [with] thamud, who carved out the rocks in the valley

arNorm: وفرۡعوۡن ذي الۡاوۡتاد
en: and [with] pharaoh, owner of the stakes

arNorm: الذين طغوۡا في الۡبلد
en: [all of] whom oppressed within the lands

arNorm: فاكۡثروا فيها الۡفساد
en: and increased therein the corruption

arNorm: فصب عليۡهمۡ ربك سوۡط عذاب
en: so your lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment

arNorm: ان ربك لبالۡمرۡصاد
en: indeed, your lord is in observation

arNorm: فاما الۡانسن اذا ما ابۡتليه ربهۥ فاكۡرمهۥ ونعمهۥ فيقول ربي اكۡرمن
en: and as for man, when his lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "my lord has honored me

arNorm: واما اذا ما ابۡتليه فقدر عليۡه رزۡقهۥ فيقول ربي اهنن
en: but when he tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "my lord has humiliated me

arNorm: كلاۖ بل لا تكۡرمون الۡيتيم
en: no! but you do not honor the orphan

arNorm: ولا تحضون علي طعام الۡمسۡكين
en: and you do not encourage one another to feed the poor

arNorm: وتاۡكلون التراث اكۡلا لما
en: and you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether

arNorm: وتحبون الۡمال حبا جما
en: and you love wealth with immense love

arNorm: كلاۖ اذا دكت الۡارۡض دكا دكا
en: no! when the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed

arNorm: وجاء ربك والۡملك صفا صفا
en: and your lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank

arNorm: وجايء يوۡمئذۭ بجهنمۚ يوۡمئذ يتذكر الۡانسن واني له الذكۡري
en: and brought [within view], that day, is hell - that day, man will remember, but what good to him will be the remembrance

arNorm: يقول يليۡتني قدمۡت لحياتي
en: he will say, "oh, i wish i had sent ahead [some good] for my life

arNorm: فيوۡمئذ لا يعذب عذابهۥ احد
en: so on that day, none will punish [as severely] as his punishment

arNorm: ولا يوثق وثاقهۥ احد
en: and none will bind [as severely] as his binding [of the evildoers]

arNorm: يايتها النفۡس الۡمطۡمئنه
en: [to the righteous it will be said], "o reassured soul

arNorm: ارۡجعي الي ربك راضيه مرۡضيه
en: return to your lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to him]

arNorm: فادۡخلي في عبدي
en: and enter among my [righteous] servants

arNorm: وادۡخلي جنتي
en: and enter my paradise

arNorm: لا اقۡسم بهذا الۡبلد
en: i swear by this city, makkah

arNorm: وانت حلۢ بهذا الۡبلد
en: and you, [o muhammad], are free of restriction in this city

arNorm: ووالد وما ولد
en: and [by] the father and that which was born [of him]

arNorm: لقدۡ خلقۡنا الۡانسن في كبد
en: we have certainly created man into hardship

arNorm: ايحۡسب ان لن يقۡدر عليۡه احد
en: does he think that never will anyone overcome him

arNorm: يقول اهۡلكۡت مالا لبدا
en: he says, "i have spent wealth in abundance

arNorm: ايحۡسب ان لمۡ يرهۥ احد
en: does he think that no one has seen him

arNorm: المۡ نجۡعل لهۥ عيۡنيۡن
en: have we not made for him two eyes

arNorm: ولسانا وشفتيۡن
en: and a tongue and two lips

arNorm: وهديۡنه النجۡديۡن
en: and have shown him the two ways

arNorm: فلا اقۡتحم الۡعقبه
en: but he has not broken through the difficult pass

arNorm: وما ادۡريك ما الۡعقبه
en: and what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass

arNorm: فك رقبه
en: it is the freeing of a slave

arNorm: اوۡ اطۡعم في يوۡم ذي مسۡغبه
en: or feeding on a day of severe hunger

arNorm: يتيما ذا مقۡربه
en: an orphan of near relationship

arNorm: اوۡ مسۡكينا ذا متۡربه
en: or a needy person in misery

arNorm: ثم كان من الذين ءامنوا وتواصوۡا بالصبۡر وتواصوۡا بالۡمرۡحمه
en: and then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion

arNorm: اولئك اصۡحب الۡميۡمنه
en: those are the companions of the right

arNorm: والذين كفروا بايتنا همۡ اصۡحب الۡمشۡمه
en: but they who disbelieved in our signs - those are the companions of the left

arNorm: عليۡهمۡ نار مؤۡصدهۢ
en: over them will be fire closed in

arNorm: والشمۡس وضحيها
en: by the sun and its brightness

arNorm: والۡقمر اذا تليها
en: and [by] the moon when it follows it

arNorm: والنهار اذا جليها
en: and [by] the day when it displays it

arNorm: واليۡل اذا يغۡشيها
en: and [by] the night when it covers it

arNorm: والسماء وما بنيها
en: and [by] the sky and he who constructed it

arNorm: والۡارۡض وما طحيها
en: and [by] the earth and he who spread it

arNorm: ونفۡس وما سويها
en: and [by] the soul and he who proportioned it

arNorm: فالۡهمها فجورها وتقۡويها
en: and inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness

arNorm: قدۡ افۡلح من زكيها
en: he has succeeded who purifies it

arNorm: وقدۡ خاب من دسيها
en: and he has failed who instills it [with corruption]

arNorm: كذبتۡ ثمود بطغۡويها
en: thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression

arNorm: اذ انۢبعث اشۡقيها
en: when the most wretched of them was sent forth

arNorm: فقال لهمۡ رسول الله ناقه الله وسقۡيها
en: and the messenger of allah [salih] said to them, "[do not harm] the she-camel of allah or [prevent her from] her drink

arNorm: فكذبوه فعقروها فدمۡدم عليۡهمۡ ربهم بذنۢبهمۡ فسويها
en: but they denied him and hamstrung her. so their lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them]

arNorm: ولا يخاف عقۡبها
en: and he does not fear the consequence thereof

arNorm: واليۡل اذا يغۡشي
en: by the night when it covers

arNorm: والنهار اذا تجلي
en: and [by] the day when it appears

arNorm: وما خلق الذكر والۡانثي
en: and [by] he who created the male and female

arNorm: ان سعۡيكمۡ لشتي
en: indeed, your efforts are diverse

arNorm: فاما منۡ اعۡطي واتقي
en: as for he who gives and fears allah

arNorm: وصدق بالۡحسۡني
en: and believes in the best [reward]

arNorm: فسنيسرهۥ للۡيسۡري
en: we will ease him toward ease

arNorm: واما منۢ بخل واسۡتغۡني
en: but as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need

arNorm: وكذب بالۡحسۡني
en: and denies the best [reward]

arNorm: فسنيسرهۥ للۡعسۡري
en: we will ease him toward difficulty

arNorm: وما يغۡني عنۡه مالهۥ اذا تردي
en: and what will his wealth avail him when he falls

arNorm: ان عليۡنا للۡهدي
en: indeed, [incumbent] upon us is guidance

arNorm: وان لنا للۡاخره والۡاولي
en: and indeed, to us belongs the hereafter and the first [life]

arNorm: فانذرۡتكمۡ نارا تلظي
en: so i have warned you of a fire which is blazing

arNorm: لا يصۡليها الا الۡاشۡقي
en: none will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one

arNorm: الذي كذب وتولي
en: who had denied and turned away

arNorm: وسيجنبها الۡاتۡقي
en: but the righteous one will avoid it

arNorm: الذي يؤۡتي مالهۥ يتزكي
en: [he] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself

arNorm: وما لاحد عندهۥ من نعۡمه تجۡزي
en: and not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded

arNorm: الا ابۡتغاء وجۡه ربه الۡاعۡلي
en: but only seeking the countenance of his lord, most high

arNorm: ولسوۡف يرۡضي
en: and he is going to be satisfied

arNorm: والضحي
en: by the morning brightness

arNorm: واليۡل اذا سجي
en: and [by] the night when it covers with darkness

arNorm: ما ودعك ربك وما قلي
en: your lord has not taken leave of you, [o muhammad], nor has he detested [you]

arNorm: وللۡاخره خيۡر لك من الۡاولي
en: and the hereafter is better for you than the first [life]

arNorm: ولسوۡف يعۡطيك ربك فترۡضي
en: and your lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied

arNorm: المۡ يجدۡك يتيما فاوي
en: did he not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge

arNorm: ووجدك ضالا فهدي
en: and he found you lost and guided [you]

arNorm: ووجدك عائلا فاغۡني
en: and he found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient

arNorm: فاما الۡيتيم فلا تقۡهرۡ
en: so as for the orphan, do not oppress [him]

arNorm: واما السائل فلا تنۡهرۡ
en: and as for the petitioner, do not repel [him]

arNorm: واما بنعۡمه ربك فحدثۡ
en: but as for the favor of your lord, report [it]

arNorm: المۡ نشۡرحۡ لك صدۡرك
en: did we not expand for you, [o muhammad], your breast

arNorm: ووضعۡنا عنك وزۡرك
en: and we removed from you your burden

arNorm: الذي انقض ظهۡرك
en: which had weighed upon your back

arNorm: ورفعۡنا لك ذكۡرك
en: and raised high for you your repute

arNorm: فان مع الۡعسۡر يسۡرا
en: for indeed, with hardship [will be] ease

arNorm: ان مع الۡعسۡر يسۡرا
en: indeed, with hardship [will be] ease

arNorm: فاذا فرغۡت فانصبۡ
en: so when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship]

arNorm: والي ربك فارۡغب
en: and to your lord direct [your] longing

arNorm: والتين والزيۡتون
en: by the fig and the olive

arNorm: وطور سينين
en: and [by] mount sinai

arNorm: وهذا الۡبلد الۡامين
en: and [by] this secure city [makkah]

arNorm: لقدۡ خلقۡنا الۡانسن في احۡسن تقۡويم
en: we have certainly created man in the best of stature

arNorm: ثم رددۡنه اسۡفل سفلين
en: then we return him to the lowest of the low

arNorm: الا الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت فلهمۡ اجۡر غيۡر ممۡنون
en: except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted

arNorm: فما يكذبك بعۡد بالدين
en: so what yet causes you to deny the recompense

arNorm: اليۡس الله باحۡكم الۡحكمين
en: is not allah the most just of judges

arNorm: اقۡراۡ باسۡم ربك الذي خلق
en: recite in the name of your lord who created

arNorm: خلق الۡانسن منۡ علق
en: created man from a clinging substance

arNorm: اقۡراۡ وربك الۡاكۡرم
en: recite, and your lord is the most generous

arNorm: الذي علم بالۡقلم
en: who taught by the pen

arNorm: علم الۡانسن ما لمۡ يعۡلمۡ
en: taught man that which he knew not

arNorm: كلا ان الۡانسن ليطۡغي
en: no! [but] indeed, man transgresses

arNorm: ان رءاه اسۡتغۡني
en: because he sees himself self-sufficient

arNorm: ان الي ربك الرجۡعي
en: indeed, to your lord is the return

arNorm: ارءيۡت الذي ينۡهي
en: have you seen the one who forbids

arNorm: عبۡدا اذا صلي
en: a servant when he prays

arNorm: ارءيۡت ان كان علي الۡهدي
en: have you seen if he is upon guidance

arNorm: اوۡ امر بالتقۡوي
en: or enjoins righteousness

arNorm: ارءيۡت ان كذب وتولي
en: have you seen if he denies and turns away

arNorm: المۡ يعۡلم بان الله يري
en: does he not know that allah sees

arNorm: كلا لئن لمۡ ينته لنسۡفعۢا بالناصيه
en: no! if he does not desist, we will surely drag him by the forelock

arNorm: ناصيه كذبه خاطئه
en: a lying, sinning forelock

arNorm: فلۡيدۡع ناديهۥ
en: then let him call his associates

arNorm: سندۡع الزبانيه
en: we will call the angels of hell

arNorm: كلا لا تطعۡه واسۡجدۡۤ واقۡترب۩
en: no! do not obey him. but prostrate and draw near [to allah]

arNorm: انا انزلۡنه في ليۡله الۡقدۡر
en: indeed, we sent the qur'an down during the night of decree

arNorm: وما ادۡريك ما ليۡله الۡقدۡر
en: and what can make you know what is the night of decree

arNorm: ليۡله الۡقدۡر خيۡر منۡ الۡف شهۡر
en: the night of decree is better than a thousand months

arNorm: تنزل الۡملئكه والروح فيها باذۡن ربهم من كل امۡر
en: the angels and the spirit descend therein by permission of their lord for every matter

arNorm: سلم هي حتي مطۡلع الۡفجۡر
en: peace it is until the emergence of dawn

arNorm: لمۡ يكن الذين كفروا منۡ اهۡل الۡكتب والۡمشۡركين منفكين حتي تاۡتيهم الۡبينه
en: those who disbelieved among the people of the scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted [from misbelief] until there came to them clear evidence

arNorm: رسول من الله يتۡلوا صحفا مطهره
en: a messenger from allah, reciting purified scriptures

arNorm: فيها كتب قيمه
en: within which are correct writings

arNorm: وما تفرق الذين اوتوا الۡكتب الا منۢ بعۡد ما جاءتۡهم الۡبينه
en: nor did those who were given the scripture become divided until after there had come to them clear evidence

arNorm: وما امروا الا ليعۡبدوا الله مخۡلصين له الدين حنفاء ويقيموا الصلوه ويؤۡتوا الزكوهۚ وذلك دين الۡقيمه
en: and they were not commanded except to worship allah, [being] sincere to him in religion, inclining to truth, and to establish prayer and to give zakah. and that is the correct religion

arNorm: ان الذين كفروا منۡ اهۡل الۡكتب والۡمشۡركين في نار جهنم خلدين فيهاۚ اولئك همۡ شر الۡبريه
en: indeed, they who disbelieved among the people of the scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of hell, abiding eternally therein. those are the worst of creatures

arNorm: ان الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت اولئك همۡ خيۡر الۡبريه
en: indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures

arNorm: جزاؤهمۡ عند ربهمۡ جنت عدۡن تجۡري من تحۡتها الۡانۡهر خلدين فيها ابداۖ رضي الله عنۡهمۡ ورضوا عنۡهۚ ذلك لمنۡ خشي ربهۥ
en: their reward with allah will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, allah being pleased with them and they with him. that is for whoever has feared his lord

arNorm: اذا زلۡزلت الۡارۡض زلۡزالها
en: when the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake

arNorm: واخۡرجت الۡارۡض اثۡقالها
en: and the earth discharges its burdens

arNorm: وقال الۡانسن ما لها
en: and man says, "what is [wrong] with it

arNorm: يوۡمئذ تحدث اخۡبارها
en: that day, it will report its news

arNorm: بان ربك اوۡحي لها
en: because your lord has commanded it

arNorm: يوۡمئذ يصۡدر الناس اشۡتاتا ليروۡا اعۡملهمۡ
en: that day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds

arNorm: فمن يعۡملۡ مثۡقال ذره خيۡرا يرهۥ
en: so whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it

arNorm: ومن يعۡملۡ مثۡقال ذره شرا يرهۥ
en: and whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it

arNorm: والۡعديت ضبۡحا
en: by the racers, panting

arNorm: فالۡموريت قدۡحا
en: and the producers of sparks [when] striking

arNorm: فالۡمغيرت صبۡحا
en: and the chargers at dawn

arNorm: فاثرۡن بهۦ نقۡعا
en: stirring up thereby [clouds of] dust

arNorm: فوسطۡن بهۦ جمۡعا
en: arriving thereby in the center collectively

arNorm: ان الۡانسن لربهۦ لكنود
en: indeed mankind, to his lord, is ungrateful

arNorm: وانهۥ علي ذلك لشهيد
en: and indeed, he is to that a witness

arNorm: وانهۥ لحب الۡخيۡر لشديد
en: and indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense

arNorm: ۞افلا يعۡلم اذا بعۡثر ما في الۡقبور
en: but does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered

arNorm: وحصل ما في الصدور
en: and that within the breasts is obtained

arNorm: ان ربهم بهمۡ يوۡمئذ لخبيرۢ
en: indeed, their lord with them, that day, is [fully] acquainted

arNorm: الۡقارعه
en: the striking calamity

arNorm: ما الۡقارعه
en: what is the striking calamity

arNorm: وما ادۡريك ما الۡقارعه
en: and what can make you know what is the striking calamity

arNorm: يوۡم يكون الناس كالۡفراش الۡمبۡثوث
en: it is the day when people will be like moths, dispersed

arNorm: وتكون الۡجبال كالۡعهۡن الۡمنفوش
en: and the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up

arNorm: فاما من ثقلتۡ موزينهۥ
en: then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds]

arNorm: فهو في عيشه راضيه
en: he will be in a pleasant life

arNorm: واما منۡ خفتۡ موزينهۥ
en: but as for one whose scales are light

arNorm: فامهۥ هاويه
en: his refuge will be an abyss

arNorm: وما ادۡريك ما هيهۡ
en: and what can make you know what that is

arNorm: نار حاميهۢ
en: it is a fire, intensely hot

arNorm: الۡهيكم التكاثر
en: competition in [worldly] increase diverts you

arNorm: حتي زرۡتم الۡمقابر
en: until you visit the graveyards

arNorm: كلا سوۡف تعۡلمون
en: no! you are going to know

arNorm: ثم كلا سوۡف تعۡلمون
en: then no! you are going to know

arNorm: كلا لوۡ تعۡلمون علۡم الۡيقين
en: no! if you only knew with knowledge of certainty

arNorm: لترون الۡجحيم
en: you will surely see the hellfire

arNorm: ثم لترونها عيۡن الۡيقين
en: then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty

arNorm: ثم لتسۡلن يوۡمئذ عن النعيم
en: then you will surely be asked that day about pleasure

arNorm: والۡعصۡر
en: by time

arNorm: ان الۡانسن لفي خسۡر
en: indeed, mankind is in loss

arNorm: الا الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت وتواصوۡا بالۡحق وتواصوۡا بالصبۡر
en: except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience

arNorm: ويۡل لكل همزه لمزه
en: woe to every scorner and mocker

arNorm: الذي جمع مالا وعددهۥ
en: who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it

arNorm: يحۡسب ان مالهۥ اخۡلدهۥ
en: he thinks that his wealth will make him immortal

arNorm: كلاۖ لينۢبذن في الۡحطمه
en: no! he will surely be thrown into the crusher

arNorm: وما ادۡريك ما الۡحطمه
en: and what can make you know what is the crusher

arNorm: نار الله الۡموقده
en: it is the fire of allah, [eternally] fueled

arNorm: التي تطلع علي الۡافۡده
en: which mounts directed at the hearts

arNorm: انها عليۡهم مؤۡصده
en: indeed, hellfire will be closed down upon them

arNorm: في عمد ممددهۭ
en: in extended columns

arNorm: المۡ تر كيۡف فعل ربك باصۡحب الۡفيل
en: have you not considered, [o muhammad], how your lord dealt with the companions of the elephant

arNorm: المۡ يجۡعلۡ كيۡدهمۡ في تضۡليل
en: did he not make their plan into misguidance

arNorm: وارۡسل عليۡهمۡ طيۡرا ابابيل
en: and he sent against them birds in flocks

arNorm: ترۡميهم بحجاره من سجيل
en: striking them with stones of hard clay

arNorm: فجعلهمۡ كعصۡف ماۡكولۭ
en: and he made them like eaten straw

arNorm: لايلف قريۡش
en: for the accustomed security of the quraysh

arNorm: اۦلفهمۡ رحۡله الشتاء والصيۡف
en: their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer

arNorm: فلۡيعۡبدوا رب هذا الۡبيۡت
en: let them worship the lord of this house

arNorm: الذي اطۡعمهم من جوع وءامنهم منۡ خوۡفۭ
en: who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear

arNorm: ارءيۡت الذي يكذب بالدين
en: have you seen the one who denies the recompense

arNorm: فذلك الذي يدع الۡيتيم
en: for that is the one who drives away the orphan

arNorm: ولا يحض علي طعام الۡمسۡكين
en: and does not encourage the feeding of the poor

arNorm: فويۡل للۡمصلين
en: so woe to those who pray

arNorm: الذين همۡ عن صلاتهمۡ ساهون
en: [but] who are heedless of their prayer

arNorm: الذين همۡ يراءون
en: those who make show [of their deeds]

arNorm: ويمۡنعون الۡماعون
en: and withhold [simple] assistance

arNorm: انا اعۡطيۡنك الۡكوۡثر
en: indeed, we have granted you, [o muhammad], al-kawthar

arNorm: فصل لربك وانۡحرۡ
en: so pray to your lord and sacrifice [to him alone]

arNorm: ان شانئك هو الۡابۡتر
en: indeed, your enemy is the one cut off

arNorm: قلۡ يايها الۡكفرون
en: say, "o disbelievers

arNorm: لا اعۡبد ما تعۡبدون
en: i do not worship what you worship

arNorm: ولا انتمۡ عبدون ما اعۡبد
en: nor are you worshippers of what i worship

arNorm: ولا انا۠ عابد ما عبدتمۡ
en: nor will i be a worshipper of what you worship

arNorm: ولا انتمۡ عبدون ما اعۡبد
en: nor will you be worshippers of what i worship

arNorm: لكمۡ دينكمۡ ولي دين
en: for you is your religion, and for me is my religion

arNorm: اذا جاء نصۡر الله والۡفتۡح
en: when the victory of allah has come and the conquest

arNorm: ورايۡت الناس يدۡخلون في دين الله افۡواجا
en: and you see the people entering into the religion of allah in multitudes

arNorm: فسبحۡ بحمۡد ربك واسۡتغۡفرۡهۚ انهۥ كان توابۢا
en: then exalt [him] with praise of your lord and ask forgiveness of him. indeed, he is ever accepting of repentance

arNorm: تبتۡ يدا ابي لهب وتب
en: may the hands of abu lahab be ruined, and ruined is he

arNorm: ما اغۡني عنۡه مالهۥ وما كسب
en: his wealth will not avail him or that which he gained

arNorm: سيصۡلي نارا ذات لهب
en: he will [enter to] burn in a fire of [blazing] flame

arNorm: وامۡراتهۥ حماله الۡحطب
en: and his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood

arNorm: في جيدها حبۡل من مسدۭ
en: around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber

arNorm: قلۡ هو الله احد
en: say, "he is allah, [who is] one

arNorm: الله الصمد
en: allah, the eternal refuge

arNorm: لمۡ يلدۡ ولمۡ يولدۡ
en: he neither begets nor is born

arNorm: ولمۡ يكن لهۥ كفوا احدۢ
en: nor is there to him any equivalent

arNorm: قلۡ اعوذ برب الۡفلق
en: say, "i seek refuge in the lord of daybreak

arNorm: من شر ما خلق
en: from the evil of that which he created

arNorm: ومن شر غاسق اذا وقب
en: and from the evil of darkness when it settles

arNorm: ومن شر النفثت في الۡعقد
en: and from the evil of the blowers in knots

arNorm: ومن شر حاسد اذا حسد
en: and from the evil of an envier when he envies

arNorm: قلۡ اعوذ برب الناس
en: say, "i seek refuge in the lord of mankind

arNorm: ملك الناس
en: the sovereign of mankind

arNorm: اله الناس
en: the god of mankind

arNorm: من شر الۡوسۡواس الۡخناس
en: from the evil of the retreating whisperer

arNorm: الذي يوسۡوس في صدور الناس
en: who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind

arNorm: من الۡجنه والناس
en: from among the jinn and mankind
